sanskrit: prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyet sarvavighnopaśāntayemahendra madhyagaṃ śāntaṃ pārvatī sahitaṃ parampraṇamya caraṇau deva saṃghaissaha tu kāśyapaḥjagatāmabhivṛddhyarthaṃ yogināmupakārakammahārthamalpagranthaṃ ca karṣaṇādijñānasīmakamtantraṃ tava ca devānāṃ yantrāṇāmadhikāriṇāmanugrahāntaṃ tatteṣāṃ saṃkṣepādvada me prabhodurlabhaṃ tadahaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥdakṣiṇe cāśvayuṅmāsaṃ śrāvaṇī kṛttikā tathāpauṣṇādityamaghāsvātī sāvitrī tvaṣṭṭa maitrakaḥdineṣu pūjitāstvetāḥ pratipatṣaṣṭhi saptamīdaśamī tithayaḥ śastāḥ śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥtṛtīyā madhyamā khyātā kṛṣṇapakṣe dvijottama !sitasaumyaśaśī jīvavārāḥ śreṣṭhatamāḥ śubhāḥśubhameveti vijñeyāḥ tatra śaśyudayaṃ vināmeṣarāśyudayaṃ śastaṃ sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhidamśatrukṣetragataścandro nīcastho'pi dhanakṣayamāyuṣyaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca kartṛnāśaṃ na saṃśayaḥtathaiva candrasaṃyuktaṃ dhanadhānyavivardhanambandhusthānagatāḥ pāpāḥ sarvaduḥkha bhayāvahāḥśatrusthāna gatāḥ sarve sarvaduḥkha bhayāvahāḥāyuṣyaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca sarvasiddhipradāḥ sadāśubhagraho navasthāne sarvasaukhyadhanāvahaḥśubhagrahāśca karmasthāḥ sarvavittāyuṣa pradāḥdvādaśastho budho jīvo vittavṛddhiṃ samāvahet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyatīpāte parighaśūle vai ghṛte kālakaṇṭhakeulkāpāte ca bhṛguje vṛddhyā ca viṣanāḍikekarṣaṇādi pratiṣṭhāntaṃ sarvakarma vivarjayettasmādyuktena śīghraṃ ca kartavyo dharmasaṃgrahaḥanekakoṭi doṣāḍhyaṃ dinaṃ lagnaṃ ca meva caanekakoṭidoṣastu jīvaikena vināśanamtathaiva jīvadṛṣṭyā tu sarvadoṣasamudgamāḥpatraiva sadanaṃ kuryāt taddeśaṃ karṣaṇaṃ kurupaiśācika pade kuryāt ālayaṃ tu parāṅmukhamtāvadeveṣṭadigbhāge kartavyaṃ śivamandirammānuṣe tu pade vātha kartavyaṃ śivamaṃdiramsamanirmāṇakartāraḥ sarvaprāṇi hitāya vaipūrite tanmṛdaṃ dhīmān adhike cottamānmahīgṛhītā cottamā madhyā gṛhītā kanyasā mahīcaturvidhā mahīkhyātā tattajjātyārhatā śubhātattadyogyamahīgrāhyā martyānāmālayaṃ kurubhūtapretapiśācebhyo dadyāddadhyodanaṃ balimśvetau raktau ca kapilau kṛṣṇau jātyarhakau kramāthemaśṛṃgakhuropetau varṇāntara na saṃspṛśaupūrvaṃ nivedanaṃ kṛtvā prāṅmukhau saṃsthitau vṛṣausīrāyāmaṃ trihastaṃ syāt nāhaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ bhavetmekhaloccaṃ tritālaṃ syāt trimātraṃ tadghanaṃ bhavetmūlādagraṃ kramātkṣīṇaṃ kiṃcitkṣīṇaṃ tu madhyamamveśāṃśe dvyaṃgulaṃ vyāsaṃ ghanamardhārdha mātrakamsīrordhve ghrāṇa tuṃgaṃ tu paṃcāṃgulamudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śeṣaṃ citramiti khyātaṃ sīramekhalasandhitauagraṃ sūcinibhākāraṃ anupūrvātkṛśaṃ bhavetayasā halajihvā tu ghrāṇāgre yojayedbudhaḥkaniṣṭhāṃgulī parīṇāhaṃ gocarmadvikarāyatamyugamadhye halaṃ badhvā kiṃciddakṣiṇamāśritamtilasarṣapamudgāni netramaṃtreṇa vāpayettrirātrāṃ kurite śreṣṭhaṃ vedayatrau tu madhyamamāpuṣpātphalagaṃ rakṣya gogaṇānāṃ nivedayetgovaktragatakenaiśca gomayeḥ prastavairapipraśastaṃ bhūtalaṃ paścāt madhye samatalaṃ guruḥśaṃkuṃ kalāṃgulāyāmaṃ nāhaṃ tatsamamucyatemūlāgraṃ mukulākāraṃ mūlāgraṃ kramaśātkṛśamśaṃku dviguṇamānena tanmadhye maṇḍalaṃ likhetpūrvāparāhnayoḥ chāyāditi tanmaṇḍalāntagautadbindudvayagaṃ sūtraṃ pūrvāparadigiṣyatedakṣiṇottaragaṃ sūtraṃ tanmadhye tu prasārayetmaṇḍalaṃ kubjatālena kanyasaṃ tu vibhājitegatetvārjavamityuktaṃ kanyāyāśca tathaiva hivardhayenmithune saptaviṃśadaṃśāvasānakamkanyāyāṃ cāṣṭaviṃśāṃśāt ardhamātra vivardhanātchāyāvṛddhikṣayaṃ hyevaṃ kīrtitā śaṃkumadhyamātpūrvāparāhvayormadhye chāyāmānaṃ ca varjayetpuṇyāhaṃ vācayepaścātkhātvā prāsādamānakaḥtatpade vāstu devāṃśca pūjayitvā tu nāmataḥpraṇavādīnnāmamadhye svāhāntaṃ balimācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāstuhomaṃ vināyatra kṛtaṃ vāstu vinaśyatisthapatiḥ kṛtyayogyaḥ syāt sthāpako mantrayogyakaḥityaṃśumatkāśyape karṣaṇavidhipaṭalaḥ (prathamaḥ)prāsādasya viśāle tu navabhāga vibhājiteevaṃ navanavāṃśe tu brahmā madhye navāṃśabhukmitraḥ paścimabhāge tu uttare pṛthivīdharaḥāpaścaivāpavatsaśca tvaiśānyāṃ diśi saṃsthitauindra indrajayaścaiva nair-ṛtyāṃ diśi saṃsthitauete dvipadabhoktāra ardhamardhadvayaṃ tathāādityassatyakaścaiva bhraṃśaścaivāntarikṣakaḥgandharvo bhṛṃgarājaśca mṛgaścaiva tu dakṣiṇevaruṇaḥ śoṣarogau ca pāpayakṣmā ca paścimeṛgāditidyutiścaiva bāhye tvekāṃśabhāginaḥīśānādiṣu koṇeṣu bāhyasthāḥ padavarjitāḥvijṛmbho balipiṃchaśca pūrvavatpadavarjitāḥviṃśatsūtraistu te sarve badhvā vai vāstumūrtināmvāstumūrtiḥ kathaṃ deva ! badhvā taṃ śāyayetkathamasurāṇāṃ hitārthāya śukraḥ pratyādihattapaḥaprabuddhistu taṃ bhūtaṃ devairyuddhaṃ pravartatesarvadevāśca taṃ bhūtaṃ śayanaṃ tu hyadhomukhamsamāpa vāstu puruṣo vāstumūrtiṃ tamucyateyatra yadvāstu vinyāsaṃ tatsarvaṃ vāstumūrtimānsarva ṛddhikarārthaṃ tu vāstuhomabaliṃ kurutāsāṃ tṛptiṃ kṛte vāstu puruṣācca na bādhyatevāstuhomaśca kartavyo brahmādīnāṃ svanāmataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āgneyyāṃ vāyudigbhāge korparau jānuśāyinaunetrasthāne ca parjanyo jayantaśca trikaṃ bhṛgaḥnābhisūtre parabrahma bījetvindrastathaiva casamarī pṛthivī caiva stanasūtrapade sthitauūrdhvahastatale caiva savitāraṃ prakalpayetrudrorudrajayaścaiva vāmapārśve tu pūrvavatdauvāripāpayakṣmāntāḥ jaṃghāyā dakṣiṇentarenāgādi ṛgaparyantā vāmabāhvau ca saṃsthitāḥete svadhomukhā vāstumūrtideva dvijottamaprāsādavāstu caivaṃ hi vāstu homaṃ tataḥ paramityaṃśumānkāśyape prāsādavāstu lakṣaṇa paṭalaḥ (dvitīyaḥ)harmye tvādyeṣṭakākāle liṃgasaṃsthāpane tathābālaliṃgapratiṣṭhāyāṃ maṇṭape nṛttaraṃgakeācāryalakṣaṇopetaḥ svācāryo homamācaretsthaṇḍilaṃ sikataiḥ kuryāt hastamātrasuvistaramkalaśaṃ vinyasedaindre śālimadhye dvijottamaḥpalāśapatradūrvāṃ ca tajjale ca nidhāpayetagnyādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ agnikāryoktamācaretgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca pūjayetsvasvanāmataḥbrahmavṛkṣasamidbhistu pratyekaṃ homamācaretpāyasenaiva caruṇā pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥindrāhutiṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍaṃ prāyaścittāhutiṃ caretyadasyeti ca maṃtreṇa homayettu ghṛtena tuparistarāṃśca paridhīn ājyenoktānhunet kramātpraṇītatoyaiḥ saṃprokṣya cātmānaṃ pavamānakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: darbhaiḥ palāśa patraiśca śoṣitairbandhayedbudhaḥprākāraṃ gopurasthānaṃ paryagnikaraṇaṃ kurusarvatra prokṣayedvidvān śucī vo havyamaṃtrataḥvāstuhomaṃ samākhyātaṃ svādyeṣṭakavidhiṃ śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape vāstuhomavidhi paṭalaḥ (tṛtīyaḥ)prāsāde maṇṭape sāle gopure ca tathaiva casnigdhaṃ caivā tathā'snigdhaṃ dvividhaṃ bhūmilakṣaṇamyā sā snigdhā mahī khyātā tanuvālukasaṃyutāakleśātkhananīyaṃ tat susnigdhā sa mahī smṛtāhastamātraṃ khanedviprā susnigdhaṃ tu mahītalamavaṭaṃ vālukaiḥ sthūlaiḥ pūrayitvā jalānvitammusalairhastapādaiśca snigdhaṃ kṛtvā bṛhacchilaiḥmānasūtrāṇi sūtrāṇi pātayettatra deśikaḥtṛtīyādhiṣṭhasīmā ca caturthopapīṭhasīmakāevaṃ krameṇa vinyasya sūtraṣaṭkaṃ dvijottamaṣoḍaśastambha saṃyuktaṃ vitānadhvajabhūṣitammaṇṭapasya tribhāgaikaṃ vedikāyāstu vistaramparitastvagnikuṇḍāni mahāśāsu prakalpayethastamātrapravistāraṃ ghātaṃ caiva trimekhalāmpiṣṭacūrṇairalaṃkṛtya tato vai viprabhojanamparyagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prokṣayettu kuśāṃbhasātadardhaistaṃḍulaiścaiva tadardhaiśca tilairapiśilāharmye śilābhistu dārubhirdāruharmyakepuṃliṃgābhiśśilābhistu kārayetprathameṣṭakāmnapuṃsakopalenaiva mūrdheṣṭakāṃ dvijottama !
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathālābhaśilābhirvā bhittistambhādayo(dikaṃ) bhavetaṣṭatriṃśāṃgulā yāvat āyāmaṃ tu kalā bhavetmānāṃgulena kartavyaṃ anyamānaṃ na kārayetekona catvāriṃśāntaṃ bhedabhojāṃgulena tuekādi ṣoḍaśāntānāṃ bhūmīnāṃ kramaśocyateayugmaṃ ṛjurekhā ca puṃliṃgāya prakīrtitāyugmarekhā sayugmaṃ vā karṇikā sā napuṃsakāvarjitāni prayatnena doṣahīnaṃ tu saṃgrahetūrdhvabhāgamukhaṃ khyātaṃ aparaṃ bhūpatāṃśakamprāgudaksthakamaiśānyaṃ śīrṣaṃ vai parikīrtitamgavyairgandhodakaiḥ snāpya pūrvarātrādhivāsayetsarvalakṣaṇasaṃpanno vedācārarataḥ śuciḥnavāmbaradharoṣṇīṣāḥ sottarīyānulepanaḥpaṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇairbhūṣya kṣālayetprathameṣṭakāḥsthaṃḍile karṇikābāhye mahāśāsu nidhāpayetrakāraṃ vāruṇe deśe yakāraṃ saumyagocarepūrvāgraṃ saumya yāmye tu śeṣau dvau cottarāgrakaunavasaṃkhyānavānkuṃbhān sasūtrānvastraveṣṭitānhemapaṃkajasaṃyuktān madhyādikramaśo nyasettattanmantraṃ nyasetkumbhe dhyātvā gandhādibhiryajetagnyādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ agnikāryoktamācaretsamidhassadyamaṃtreṇa mūlenājyaṃ tu homayetsarṣapaṃ kavacenaiva pratyekāṣṭaśatāhutiḥevaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prabhāte deśikottamaḥiṣṭakāḥ kalaśāgniṃ ca pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sviṣṭamagneti maṃtreṇa pūrṇāhutimathācaretmuhūrte samanuprāpte dvāraṃ nītvā'tha deśikaḥiṣṭakāṃ vā śilāṃ vā tu sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥsālānāṃ gopurāṇāṃ ca praveśasya pradakṣiṇeagramagraṃ tathaiśānyāṃ mūlamūlaṃ ca nair-ṛtepaṃcabrahma samuccārya pūrvādikramaśo nyasetpaṃcamṛdbhiḥ samālipya kuṃbhasthādbhiḥ prapūrayetvāmāvarte bhavetsamyak śāntihomaṃ samācaretityaṃśumānkāśyape prathameṣṭakā paṭalaḥ (caturthaḥ)svādhiṣṭhānasamoccaṃ vā tripādaṃ vārdhameva vāpādonadviguṇaṃ vātha dviguṇaṃ vā viśeṣataḥdaśadhābhajyamadhiṣṭhānaṃ ekadvitricatuṣṭayamupapīṭhasya nīrvaṃ tu paṃcadhā parikīrtitamathavāgrapādasadṛśaṃ dviguṇadviguṇaṃ tathāevaṃ hi paṃca bhedaṃ syāt upapīṭhasya nirgamamsabhādīnāṃ tu tadbāhye niṣkrāntaṃ daṇḍamucyateupānaṃ navadhā tīvraṃ adhamāditrayaṃ trayampadmamaṃśena kartavyaṃ ardhāṃśaṃ kampamucyatesārdhāṃśaṃ vājinaṃ kuryāt kampamardhena kārayetkaṃpenāmbujamānaṃ tu yojyaṃ bhadropapīṭhakamupapīṭhasya cotsedhaṃ saptaviṃśatibhājitekampamekāṃśamityuktaṃ dvādaśāṃśaṃ galodayamagnibhāgaṃ kapotoccaṃ maṃśamāliṃ miṣyatevājanaṃ caikabhāgena nāmnā tatpratibhadrakamkampamekena kartavyaṃ ekāntaritaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭāṃśaṃ galamānaṃ tu kampamekena kārayetekena liṃgamānaṃ tu mantaryaṃśena kalpayetsaptaviṃśatibhāge tu nāmnā tatpratisundaramupānaṃ tu dvibhāgena tatsamaṃ tvambujodayammahāpaṭṭī dvibhāgena padmamardhena kārayetbhāgena kampamardhena padmakampe kapotakamupānadvibhāgamardhāṃśaiḥ ambujāṃśena kandharampadmakaṃ sārdhabhāgena kampamardhena kārayetambujaṃ sārdhabhāgena mahāpaṭṭī dvibhāgayāpaṃcapaṃcopapīṭhocca samabhāgadvibhājiteevaṃ ṣaḍaṃgamākhyātaṃ upapīṭhaṃ dvijottama !bhūtaivyālebhasiṃhaiśca makaraiḥ patrajātibhiḥpratyagramakarasyābhā vālārūḍhasamastakamp. 23) upapīṭhaṃ samākhyātaṃ adhiṣṭhānavidhiṃ śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape upapīṭhavidhāna paṭalaḥ (paṃcamaḥ)dharātalamadhiṣṭhānaṃ ādhāraṃ dharaṇī tayāharmyatāraṃ tu kūṭādi nīvrādhiṣṭhānanīvrakamtasmātprakṛti nīvraṃ ca sūtra pātaṃ tu kārayettasmāttu ghanabhittyevaṃ prakṛtyantaṃ prakalpayetdvihastaṃ vā prakṛtyuccaṃ trihastaṃ vā ghanākṛtiḥuttamaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva adhamaṃ ca tathāpi vāevaṃ kṛtvā prakṛtyūrdhve homaṃ saṃkalpya deśikaḥhomanīvramiti khyātaṃ tadardhaṃ bahulānvitamkuḍyapādād bahirnīvra dupapīṭhagalaṃ tu vāhomatuṃgārdhamānena homordhvābjaṃ prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasyoparitvadhiṣṭhānaṃ sopapīṭhānvitaṃ tu vātattadūrdhve dharātalaṃ vātha sopapīṭhamathāpi vāprakṛtīsamasūtre tu kalpayecchilpikottamaḥāptotsedhāṃśamānena tvadhiṣṭhānasya cocchrayamagrapādaviśālaṃ tu daṇḍamityabhidhīyateyāvatā paṃcasaṃkhyā tu agnidaṇḍāvasānakamp. 25) upānavyāsamekāṃśaṃ śeṣaṃ jagati vistaramkumudordhve paṭṭaveśaṃ tatsamaṃ kaṇṭhaveśanamūrdhvapaṭṭamaśeṣaṃ tat samaṃ vā kaṇṭhaveśanammahāvājanniṣkrāntaṃ tuṃgatulyārdhameva vājanmādipaṃcavargeṣu tattadaṃgāvasānakamupānaṃ jagatīṃ caiva kumudaṃ kaṇṭhapaṭṭikādvāraṃ ca jaladhāraṃ ca sthalaṃ ca pratibandhakaiḥpratyaṃgacchedanaṃ cettu vipadāmāspadaṃ sadāadhiṣṭhānaṃ dvidhā jñeyaṃ pratibandhāṃghribandhanamsarveṣāṃ pratibandhānāṃ kumudaṃ vṛttamucyatetayossaṃkaramekasmin kartavye kartṛnāśanamkūṭakoṣṭhādikānāṃ tu kartavyaṃ tacchubhāvahamaśubhaṃ viparītaṃ cet vāstu rāṣṭranṛpasya caadhiṣṭhānasya cotsedhaṃ ekonāviṃśadaṃśakeṣaṭtriṃśaṃ kumudoccaṃ tu āliṃlaṃ caikabhāgayāvājanaṃ caikabhāgena pratibandhamidaṃ bhavetadhiṣṭhānasya cotsedhaṃ paṃcaviṃśatibhājitedhātvaṃśaṃ kumudoccaṃ tu vyomāṃśaṃ kaṃpamānakammahāpaṭṭī guṇāṃśaṃ tu tadūrdhve'ṃśena kampakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śirasā saharudrāṃśaṃ guṇabhāgavibhājitetadadhasthāṃśake vipra lakṣaṇoddhāramācaretdvijānāmabhivṛddhyarthaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca jayāvahamśaṃkhaṃ cāṃkuśayorbhedānnṛpāṇāmabhivṛddhayevaiśyānāṃ tattrikoṇaṃ ca śūlavṛttāyataṃ tathālakṣaṇoddhāraṇoktāṃśaṃ rudrabhāgavibhājitetanmūlanāladīrghaṃ tu navabhāgamudāhṛtamsūtradvitriyutaṃ cettu sūtrāntaraṃ yavatrayamnālamūle ca tasyāgre sīmāsūtraṃ samālikhetsūtrokta vyāsakhātaṃ ca nālayāme tu kalpayetmaṇirekhāṃ tataḥ kuryānmukulādāsphigantakampadmatāra tridhaikaṃ vā vedāṃśe'gnyaṃśameva vāmukulamūlentaraṃ hyevaṃ nālamūlentaraṃ śṛṇutribhāgaṃ paṃcabhāge tu vedabhāgamathoparimūlādagraṃ kramātkṣīṇaṃ maṇirekhāṃ tataḥ kurumaṇirekhāvyāsakhātaṃ liṃgasyocitasūtravattasmāttanmūlaparyantaṃ vasubhāgavibhājitesarveṣu lakṣaṇoddhāreṣvevaṃ vai maṇirekhakelakṣaṇoddhāraṇāṃśaṃ tu daśabhāgavibhājitenālādhastāttu vyomāṃśaṃ nītvā śeṣaṃ tu pūrvavatlakṣaṇoddhārabhāgaṃ tu dharmabhāgavibhājiteśeṣaṃ pūrvavaduddiṣṭaṃ caturthaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇusaptāṃśaṃ nāladīrghaṃ tu śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva hilakṣaṇāṃśaṃ vasudhā bhajya vyomāṃśaṃ mukulodayamtadeva saptabhāgaṃ tu nāladīrghamudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: * * * * * * * * saptamaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇubhūtāṃśaṃ nāladīrghaṃ tu śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva hievamaṣṭavidhaṃ khyātaṃ nālāyāmaṃ dvijottama !yatheṣṭanālakartavyaṃ vasusaṃkhyāsu me dvijasthāpayettu tato liṃgaṃ prāgudagraṃduraṣṭakesthāpitaiḥ kalaśaiḥ snāpya liṃgapīṭhau hṛdā guruḥlambakūrcasamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitamācāryaṃ śilpinaṃ pūjya vastra hemāṃgulīyakaiḥlakṣaṇoddhāramākhyātaṃ pratimālakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape lakṣaṇoddhāravidhipaṭalaḥ (catuḥ paṃcāśaḥ)acalaṃ ca calaṃ caiva calācalamiti tridhāśailajaṃ dārujaṃ caiva dhātujaṃ ratnajaṃ tathāardhacitraṃ ca citraṃ ca citrābhāsamiti tridhāsarvāvayava dṛṣṭaṃ yat taccitraṃ hi vidhīyateardhacitraṃ tu sudhayā cānyaiścitravadardhakamcitraṃ citrārdhamābhāsaṃ phalaṃ śreṣṭhāntarādhamamābhāsādardha citraṃ tu tasmādvai mṛṇmayaṃ varamśailajāllohajaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kartṝṇāṃ ca phalaṃ tathātāmrajaṃ kanyasaṃ khyātaṃ teṣu teṣu phalaṃ tathāsarvadravyeṣu daivatyaṃ samameveti vidyateūṣare sundhabhūmau ca mārdave ca mahītalephalasthalānusāreṇa yathālābhaṃ tathā bhajettathā dravyaphalaṃ tulyaṃ dravyabhede phalapradamyo naraḥ kṛtavānbhūmau putramitrakalatra yukna naśyate tato vipra ! sālodyādi padāśritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asau vittānusāreṇa kartṛlabdhaphalānubhāksukhāsanaṃ tu prathamaṃ umā skandaṃ dvitīyakampaṃcamaṃ nṛttamūrtiṃ ca gaṃgādharamataḥ paramnavamaṃ cārdhanāriṃ ca daśamaṃ gajahāriṇamtrayodaśaṃ harerardhaṃ bhikṣāṭanaṃ caturdaśaṣoḍaśaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtiṃ tataḥ kālārimucyatesarvāsāṃ pratimānāṃ tu mānamādau vadāmyahamgṛhītaṃ vidyamāneṣu anyeṣu śirasā sahapūjāṃśa dviguṇaṃ grāhya dvātriṃśadvibhajetsamamtribhāgādhikaviṃśacca ekaviṃśatireva vārudrāṃśaṃ nandabhāgaṃ vā saptāṃśaṃ paṃca eva vāteṣvekāṃśaṃ samārabhya ekaikāṃśa vivardhanātrudrāṃśocce tu bimboccaṃ sāṣṭatriṃśati bhedakamliṃge bimbocca bhedaṃ tu manvādhikaśataṃ bhavetathavā garbhagehaṃ tu trinnavāṃśavibhājiteathavā garbhagehaṃ tu dvinavāṃśaṃ vibhājiteśuddhadvārasya cotsedhaṃ caturbhāgavibhājiteadhamaṃ tu guṇāṃśaṃ syāt trividhaṃ dvāramānakamnavadhā sa galottuṃgaṃ dvāramāne vidhīyateekaikāṃśavihīnena bimboccaṃ saptaviṃśatiḥtathādhiṣṭhānamāne ca stambhamānavibhājiteekādinavahastāntaṃ navadhā hastamānakamkartuśca hṛdayāntaṃ vā stanāntaṃ bāhusīmakamkartuścodayatulyaṃ vā yajamānavaśādimeekaikāṃśavihīnena navadhā sakalodayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekāṃśamaṃgulaṃ khyātaṃ mūlaliṃgāṃgulānvitamkarturdakṣiṇahaste tu madhyamāṃgulimadhyamesaptāṃgulaṃ samārabhya dvidvyaṃgulavivardhanātbimbamānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ mānau dvābhyāṃ parārthakamkartavyamanyathā cettu kartavye kartṛnāśanamaṃguleṃ gulasaṃkhyābhiśāyādīṣacchubhekṣaṇamaṃgulādanyadyanmānaṃ vedāśīti vibhajya cadvibhāgādhikaṣaṣṭyaṃśaṃ bhajyaikāṃśasamanvitamcaturviṃśati bhāgaṃ tu kṛtvaikāṃśasamanvitamṣoḍaśāṃśeṃśamāropya śūdra-ṛddhikaraṃ bhavetsaptaviṃśatibhirhrāse śeṣamaśvādimaṃ bhavetsuśobhanena yuktaṃ cet kartṛvāstu nṛpādināmśaśyaṃśaṃ ropayedyāvat śubhāyādīni saṃbhavamāyāṃśakamidaṃ khyātaṃ caikāṃśāyādikalpayetśeṣamāyamiti khyātaṃ aṃśamaṣṭaguṇīkṛtamnavabhirguṇite tvaṃśaṃ nāḍibhirhrāsayettataḥvardhayedvasubhirhrāse śeṣaṃ dhvajādayo bhavetvardhayedvedasaṃkhyā tu hrāsayennavasaṃkhyayāāyādhikyaṃ vyayaṃ kṣīṇaṃ puṣkalāyaṃ suśobhanamyonayaścāṣṭa te teṣu teṣu ketuharī vṛṣamvipattiḥ pratyaraṃ caiva varjyaṃ vaināśikaṃ tathākartuśca grāmanakṣatrāt nṛpavāstudinaṃ tathāvāraṃ sūryādi saṃkhyā tu bhaumavāraṃ vivarjayetbhānu vārādi saṃyuktaṃ viśākhādi catuścatuḥtaskaraṃ bhuktiśaktiśca dhanyaṃ rājaṃ ca ṣaṇḍakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: teṣu taskara ṣaṇḍaṃ ca ṛṇaṃ caiva tu varjayetevaṃ parīkṣya śobhāḍhyaṃ āyāmaṃ tu suyojayettasmādubhayabhāgo'pi praśastā veśakāṇḍapāityaṃśumānkāśyape pratimālakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (paṃcapaṃcāśaḥ)mṛṇmayaṃ cettu bimbaṃ vai śūlasthāpanamācaretlohajaṃ sakalaṃ cettu madhūcchiṣṭhena nirmitamkuśāśayaṃ tu saṃkalpya darbhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristaretācāryaḥ śilpakartā ca śuddhamānaṃ parigrahetprākśiraścordhva vaktraṃ tu phalakāyāṃ nidhāpayettasya dakṣiṇa pārśve tu śivāgniṃ tu prakalpayetdravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tu mūlataḥātmanā nijatadrūpaṃ hṛdayaṃ mantramuccaranaṃguṣṭhāgraṃ tu pārṣṇyantatalaṃ saptadaśāṃgulamkorparoccaṃ dvimātraṃ syāt ekaviṃśatprakoṣṭhakamtato vai mukhavistāraṃ sārdhabhānvaṃgulaṃ bhavetgrivāgraṃ sārdhanandāṃśaṃ grīvāmūlaṃ daśāṃgulamsārdhadvāviṃśadaṃśaṃ tu kakṣayorantarastatamekaviṃśati bhāgaṃ syāt stanadeśe tu vistaramkalāṃśaṃ caturyavopetaṃ madhyavyāsamudāhṛtamkaṭiragraviśālaṃ tu trinavāṃgulamucyatepādonamanubhāgaṃ tu ūrumūlaviśālakampādona dharmabhāgaṃ tu jātu vyāsamudāhṛtampādona saptabhāgaṃ tu jaṃghāmadhyaviśālakampādona pakṣabhāgaṃ tu nalakāvistṛtaṃ bhavetakṣādātavatuṃgaṃ tu sārdhavedāṃgulaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: talamadhyaṃ ṣaḍaṃśaṃ syāt yavadvayasamāyutamdviyavādhikavedāṃśaṃ pādāṃguṣṭhāyataṃ bhavettārārdhaghanavistāraṃ pādonāyatavartulampādona vedabhāgaṃ tu madhyāṃgulāyataṃ bhavetsārdhapakṣāṃśamānaṃ tu kaniṣṭhāṃguli dīrghakamyavamānaṃ svatārārdhaṃ nakhaṃ pūrvoktavadviduḥtribhāgamaṃgulāgroccaṃ śeṣaṃ syāttu nakhodayamsa pādasaptabhāgaṃ tu korparavyāsamucyatepādona caturaṃśaṃ tu maṇibandha viśālakamsa pādabhūtabhāgasyānāmikāyāmayucyatesa pādavedabhāgaṃ tu dīrghāṃguṣṭha kaniṣṭhayoḥtarjanyāṣṭa yavā khyātaṃ navayavākhyamadhyamamaṃguṣṭhādyaṃgulāntaṃ tu mūlavistārameva hiagratāraṃ rasāṃśe tu paṃcāṃśaṃ nakhavistṛtamsa pādanakhatāraṃ tu nakhayāmamudāhṛtamaṃguṣṭhaṃ mūlaparvasya dīrghaṃ saptadaśāyavammadhyamāmūlaparvasya dīrghamaṣṭādaśā yavāḥmūlāgraparvayormadhya dīrghamadhyastha parvasusārdhabhūtāṃgulaṃ vipratalāgraṃ vipralaṃbhavettalamūlaviśālaṃ tu sārdhaṣaḍbhāgamucyateaṃguṣṭhamūlamārabhya maṇibandhāvasānakampārṣṇihastavanāgnyaṃśaṃ agramaṃguṣṭhavatkṣayamdvibhāgaṃ pārṣṇihastasya śukodaraviśālakamsūkṣmarekhāṃ likhettasminśaṃkhaṃ vā cakraśūlakamyavākaikartunimnaṃ syāt rekhānāṃ tu dvijottama !
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekāṃśaṃ tu parigrāhya vistāraṃ dviguṇāyatamkarṇordhve śirasā nāhaṃ sāstriṃśāṃgulaṃ bhavetkarṇordhve pūrvabhāgaṃ tu dvāviṃśāṃgulakaṃ bhavettayormadhyastha bhāgaṃ tu karṇayorantarasthitiḥguḍāgrakeśāntaṃ sārdhanavāṃgulamudāhṛtammaṇḍalātpṛṣṭhakeśāntaṃ sārdhadharmāṃgulaṃ bhavetkeśāntā dakṣisūtraṃ syāt dvayormadhye bhruvaḥ sthitiḥdvyantaraṃ tu bhruvorvipra sārdhavedayavaṃ bhavetbālacandrāgravatkṣīṇaṃ bhruvāgrau tasya madhyamamkṛṣṇamaṇḍalavistāraṃ cotsedhaṃ ṣaḍyavaṃ bhavetśabarākṛtikaṃ vāpi dhanurākṛtireva vātadākārānukūloccaṃ sitamaṇḍalayordvija !* * * kṛṣṇa madhye tu jotirmaṇḍalakaṃ yavamtatsārdhayavamānaṃ tu ūrdhvavarmatataṃ bhavetnetrayorantaraṃ vipra ! sa pādadvyaṃgulaṃ bhavetkarturnāśamathodṛṣṭiḥ ūrdhvadṛṣṭirvipatkaramtasmātsarva prayatnena samameva nirīkṣaṇamnāsikāpuṭa bāhye tu tāramaṣṭā daśāyavamgojimūlāttu nāsyagraṃ tuṃgaṃ taddvyaṃgulaṃ bhavetadhyardhayavamālambya nāsāgraṃ puṭasūtrataḥuttaroṣṭhasyordhvanimna gojināmnā praśaṃsitamsa pāda caturaṃśaṃ tu āsyādīrghaṃ tiryagviduḥuttaroṣṭhasya madhye tu tāraṃ sārdhatrayaṃ yavamyavamānaghanaṃ palī uttaroṣṭhasya copariaṣṭādaśayavā proktā adharoṣṭhasya dīrghakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adharaṃ pālikā sārdha yavamānamathocyatekiṃcitprahasitākāraṃ āsya yuktānukārayetcibukāttu hanorvaṃśaṃ sārdhāṣṭayavamucyatehanoḥ sandhyaikarṇabandhāntaṃ tvantaraṃ dvādaśāṃgulamkarṇaveśamiti khyātaṃ tataḥ karṇaṃ vadāmitekarṇasya tu viśālaṃ tu aṣṭādaśa yavāḥ smṛtāḥtadardhaṃ cordhvabandhā tu śeṣaṃ vṛttamamūrdhvataḥsārdhavedāṃgulaṃ tasmāt tasya nālaṃ pralambayetnālayorvyāsamākhyātaṃ ghanamardhāṃgulaṃ tayoḥkarṇatuṃgamaśeṣaṃ tu yavaikona navāṃgulamutsedhaṃ sārdhamātraṃ syāt mūlādagraṃ kṣayānugamakṣasūtrādayaḥ karṇadvāramardhāṃgulaṃ bhavetkarṇapālīghanaṃ sārdhayavanīvaṃ caturyavamkeśāntāt pṛṣṭhakarṇaṃ tu dvyantaṃ dvyardhamātrakamtasyādhaḥ pṛṣṭhadīrghoccaṃ yugāṃśaṃ triyavādhikampṛṣṭhagrīvasya mūlasya tāraṃ sārdhadaśāṃgulamhikkāsūtropari skandhasaṃdhītuṃgaṃ yugāṃgulamsaptāṃgulaghanaṃ skandhaṃ hikkāvadhi kramātkṣayamtasmādā kaṭisaṃdhānta vaśamṛkṣāṃśamāyatamvaṃśamānādadhastāttu vaṃśamūlaṃ guṇāṃgulamsārdha ṛkṣāṃgulaṃ proktaṃ kakṣayorantaraṃ dvija !kakṣordhve bāhusīmāntaṃ saptāṃgulamudāhṛtamnābhisūtre tu vistāraṃ sārdhaviṃśāṃgulaṃ bhavetpādona dharmabhāgaṃ tu sphik piṇḍaṃ prativistṛtamapare tāramevoktaṃ pārśvavyāsamathocyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa pādaṣoḍaśamātraṃ syāt stana sūtre tu vistṛtamśroṇī madhyaghanaṃ pārśve saptadaśāṃgulaṃ bhavetnābhisūtrādadhaścordhve caturthaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ hi tattatkaṭestu ghanaṃ dhīmān sārdhabhānvaṃgulaṃ bhavettatpiṇḍālambanaṃ cārdha sūtrāndādhogāṃgulamkakṣāgradharanimnaṃ tu sārdhadvyaṃgulakaṃ bhavetkarṇamūlena tattāraṃ tuṃgaṃ caiva caturyavamhikkāmadhyāttu kakṣāntaṃ bhānvaṃśātpādahīnakamhṛdāyastanayormadhye nimnamadhyardhamātrakamtasyārdhaṃ vā samāvṛttaṃ kalpayettu tripuṇḍyavathikkāsūtropariṣṭhāttu nīlakarṇaṃ prakalpayetsaptādaśayavā khyātaṃ stanamaṇḍalavistṛtamnābhestu natavistāraṃ vyomāṃśaṃ dviyavādhikamtannābhyavaṭamadhyasthaṃ nābhisūtraṃ dvijottama !tadadhastātkaṭiśroṇī sārdhatryaṃgulakaṃ bhavetsa pādapaṃcamātraṃ tu liṃgadīrghamudāhṛtamliṃgāyāmatribhāgaikamagra maṇḍyā yavaṃ bhavetraktotpalamukulābhaṃ agramaṇḍyāgramucyateghanaṃ sārdhaguṇāṃśaṃ tu tanmūlordhvo'grabandhanammeḍhrapīṭhasya mūlāntaṃ ūrumūlasya māṃsalamsārdhatryaṃgulakaṃ proktaṃ jānumaṇḍalanīvrakammadhye tu pāśvayoḥ śeṣaṃ yathā saundaryamācaretityaṃśumānkāśyape uttamadaśatālavidhipaṭalaḥ (ṣaṭpaṃcāśaḥ)umāsarasvatīdurgā uṣā bhūṣiśca mātaraḥīśo brahmā tathā viṣṇuśaktirityabhidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaṃbhornāsāgrasīmāntaṃ śaktyuccaṃ hyuttamottamamtayormadhye'ṣṭabhāge tu navadhā śaktimānakamtayormadhye'ṣṭabhāge tu navadhā śaktimānakamtasmājjātyaṃśamāyāṃśaṃ yojayetkramamicchatāmdevyuccaṃ samapādasya sthānakaṃ syaiva yuktitaḥmānakalpe tu liṃgānāṃ mānaiḥ saṃkalpya deśikaḥsa viṃśatiśataṃ bhāgaṃ strīmāne tu vibhājitetadaṃgulairyavaiścaiva cāṃgamānaṃ pramīyateuṣṇīṣodayamekāṃśaṃ keśāntaṃ tu guṇāṃgulamakṣisūtrātpuṭāntaṃ tu sārdhavedāṃgulaṃ bhavettasyādhaḥ kaṇṭhamānaṃ tu caturbhāgamudāhṛtamnābhyāśca yoniparyantaṃ samaṃ trayodaśāṃgulamūrudīrgha samaṃ jaṃghā dīrghaṃ pādatalaṃ yugamtarjanyāṃguṣṭhayordīrghaṃ caturbhāgamudāhṛtamsārdhadvibhāgamānaṃ tu kaniṣṭhāṃgulidīrghakamaṃguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ caraṇāṃguli vistṛtamaṃgulīnāṃ mukhoccaṃ tu nakhavyāsasamaṃ bhavetmadhye paṃcāṃgulaṃ pārṣṇiḥ vistāraṃ caturaṃgulamnalakātatiyedāṃśaṃ jaṃghāmadhyaṃ rasāṃgulambhānudviguṇabhāgaṃ tu vistāraṃ kaṭisaṃdhayoḥyonitāraṃ caturbhāgaṃ adhogāśvatthapatravatśroṇi sthāne tu vistāraṃ sa yavaṃ viṃśadaṃgulammadhyamasya viśālaṃ tu rudrāṃgulamudāhṛtamstanatāraṃ navāṃśaṃ syāt guṇāṃśaṃ stana cūcukamstanākṣaṃ ca stanaṃ caiva vṛttaṃ kṛtvāti sundaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 27) etacca pādabandhaṃ ca nānābhedena kīrtitamambujaṃ sārdhabhāgaṃ syāt kampamardhāṃśamucyateāliṃgamekabhāgena tripaṭṭaṃ caikabhāgayāpratikramamidaṃ nāmnā pratibandhaṃ tu bheditamāliṃgoccaṃ dvibhāgena śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva hitaduccaṃ pratikramaṃ khyātaṃ sarvadevālayāvahamdvibhāgena dalaṃ kuryāt kampamekena kārayetkaṇṭhamekena kartavyaṃ kaṇṭhoccaṃ taddvibhāgayāmahāpaṭṭī dvibhāgena dalamekāṃśamānataḥaṃbhojakesaraṃ khyātaṃ pādabandhe tu bheditamupānamekabhāgena padmoccamanalāṃśakamambujaṃ cārdhabhāgena galamardhāṃśamānataḥpadmamardhāṃśamānena tatsamaṃ kampamucyatepadmamardhena kartavyaṃ paṭṭikā sārdhabhāgayāpuṣpapuṣkalamākhyātaṃ pādabandhe tu bheditamupānaṃ caikabhāgaṃ syāt saptāṃśaṃ kamalocchrayamkumudoccaṃ caturbhāgaṃ ekāṃśaṃ galamucyateekenakampamekena ūrdhve padmaṃ prakalpayetekenāntaritaṃ kuryāt pratituṃgaṃ dvibhāgayāpratibandhe tu bhedaṃ syāt śrībandhāntaritāddhṛtamupānaṃ caikabhāgena jagatyuccaṃ rasāṃśakamgalāṃśaṃ guṇamānaṃ tu kampamekena kārayetāliṃgamekabhāgena antarītaṃ tu kalpayetpratibandhasya vargasya maṃcabandhamudāhṛtamkalyaṃ śrīkāntakaṃ nāmnā pādabandhe tu bheditaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kakṣayorantaraṃ vipra saptādaśāṃgulaṃ smṛtamhikkāsūtrādadho bāhudīrghaṃ ṣaḍviṃśadaṃgulammaṇibandhāttalāyāmaṃ saptāṃgulamudāhṛtamanāmikā tarjanītulyaṃ bhāgāṃguṣṭhakaniṣṭhayoḥnavasaptāṣṭasaptaṃ tu yavāṃguṣṭhādi vistṛtamyavadvayādhikaṃ tārāt nakhāyāmaṃ tu tīkṣaṇavatmaṇibandhaviśālāgni bhūtāṃśaṃ korparasya tutasmāttanmaṇibandhāntaṃ taruṇaṃ veṇuvatkṛśamagre mūle tu vistāraṃ ṣaḍaṃśaṃ syādyavādhikambhrūkeśāntayormadhyaṃ sārdhadvyaṃgulakaṃ bhavetpuṭadāsyāvasāaṃ tu sa yavaikāṃgulaṃ bhavetadharaṃ sa yavāṃgulyaṃ śeṣaṃ hanvantamānakamdvibhāgaṃ karṇavistāraṃ sa pādaṃ caturaṃśakamdvibhāgaṃ karṇavistāraṃ sa pādaṃ caturaṃśakamnālālambaṃ tu paṃcāṃśaṃ karṇabandhanasaṃyutamśeṣamuttamatāloktamārgeṇaiva samācaretgaurī vai dvibhujā śāntā prasannavadanāmbujāmakuṭaṃ keśabandhaṃ vā teṣu tatsundaraṃ kuruekaviṃśāṃgulaṃ madhyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhānudvayāṃgulammūlaṃ saptāṣṭadhā bhajya bhāgonāgraviśālakammūlādagraṃ kramātkṣīṇaṃ karaṇḍamakuṭasya tutripaṃcasaptanandairvā karaṇḍaistu virājitamlalāṭapaṭṭasaṃyuktaṃ muktādāmalakākṛtiḥmakaraṃ kuṇḍalaṃ vātha vṛttakuṇḍalameva vābāhupūrimasaṃyuktaṃ channavīrasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dukūlavasanā devī śyāmavarṇāṃgasundarīābhaṃge tu guṇāṃśaṃ tu vedāṃśaṃ samabhaṃgakelalāṭamadhyādvāme tu netrānte ca puṭāntakenābherdakṣiṇapārśve tu vāmorurdakṣiṇaṃ spṛśetpādāṃguṣṭhadvayoścaiva dvantaraṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgulamevamābhaṃgamākhyātaṃ samabhaṃgamatha śṛṇuprasārya brahmasūtraṃ tu dvantaraṃ tu vadāmyahamtatsūtrāddakṣiṇe nābhe nīvrakaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ bhavettatsūtrādvāmato jānu nīvraṃ guṇāṃgulaṃ bhavettattribhāgaikabhāgaṃ tu pāṣṇyau dvantaramiṣyatenābhestu maṇibandhāntaṃ sārdhatrayodaśāṃgulamkaṭisaṃdhaistu vedāṃ(śaṃ) lambahastasya korparamūrvāgrāttatkarāgrāntaṃ daśāṃgulamudāhṛtamsusthitaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu dakṣiṇaṃ kuṃcitaṃ bhavetprasārya brahmasūtraṃ tu dvantaraṃ tu pramīyatetatsūtrādvāmato nābhi nīvraṃ dvyaṃgulakaṃ bhavettatsūtrāddakṣiṇe jānu nīvraṃ guṇāṃgulaṃ bhavetsarasvatyādi śaktīnāṃ prāgeva procyate'thavācandrādityāśvinī caiva ṛṣayaśca grahastathākanyasaṃ daśatālena kārayettu vicakṣaṇaḥkeśāntāddhanu paryantaṃ sārdhabhānvaṃgulaṃ bhavethikkādistanasūtrāntaṃ sārdhabhānvaṃgulaṃ bhavetvāmestu meḍhramūlāntaṃ sārdhadvādaśamātrakamvedāṃgulaṃ tu jānu syāt jaṃghāsamorusādṛśamuṣṇīṣātpṛṣṭhakeśāntaṃ sārdhabhānvaṃgulaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uṣṇīṣātpūrvakeśāntaṃ paṃcāṃgulamudāhṛtamkeśāntādakṣisūtrāntaṃ vyomāṃśamiti vidyateyavopetadvimātraṃ tu netrayorantaraṃ dvija !bhrūmadhyādūrdhvakeśāntaṃ saptādaśa yavastathāṣaḍaṃśaṃ netra vistāraṃ ūrdhvavarma yavārdhakamnetrāyāmaṃ tridhā kṛtvā ekāṃśaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamyūkamānena dṛṣṭiḥ syāt jyotirmaṇḍalamadhyametasya keśāntayormadhye bhrūsthitirvārdhacandravatghrāṇamūlasya vistāraṃ yavamatramudāhṛtamadharoṣṭhasya cāyāmaṃ pakṣāṃgulamudāhṛtamvistāraṃ tatsamaṃ vidyāt nimnamardhayavaṃ bhavetgrīvāmūlaviśālaṃ tu vasvaṃgulamudāhṛtamvakṣaḥsthalasya vistāraṃ saptatriṃśatimātrakamtasmādadhara niṣṭhāntaṃ sa yavaṃ vyomamātrakamāyāmaṃ tu prakoṣṭhasya ekona viṃśadaṃgulamtadardhaṃ tu talāyāmaṃ śeṣaṃ madhyāṃgulaṃ padamsārdhavedāṃgulaṃ proktaṃ anāmikāyāstu dairghyakamdharmābdhivasu ṣaḍbhūta yavāṃguṣṭhādi vistṛtamagravyāse tu bhūtāṃśaṃ vedāṃśaṃ na vistṛtamaṃguṣṭhaṃ tu dviparva syāt anyāṃgulyaḥ striparvakāḥtalamūlapradeśasya ghanaṃ kolakamadhyametalāyāmasamaṃ caiva talasyaiva tu vistṛtamprakoṣṭhamūlavistāraṃ sārdhabhūtāṃśamucyatebāhumadhyaviśālaṃ tu saptāṃgulamudāhṛtamhikkāsūtrāttu kakṣāntaṃ aṣṭamātramudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdayāvadhivistāraṃ aṣṭādaśāṃgulaṃ bhavetśroṇī pradeśavistāraṃ aṣṭādaśāṃgulaṃ bhavetstanamaṇḍalavistāraṃ ardhāṃgulamudāhṛtamubhayostanayorantaḥ sārdhadvādaśamātrakamliṃgaṃ paṃcāṃgulaṃ dairghyaṃ utpalaṃ mukulopamamūrumūlaviśālaṃ tu sārdhadvādaśamātrakamjaṃghāmūlaviśālaṃ tu sārdhaṣaṇmātramucyateaṃghritalāgravistāraṃ kauśikāṃgulamucyatepādāṃguṣṭhasamāyāmaṃ caturmātramudāhṛtamanāmikāyā dīrghaṃ tu trayastriṃśadyavaṃ bhavetkaniṣṭhikāyā dīrghaṃ tu sārdhavahnyaṃgulaṃ bhavetkaniṣṭhādyaṃgulīnāṃ tu vistāraṃ pravidhīyatedvibhāgaṃ nakhavistāraṃ tattulyāyatavartulamkaniṣṭhikāyā mūle tu ghanaṃ tattriyavaṃ bhavetpṛṣṭhamaṇḍalavistāraṃ pādona navamātrakamkakṣayorantaraṃ pṛṣṭhe caturviṃśati mātrakamevaṃ lakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ teṣāmākṛtipūrvavatityaṃśumānkāśyape adhamadaśatālavidhipaṭalaḥ (aṣṭapaṃcāśaḥ)vasavaścāṣṭamūrtiśca vidyeśā lokapālakāḥsadvādaśaśatāṃśaṃ tu beramānavibhājitekeśāntādakṣi sūtrāntaṃ vedamātraṃ vidhīyatepuṭādyāddhanuparyantaṃ vedāṃśaṃ pravidhīyatehṛdayānnābhisīmāntaṃ tāvadvādaśa mātrakamūrudīrghaṃ caturviṃśat daśajānu yugāṃśakamhikkādho bāhudīrghaṃ tu caturviṃśati bhāgayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tanmadhyāṃgulamāyāmaṃ ṣaḍaṃgulamudāhṛtamtasmādyeva yavārdhaṃ hi aṃgaṃ pratyenamācaretityaṃśumānkāśyape uttamanavatālavidhipaṭalaḥ (ekonaṣaṣṭhitamaḥ)yakṣāpsarogaṇāścaiva astramūrtimarudgaṇāḥaṣṭottaraśatāṃgulyaṃ patimoccaṃ vibhājitekeśāntānnetrasūtrāntaṃ yugāṃśaṃ tadyavonakampādona caturaṃśaṃ tu grīvamānamudāhṛtamvābhyantaṃ caiva tattulyaṃ meḍhramūlāntakaṃ tathājānugrīvasamaṃ tuṃgaṃ jaṃghā corusamaṃ bhavetsaptadaśāṃgulaṃ proktaṃ prakoṣṭhasya tu dairghyakamtatsamaṃ madhyamāyāmaṃ śeṣaṃ yuktyā samācaretityaṃśumānkāśyape madhyamanavatālavidhipaṭalaḥ (ṣaṣṭhitamaḥ)vidyādharagaṇāścaiva tvasurāśca tathaiva casa vedaśatabhāgaṃ tu kautukoccaṃ vibhājite.* * * * * * * * * * hṛdayāntakamūrudīrghaṃ trayoviṃśat yavonaṃ tu vidhīyatebāhucorusamaṃ dīrghaṃ prakoṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgulamśeṣaṃ yuktyā tu kartavyaṃ sarvāṃgaṃ tu vidhīyateityaṃśumānkāśyape adhamanavatālavidhipaṭalaḥ (ekaṣaṣṭitamaḥ)śatāṃśamadhyabimboccaṃ kṛtvoṣṇīṣaṃ śivāṃśakampādonarudrabhāgaṃ syāt tattribhāgaṃ vibhājitepuṭāntāddhanvantakaṃ śeṣaṃ sārdhāgnyaṃśaṃ galodayamnābhyantaṃ caiva tattulyaṃ meḍhramūlāntakaṃ tathājānukarṇasamaṃ tuṃgaṃ jaṃghācorusamā bhavetprakoṣṭhaṃ tu kalāṃśaṃ syāt sārdhabhūtāṃgulaṃ talam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tripaṃcamātramityuktaṃ pādasya tu talāyatamityaṃśumānkāśyape aṣṭatālavidhipaṭalaḥ (dvāṣaṣṭhitamaḥ)piśācapratimotsedhaṃ aṣṭāśītyaṃśakaṃ bhavetsārdhadvyaṃśaṃ tu netrāntaṃ sārdhāgnyaṃśaṃ puṭāntakamstanāntaṃ saptabhāgaṃ tu rudrāṃśaṃ nābhisīmakamjānumānaṃ dvibhāgena jaṃghā corusamā bhavetūrudīrghasamaṃ bāhuprakoṣṭhadīrghaṃ tripaṃcakamtalāyāmasadṛśaṃ madhyamāṃguli dīrghakamsaptatālaṃ samākhyātaṃ śeṣaṃ prāgaparoditamityaṃśumānkāśyape saptatālavidhipaṭalaḥ (triṣaṣṭhitamaḥ)ārjavaṃ rājasaṃ bhāvaṃ bhadrapīṭhe sukhāsanamūrdhvakāyopariṣṭāttu sārdhavedāṃgulādhikamāsanātpūrvakeśāntaṃ jānvordhve bāhyāvasānakamparahastadvayormadhye bāhyamabhyantaraṃ bhavetmaulimadhye tu nāsāgre stanānte nābhimadhyamesūtrāddakṣiṇajānvantaṃ ekatriṃśāṃgulaṃ bhavetsūtrātadaṃghrinalakāt antaraṃ dvādaśāṃgulampīṭhāttadaṃghripārṣṇyostu nīvraṃ dvitryaṃgulaṃ tu vācaturdaśāṃgulaṃ proktaṃ tvantaraṃ tu dvijottama !tatsūtrātkaṭake haste maṇibandhasya madhyamātūrostu maṇi bandhāntaṃ ekadvitryaṃgulaṃ tu vātarjanyādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ tattanmūlāntavarji(kri?)tāmadhyānmadhyatalāntaṃ tu ardhamardhāntanāmikāhikkāsūtrasamaṃ kuryāt kartaryāgre karau paraukiṃcidvakraṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ tu śeṣo dvau tadṛju kriyā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: korparaṃ śroṇi pārśvāttu paṃcaṣaṭsaptamātrakammeḍhramūlāttu vāmāṃghri gulphamadhyaṃ rasāṃgulamnābhimadhyāttu vāmāṃghrinalakā madhyaṃ caturdaśamaulyagraṃ madhyamātsūtrāt dvantaraṃ manu mātrakamṛjvāgataṃ sukhāsīnaṃ pravālasadṛśaṃ prabhumvyāghrājināmbaradharaṃ dukūlavasanānvitamdakṣiṇe paraśuṃ vāme kṛṣṇaṃ nyasya karadvayevāmakarṇe viśeṣeṇa śaṃkhapatraṃ nidhāpayetkarṇanālaghanaṃ hyevaṃ triguṇaṃ patravistṛtamdakṣiṇe makarākhyaṃ tu kuṇḍalaṃ siṃhameva vāyuktaṃ vai kuṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā karṇe skandhoparinyasetvṛttakuṇḍalavistāraṃ aṣṭādaśayavaṃ bhavetanyaṃ vā sundaropetaṃ kalpayedvṛttakuṇḍalammakuṭasyodayaṃ vipra ! caturviṃśāṃgulaṃ bhavetkeśāntānmakuṭoccaṃ tu lalāṭapaṭṭasaṃyutamtatsaptāṣṭa navāṃśaikaṃ hīnamagraviśālakamkaṭisūtraṃ trisaṃkhyābhiḥ sūtraṃ pratiyavaṃ ghanampaṃcaṣaṭsaptamātraṃ vā kṛttimānanavistṛtamkaṭisūtrādūrumānaṃ madhyatriṃśāvasānakamkaṭisūtraṃ samākhyātaṃ kaṭakaṃ valayaṃ śṛṇukaniṣṭhāṃguliparīṇāhaṃ valayaṃ tvārdavā hi tatracitaṃ ratnakāṇḍaistu prakoṣṭhe tu nidhāpayetkeyūraṃ korpare nyastvā valayasya ghanānvitamnānāratnasamāyuktaṃ śaivālābhamathāpi vāpatrapūrimanālaṃ tu keyūrasadṛśaṃ ghanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tricatuṣpaṃcamātraṃ vā patrapūrimavistṛtamdviguṇaṃ vāpi tattuṃgaṃ tadbāhuvalayaṃ bhavetmudrikā mūlaparvastha vṛttaṃ yavaghanānvitamyavaṃ dviyavaṃ vātha udarabandhaghanaṃ bhavetnābherūrdhvaguṇāṃśaṃ tu tyaktodaraṃ tu bandhayetyavadvayena sarve * vyaṃgulānāṃ tu madhyakājālakābandhasūtraṃ tu yavadvayaghanānvitamtriyavaṃ jālakānnālaṃ śeṣaṃ vai jālakodayamśeṣaṃ tadghrāsagāḍhaṃ vā gāḍhahīnaṃ ghanaṃ tu vāghanapāṣāṇarahitaṃ tuṃgārdhaṃ nīvramucyateparaśuṃ hariṇīṃ caiva yuktyā saundaryamācaretupavītaṃ tritrisūtraṃ udarasūtrasamanvitamvāmaskandhoparinyastvā nābhyadhastāṃgulāntaramapare vaṃśamāśritya yajñasūtraṃ nidhāpayetyajñopavītamevaṃ syāt channavīramatha śṛṇupārśvayoścaiva śroṇyūrdhve nyastvā stanāntaraikavatlambya vedāṃgulaṃ tāraṃ yavatraya ghanānvitamhikkāsūtropariṣṭāttu upagrīvaṃ tu bandhayetupagrīvamidaṃ khyātaṃ hṛnmālātvadhunocyateetaddhṛdayamālā syāt skandhamālā tathocyatesarvāṃgasundaraṃ devaṃ śeṣaṃ yuktyā samācaretityaṃśumānkāśyape sukhāsanamūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (catuṣṣaṭitamaḥ)sukhāsanaṃ yathā proktaṃ tathā devo vidhīyateśāyayeddakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmapādaṃ pralambayetūrdhvakāyasamāyuktaṃ āsanoparikalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varadaṃ vāmahastaṃ tu utpalaṃ dakṣiṇe karevaradaṃ cāti vikhyātaṃ puṣpadhṛtsiṃhakarṇavatraktāmbaradharā devī channavīrasamanvitāvāmoru bāhyapīṭhāttu vāmahaste tale nyasetpīṭhāttu dakṣiṇaṃ jānuṃ kiṃciduddhṛtasaṃyutamṣaṭsaptāṣṭāṃgulaṃ vātha pīṭhājjānvantaraṃ bhavetstrīmānasyoktamārgeṇa devīmānaṃ tu gṛhyatāmāsane cāsanaṃ khyātaṃ viparītaṃ vipatkaramdevī deveśayormadhye sthāpayetskandamūrtinamstanākṣāntaṃ kaniṣṭha syāttayormadhye'ṣṭabhājitejātyaṃśakayutaṃ vāpi hīnaṃ vāpi prakalpayetekāṃśamaṃgulaṃ khyātaṃ tadaṣṭāṃśaṃ yavaṃ bhavetdvibhāgaṃ netrasūtrāntaṃ puṭāntaṃ caiva tatsamamhikkāsūtrātstanāntaṃ tu navabhāgamudāhṛtamvāmestu meḍhramūlāntaṃ saptabhāgamiti smṛtamjaṃghādīrghorutattulyaṃ madhyaṃ pādatalānvitamkoṣṭhāyāmaṃ daśāṃśaṃ tu talaṃ vedāṃgulāyatamtatsamaṃ tarjanī dīrghaṃ kaniṣṭhoccaṃ guṇāṃgulamprakoṣṭhāgraṃ guṇāṃśaṃ tu tanmūlaṃ caturaṃgulamsārdhāṣṭāṃśaṃ mukha vyāsaṃ saptāṃśaṃ karṇavistṛtambhānvaṃśaṃ hṛdayavistāraṃ rudrāṃśaṃ madhyavistṛtamurumūlaviśālaṃ tu vasvaṃgulamudāhṛtamguṇāṃśaṃ nalakātāraṃ ṣaḍaṃśaṃ talavistṛtamkeśānte vāsikopetaṃ karaṇḍamakuṭānvitamkaṭakaṃ vātha taddhaste siṃhakarṇamathāpi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kaṭisūtrayutaṃ nagnaṃ channavīrasamanvitamāsīno vā sthito vātha nṛttaṃ vā skandamācaretsthite pādatalau dvau tu samabhaṃgamiva sthitaunṛttaṃ cetsusthitaṃ savyapādaṃ vakrasamanvitamṣaṇmātramathavā paṃcamātrāntaṃ vā samuddharetathavā vāmahastaṃ tu phalaṃ nyastvā prasārayetdvantaraṃ lambasūtraṃ ca nṛttamūrtivadācaretkevalaṃ gaurīsahitaṃ āliṃgaṃ trividhaṃ bhavetāliṃgamekahastena devo devī parasparamkevalaṃ samapādaṃ tu sthānakaṃ sahitaṃ tu vākevalaṃ muktidaṃ khyātaṃ sahajaṃ hyubhayapradamteṣvādau samapādaṃ tu sthānakaṃ śṛṇu suvrata !lambamānopamānaṃ ca tvadhunā vakṣyate kramātaṣṭādaśāṃgulaṃ tāraṃ sārdhaṃ vā dvyaṃgulaṃ ghanamṛkṣāṃgulasamāyuktaṃ sthāpayetsamabhūtalepūrve pare ca pārśve ca mānasūtraṃ prasārayetsūtrasyānuguṇaṃ bimbaṃ kārayed dvijasattama !etāni paṃcasūtrāṇi brahmasūtramudāhṛtamevaṃ hi navasūtrāḍhyaṃ sthānakaṃ cāsamantathānāsāgra madhyame caiva hanormadhye tathaiva caliṃgamadhyorumadhyāttu pādayośca talāntaremakuṭasya madhyamāccakṛkaṭīkāyāṃ tu madhyamātūrujānvośca jaṃghāntaṃ pārṣṇidvayontare tathāpārśvayoḥ karṇapālyantāt grīvāmadhyāttathaiva cadehamadhyagate naiva paṃcasūtraṃ pralambayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvibhāgaṃ galamānaṃ tu kampoccaṃ śaśibhāgayākampamekena kartavyaṃ kaṇṭhoccaṃ tu dvibhāgayāvājanaṃ * * * * * dvibhāgaṃ kaṇṭhamucyatekampamardhena kartavyaṃ śroṇībandhamidaṃ paramtriṣṣaḍaṃgaṃ talotsedhaṃ kṛtvā sārdhāṃśa pādukamgalamekena kartavyaṃ padmamekena kārayetāliṃgamekabhāgena tvantarītatsamaṃ bhavetabjabandhamidaṃ nāmnā bhedaṃ tatpratibandhakeabjamekena kampaṃ tu tvekāṃśena prakalpayetpadmamekena kartavyaṃ kampamekena kārayetśivāṃśaṃ dalamānaṃ tu mahāpaṭṭīdvibhāgayāpādabandhasya vargasya sarvadhāmasu pūjitamkapotoparikampordhve tripaṭṭaṃ caikabhāgayātuṃge ṣaḍviṃśadaṃśe tu kalpaṃ tatpratisundaramupānamekabhāgena padmamekena kampakamdvyaṃśena paṭṭikāṃ vidyāt kampamekena kalpayetekāṃśenāmbujaṃ kuryāt guṇāṃśaṃ kumudodayamtripaṭṭaṃ śivabhāgena dvibhāgaṃ pratimānakampratibandhe tu bhedaṃ syāt śrīkaṇṭhaṃ tadudāhṛtamkaṇṭhaṃ dvibhāgamaṃśena kampaṃ dvyaṃśena paṭṭikākumudaṃ tu triyaṃśena padmamekāṃśamānataḥdvibhāgena pratiṃ kuryād vājanaṃ caika bhāgayāetatkarīrabandhaṃ syāt pratibandhe tu bheditamkampamekena kartavyaṃ kaṇṭhamānaṃ dvibhāgayādvibhāgaṃ galamānaṃ tu galamekāṃśamānataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādamadhyapradeśinyāṃ madhyame tu pralambayetakṣamadhye kaṭī pārśve madhye caiva tu lambayetaparasūtrāttu maulyagraṃ madhyaṃ ṣaṇmātramucyateaparasūtrācchiraḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ pādonaṃ tu yugāṃgulamkṛkāṭikāparasūtraṃ tu yavonāgnyaṃgulāntaramkakuthoparasūtrā tu ṣoḍaśaṃ tu yavāntaramkakunmadhyātparasūtrādyantaraṃ manuyavārdhakamvaṃśanimnāparaṃ sūtraṃ pādona dvyaṃśakāntaramnābhisūtrasame pṛṣṭhe sārdhapakṣāṃgulaṃ bhavettatsame tvapare sūtrāt antaraṃ sārdhamātrakamjaṃghāmadhye ca nalakā madhye caiva purogatamtattatsthāne pare caiva tiryak sūtraṃ prakalpayettatraivāparasūtrāntaṃ yavona caturaṃgulamtatraiva parasūtrāntāt pādo na paṃcamātrakamtatraivāparasūtrāntaṃ ṣaḍviṃśati yavaṃ bhavetnalakāparasūtrāntaṃ pādona paṃcamātrakamtatsūtrātpārṣṇiparyantaṃ sārdhamanvaṃśamiṣyatetatkāyamadhyasūtrāttu śiraḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ yugārdhakamuromadhyapradeśe tu pṛṣṭhe sārdha ṣaḍaṃgulamnābhipradeśe pṛṣṭhe tu sārdhabhūtāṃgulaṃ bhavetūrumadhyāparaṃ vedajānu pṛṣṭhaṃ tathaiva capārśvasūtrau ca madhyasthaṃ samasūtre tu saṃsthitāḥtatsūtrādapare bāhu paryantaṃ vasumātrakamtatkare bāhyavistṛtau caturaṃgulamiṣyatemadhyāṃgulāgramubhayostanasūtrasamaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāksūtrādabhaye haste madhyaṃ paṃcadaśāṃgulamtalamūlaṃ kaṭiṃ spṛṣṭvā meḍhrāntaṃ tu ca tatkareūrdhvavaktraṃ tu varadāt pṛṣṭhanābhisameḍhrakamkartarī maṇibandhāstu bāhu bāhyamukhaṃ bhavetkorparāt pūrvasūtrāntaṃ rasasaptadaśāṃgulamūrumūlād dvayorantaḥ ekāṃgulamudāhṛtamjānvantaraṃ caturmātraṃ jaṃghayoḥ paṃcamātrakampārṣṇyantaraṃ caturmātraṃ rasāṃśaṃ pādatalāntaramārjavaṃ rājasaṃbhāvaṃ kalpyevaṃ dvijasattama !* * * * * * * * dakṣiṇe'rdhenduśekharetrinetraṃ saumyavadanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamubhayoḥ pārśvayorevaṃ ambaraṃ ūrumadhyagamtadgaurī sahitaṃ khyātaṃ bhinnapīṭhaika eva vādevo varadahastena devīṃ bāhya parāśritāmpārśvasūtrātpare vāmabāhumāliṃganaṃ tu vākaṭisūtropari spṛṣṭvā puṣpaṃ vāmakaroddhṛtamraktotpalaṃ parigrāhya vāmahastaṃ pralambitamsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalasaṃyutamābhaṃgaṃ samabhaṃgaṃ vā kalpayetkalpavittamaḥuṣṇīṣamadhyamādvāme lalāṭādvāmake tathādakṣiṇe stanapīṭhasya vāme nābheśca madhyameevaṃ tu samabhaṃgaṃ syāt na ta mānaṃ yugāṃgulamnābhervāme guṇāṃśe tu vāmorormadhyame tathāati bhaṃgamidaṃ khyātaṃ na taṃ paṃcāṃgulaṃ bhavethikkāsūtrādadho vipra ! kalā vā dvinavāṃgulam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛṣabhasyodayaṃ khyātaṃ vṛṣaṃ lakṣaṇavatkṛtamnābhisūtrasamaṃ kuryādaṃgulaṃ vā natonnatamadhomukhaṃ prakartavyaṃ taddhastaṃ tu prasārayetpakṣaṣoḍaśamātraṃ vā nataṃ tatsiṃhakarṇavatsthitāṃghrijānūrdhva sīmāntaṃ hikkāsūtrāntamunnatamlohajaṃ dārujaṃ vātha vakradaṇḍaṃ tu kārayetpaṃcaṣaṭsaptamātraṃ vā vasunandāṃgulaṃ tu vāṭaṃkaṃ dakṣiṇahaste tu vāmahaste mṛgaṃ bhavetekadvitricatuṣpaṃcamātraṃ vātha nataṃ tu vājaṭābandhadharo vāpi karturicchāvaśānnayetvāmapārśve hyumādevī dakṣiṇe vā viśeṣataḥutpalaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmahaste prasāritamvṛṣavāhanamākhyātaṃ nṛttamūrtirathocyaterurundhavadhanārthaṃ tu tadbhūtā carmamuṇḍanītadāhiṃsotsukā devā tadāsukhanivṛttayedevānāmārtināśāya rājarāṣṭra vivṛddhayeprāguktavidhinā grāhya bimbamānaṃ dvijottama !bhānurudradaśāṃśena tuṃgaṃ nṛttānataṃ bhavetnītvā śivāṃgulaṃ savye netrānte ca puṭāntakevāmorvābhyantare caiva sthitāṃ prau (?) gulphamadhyamelalāṭātsūtranīvraṃ tu yugāṃśaṃ vārdhahīnakamhikkāmadhyāttu sūtrāntaṃ sārdhasaptāṣṭavāṃgulamūrdhvakukṣī spṛśetpūrvasūtramevaṃ prakalpayettasmādaparabāhvagraṃ yugāṃgulamudāhṛtamcatvāriṃśatimātraṃ vā tasmādau guṇamātrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taddhastatalamadhye vā madhyāṃgulyāgra parvakepātraṃ vināthavā vahniṃ paṃcāṃśaṃ vistṛtānvitamtripaṃca saptajihvāyāṃ kalpayettu yathocitamcatvāriṃśati mātraṃ vā vāme saṃkhyāḥ kramānnayetḍamaruke madhyapīṭhasya sūcikarṇāntamuddhṛtamathavā carmasūtraṃ tu pīḍyamadhyāṃgulopariḍamarukadīrghavistāraṃ vasupaṃcāṃgulaṃ tathāvalayadvayasaṃyuktaṃ varmasūtreṇa bandhitamsūcyagrātkarṇasīmāntaṃ catvāriṃśati mātrakampārśvasūtrasamaṃ sūciṃ cāgniste madhyamāṃgulamprāksūtrādabhaye haste madhyaṃ bhānudvayāṃgulamsūtrāntātkorparaṃ nīvraṃ catvāriṃśati mātrakamprakoṣṭhamadhyanāhasya pādaṃ tasya tu deśikaḥsaptāṃgulaviśālaṃ tu ghanamekāṃgulaṃ bhavetbhujaṃgavalayaṃ hyevaṃ kalpayetkalpavittamaḥsūtrānmadhyodaraṃ vāme navāṃgulamudāhṛtamsūtrātkuṃcitajānvo'stu tvantaraṃ tu daśāṃgulambhānurudradaśāṃgulyaṃ natamānena kalpayetkalāṃgulaṃ tripaṃcamanumātraṃ vā jaṃghostudvantaraṃ tridhāsa veda catvāriṃśāṃśatyaṃgulaṃ tu vidhīyatesthita jānvoddhṛtaṃ pārṣṇyoḥ caturviṃśati mātrakamuddhṛtāṃghritalāntaṃ ca sthitajānūrdhva tatsamamkorparāḍḍolahastasya nābhi sūtrāddaśāṃgulamtaddhasto maṇibandhācca vāmajānvo'stu vyantaramḍolahaste tu madhyasthādaṃgulāgraṃ viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navāṃgulāntaraṃ vāpi rudrāṃgulamathāpi vāanyānyuktāni nīvrāṇi yathā saundaryamācaretsaptādaśāṃgulaṃ vātha ṣoḍaśāṃgulameva vāsuvikīrṇa jaṭābhāraṃ paṃcasapta ca nandakamdvātriṃśāṃgulamārabhya saikaṣaṣṭhyaṃgulāntakamadho jaṭādīrghamevaṃ hi tasmādūrdhvordhvamūrdhanijaṭāntaraṃ puṣpamālābhiḥ alaṃkṛtya viśeṣataḥhasitaṃ śīrṣakaṃ caiva karoṭī ratnabandhanamsindūrālaṃ kṛtaskandaṃ akṣamālyairalaṃkṛtamyajñopavītasaṃyuktaṃ urusūtrasamanvitamprabhāmaṇḍalamāśrityodarabandhāgrakaṃ dvija !ḍolabāhūrdhvato badhvā vyāghracarma dvijottama !tadardhaṃ vā tripādaṃ vā vistāraṃ tadvijottama !hastapādāṃgulīḥ sarvāḥ ratnahemāṃgulīyakāḥdakṣiṇaṃ kuṃcitaṃ pādaṃ aparopari sthitamvāmapādataloddhṛtya tiryagdordakṣiṇānugamtricatuṣpaṃca vaktraṃ vā apasmārasya dairghyakamuṣṇīṣamekabhāgena keśāntaṃ ca tathā bhavetadhyardhāṃgulamāyāmaṃ karṇavyāsaṃ tu śeṣataḥhṛdādi nābhi paryantaṃ tatsamaṃ parikīrtitamūrudīrghaṃ tu saptāṃśaṃ jānudīrghaṃ dvayāṃgulammanvaṃśaṃ tu karaṃ hikkā madhyāṃgulāgrasīmakamśaṃbhoḥ savye śiraḥ sthāpya vāme pādau vikīrṇitautanmukhaṃ tu samuddhṛtya vyālalīlāmudānvitamsasya śyāma nibhākāraṃ apasmāraṃ dvijottama !
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa pādaṃ sārdhapādona dviguṇaṃ vā tadāyatamprabhāmaṇḍalasaṃyuktaṃ anena vidhinā kṛtamtāvadekāṃgulārddhyā tu sāṣṭhanadithodayamprāgvat saṃkhyāghanaṃ khyātaṃ daṇḍasya prathamasya tuekadvitricatuṣpaṃca ṣaṭsaptāṣṭanavaṃ daśakartarīścāvaśātteṣu daṇḍasaṃkhyā tu tatkurutasyopariṣṭādanalaṃ haste tvagnirivākṛtiḥbhānumaṇḍalabaddhīmān prabhāmaṇḍalavartinametatsyātprathamaṃ nṛttaṃ sarvalokahitāvahamśaṃbhordehāṃgulenaiva ṣoḍaśāṃgulamunnatamevaṃ jāhnavīsaṃyuktaṃ nṛttaṃ caiva dvitīyakamuddhṛtaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmahastaṃ prasāritamlambayed brahmasūtraṃ tu sthitaṃ pādasya gulphakesuvikīrṇa jaṭābhāraṃ jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyutamcaturthaṃ nṛttametaddhi sarvaprāṇi hitāvahamsvavakraṃ vāmapādaṃ tu apasmāropari sthitamabhayaṃ śūlapāśaṃ ca ḍamaruṃ dakṣiṇe karegajahastopamaṃ hastaṃ prasāryaṃ dakṣiṇānugamcihnaṃ paṃcamanṛttasya evameveti vidyateskandadhṛt * * * * * vāmahaste dhṛtāṃjaliḥskando bhayakarābhyāṃ tu hanustanaṃ dhṛgādarātabhayaṃ ḍamarukaṃ caiva vajraṃ śūlaṃ tathaiva casavyānugakaraṇḍairvā vetālaṃ vāmānubhaṃgajāpamamghaṇṭāṃ caiva kapālaṃ ca vāmapārśve'ṣṭahastakeṣaṣṭhamevaṃ samākhyātaṃ saptamaṃ śṛṇu suvrata !
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuṃcitaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu apasmāropari sthitamuddhṛtaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ aṃguṣṭha jaṃghāgrasīmakamabhayaṃ śūlapāśaṃ ca ḍamaruṃ dakṣiṇe karegajahastopamaṃ vāme caturtho hyevameva hilalāṭasya tu madhyāttu vāme tu stanamadhyametatsūtrādvāmajānvo'stu nīvraṃ navāṃgulaṃ bhavetsaptamaṃ nṛttamākhyātaṃ jagadārtivināśanamśūlaṃ dakṣiṇapārśve tu kapālaṃ vismayaṃ tathāpaṃcamasya ca nṛttasya ṣaṣṭamaṃ śṛṇu suvrata !caturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyutamapasmāraṃ vinā pīṭhe vāmāṃghriḥ kuṃcitaṃ sthitamtatpādaṃ kuṃcitaṃ yuktyā sūtraṃ yuktyā tu lambayetityaṃśumānkāśyape nṛttamūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamaḥ)susthitaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu kuṃcitamdakṣiṇe'pyakṣisīmānte savyanāsāpuṭāntakedakṣiṇe meḍhramūlasya madhyamād dvyaṃgulāntakeyugāṃśaṃ natamānaṃ tu pādāṃguṣṭha dvayonnatamviślīṣaṃ syājjaṭābandhaṃ vāmetvīṣannatānanamvāme tu pūrvahastena devīmāliṃganaṃ kuruuṣṇīṣāntaṃ samuddhṛtya vāme kṛṣṇamṛgaṃ dhṛtamsusthitaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu kuṃcitaṃ dakṣiṇe bhavetprasārya dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmahastaṃ tu puṣpadhṛtśroṇyadhastāttalambaṃ syādvastraddhṛtamivākṛtiḥgambhīraṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve ṛṣibhiḥ prārthiteśvaraḥtricatuṣpaṃcamātraṃ syāt natamānaṃ yathākramam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratimoccaṃ nataṃ tuṃgaṃ bhaṃgamānaṃ hi kalpayetābhaṃgaṃ tadvijānīyāt aṣṭādaśāṃgulaṃ samamtattribhāgaikabhāgaṃ tu pārṣṇyośca tvantaraṃ bhavethanorvāme samālaṃbya dakṣiṇastana vāmakedakṣiṇāṃghrau tu pārṣṇyostu vāmapārśve tu lambayetlalāṭaṃ madhyanāsāgraṃ pādayoḥ pārṣṇimadhyametatsūtrādvāmapārśve tu hikkāmadhyaṃ śivāṃgulamtatsūtrāddakṣiṇe nābhimadhyamaṃ tu dviyaṃgulamtatsūtrādvāmagojānorantaraṃ dvādaśaṃ yavamuṣṇīṣādvāmapārśve tu netrānte tatpuṭāntakenābhimadhyāttu vāme tu sūtranīvraṃ dvayaṃgulamvāmāṃghripārṣṇisavye tu pārśvasūtraṃ pralambayetevaṃ tribhaṃgasūtreṣu saṃmiśraṃ tu na kārayetābhaṃgamadhamaṃ khyātaṃ tripurāntakamūrtinaḥdakṣiṇe pūrvahastordhvaṃ nābhisūtrāvasānakambāṇāyāmaṃ saptaviṃśatyaṃgulaṃ tu vidhīyateāsyaṃ paṃcāṃgulaṃ vyāsaṃ mātroccaṃ vyāsasādṛśamvāmahaste dhanurdhṛtvā kakṣāntaṃ tatkarordhvakamviṃśadaṃgulatuṃgaṃ triḥ paṃcasaptanavāṃgulampūrṇamuṣṭistu nāhaṃ syānmadhyādagraṃ kramātkṛśambāṇanāhaṃ tribhāgaikaṃ rajjunāhaṃ tu tantunātaddīrghasyānukūlyaṃ tu dhanorvakramudāhṛtamdhanuṣākṛtireva syāt lohajaṃ dārujaṃ tathāṭaṃkaṃ dakṣiṇa haste tu vāmahaste mṛgaṃ dhṛtampravālasadṛśaprakhyaṃ vāme gaurīsamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadeva vāmapādaṃ tu apasmāroparisthitamsusthitaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu dakṣiṇaṃ kuṃcitaṃ bhavettṛtīyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ caturthaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuprāgivaiva viśeṣaṃ tu caturthaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tu vātithyaṃśaṃ manumātraṃ vā trayodaśāṃgulameva vātatkare korparaṃ nīvraṃ śroṇipārśve tathā bhavettatkare korparoddhṛtyaṃ hṛdayāntamudāhṛtamsarveṣāmapi sāmānyapyantaraṃ kathitaṃ mayāvāmadakṣiṇahastaṃ ca kramādūrdhvamadhomukhamparahaste dakṣiṇe ṭaṃkaṃ dhanuścaiva tu vāmakeapasmāraṃ vinā pādaṃ nataṃ sūtraṃ ca prāgivaatibhaṃgasamopetaṃ aṣṭahastasamanvitamdhanurvismayahastaṃ ca kheṭakaṃ kaṭakaṃ tathāyathā śobhanatuṃgaṃ vā kalpayedgaurisaṃyutambāṇaṃ cakraṃ tathā śūlaṃ ṭaṃkaṃ vajraṃ ca dakṣiṇevāme paṃcakare khyātaṃ atibhaṃgamathoparitatpūrve vāmapādaṃ tu talaṃ nyastvā raṃthoparimukulābhyantare brahmā caturvaktraścaturbhujaḥkuṇḍikaṃ padmapāśaṃ ca vāmahastadvaye dhṛtamrathaṃ tvāpannamārgeṇa kalpayetkalpavittamaḥpravālasadṛśaṃ varṇaṃ satvarājasamāśritamtasya vāme'pyumā devīṃ prāguktavidhinā kuruityaṃśumānkāśyape tripurāntakamūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (saptatitamaḥ)lalāṭamadhyamādvāme vāmanetrāvasānakedakṣiṇe nābhi madhyāttu devavahnyaṃgulaṃ tu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: antaraṃ mānasūtraṃ ca samabhaṃgaṃ yathā tathādakṣiṇe pūrvahastaṃ tu gaurīdakṣiṇahastadhṛtdakṣiṇe paraśuṃ vāme pare kṛṣṇamṛgaṃ dhṛtamdevaṃ pravālavarṇābhaṃ deveśasya viśeṣataḥutpalaṃ vāmahaste tu dhṛtā dakṣiṇahastakampārvatyānugatā śrībhūmiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitādevāgre kārayetkuṇḍe homakarma prajāpatiḥcaturbhujaṃ caturvaktraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamsruksruvau pūrvahaste tu dhṛto vāmetare kramātprāgagrau devi deveśau devī devasya dakṣiṇeśaṃbhornāsyagrasīmāntaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hīnaṃ stanāntakamśyāmavarṇaṃ samābhaṃgaṃ śaṃkhacakraṃ pare karesaṃgrāhya varade haste dadyādudakapūrvakamādigotrāmimāṃ gaurīṃ tathaivāhaṃ dadāmyahamaṣṭalokeśa vidyeśāḥ siddhayakṣagaṇādayaḥtattacchaktisamopetā hṛdayāṃjalisaṃyutāḥevaṃ kalyāṇamūrtestu ardhanārīśvaraṃ tathācaturbhujaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ dvividhaṃ parikīrtitamsusthitaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu kuṃcitamabhayaṃ paraśuṃ savye haste tattu śivāṃśakamtadanyavāmahaste tu kaṭakaṃ puṣpasaṃyutamśivasyā bharaṇaṃ savye vāme strībhūṣaṇānvitamathavā kuṃcitaṃ savyaṃ pādaṃ vāmaṃ tu susthitamvaradaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ anyokṣaśirakorparamdakṣiṇe raudradṛṣṭiḥ syādvāmapārśve tu śītalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekāṃśaṃ galamānaṃ tu dvyaṃśenāliṃgamucyatevājanaṃ caikabhāgena bhāgaṃ dviguṇitāṃśakeadhiṣṭhānasya cotsedhaṃ caturviṃśati bhājitekhuramekena kartavyaṃ jagatyuccaṃ rasāṃśakamvedāṃśaṃ * * * tsedhaṃ kalaśaṃ caikabhāgayādvibhāgaṃ pratituṃgaṃ tu vājanaṃ caikabhāgayābhānudvyaṃśe taloccaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ pādukaṃ bhavetkaṇṭhamaṃśena kartavyaṃ aṃśenābjaṃ prakalpayetkampamekena kaṇṭhaṃ tu guṇāṃśamekena kampakamekāṃśaṃ galamānaṃ tu kampamekena kārayetcatussaptadvibhāgaṃ tu tattanmānaṃ vibhājitegalamekena kartavyaṃ ambujaṃ tu dvibhāgayājagatī caturaṃśaṃ tu padmamaṃśe dvijottama !guṇāṃśaṃ kumudoccaṃ tu padmamaṃśena kalpayetdvyaṃśena pratimānaṃ tu vājanaṃ ca śivāṃśakamtrayoviṃśati bhāgaṃ tu taloccaṃ tu vibhājiteadhaḥ padmaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syāt ekāṃśaṃ kaṇṭhamucyatetadūrdhve padmamekāṃśaṃ ekāṃśaṃ kampamānakamekāṃśaṃ padmatuṃgaṃ tu sārdhāṃśaṃ vājanodayamtripaṭṭaṃ tu tathāṃśena pratimānaṃ dvibhāgayāpratibandhasya bhedaṃ syāt etaccaṃ puratastathāupānaṃ caikabhāgena dvibhāgena tu dalodayamvedāṃśaṃ kumudoccaṃ tu padmamaṃśena kalpayetvājanoccaṃ dvibhāgena ekāṃśaṃ padmabhāgakampratimānaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syāt vājanaṃ caikabhāgayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ samāsataḥ proktaṃ ardhanārīśvaraṃ haramlalāṭamadhyanāsāgrāt vā vetustanamadhyamāttatsūtrāddakṣiṇe vāmapādapārṣṇyantaraṃ dvija !tatsūtrādamataḥ savyapādāṃguṣṭhāntaraṃ dvijasarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ caturdoraṣṭa eva vāgajaśṛṃgaṃ ca carmaṃ ca vāmapārśve karadvayeśūlaṃ ḍamarukaṃ pāśaṃ gajacarma ca dakṣiṇevāmapārśve tu catvāro hastā evaṃ prakīrtitammakuṭasyopariṣṭāttu gajapucchaṃ prakalpayetprabhāmaṇḍalavaccheṣaṃ gajacarma prakalpayetsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ atiratnasamaprabhamśūlaṃ khaḍgaṃ tathā carma gajaśṛṃgaṃ ca dakṣiṇelalāṭamadhyanāsāgradakṣiṇastanamadhyamātsusthitaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu gajamūrdhnastu deśika !tadaṃghripārṣṇyāt sphik piṇḍātvantaraṃ caturaṃgulamevaṃ dvividhamākhyātaṃ gajahāriṃ ca cocyateevaṃ hi kalpitaṃ bimbaṃ rājarāṣṭravivṛddhidamityaṃśumānkāśyape gajahārimūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (trisaptatitamaḥ)samapādaṃ sthānakaṃ ca candraśekharamūrtivatabhayaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca dakṣiṇe tu karadvayampravālasadṛśaprakhyaṃ saumyanetrāti śītalamnityotsavāyabimbaṃ tat sthānakaṃ vāsanaṃ tu vātīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāsya saṃyuktaṃ vyālayajñopavītakamśūlaṃ hyadhomukhaṃ dhṛtvā kapālaṃ varade dhṛtamśūlāgraṃ varadenaiva saṃgrāhya tryajatho dhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raudraṃ pāśupataṃ hyetat bimbe liṃge tu pūjitametāṃ mūrtiṃ sakṛd dhyāyet sarvaśatruvināśanamityaṃśumānkāśyape pāśupatamūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (catussaptatitamaḥ)pādau tu pādukopetau vāmapādaṃ tu susthitamśuddha śvetānibhaṃ varṇaṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamdhūrdhūrapuṣpaṃ nāgaṃ ca vāme savyenduśekharamkiṃcitprakāśitāntastha darśanaṃ suvilāsitamkarṇau kuṇḍalasaṃyuktau vāme śākhādalaṃ tu vādakṣiṇaṃ hariṇī vaktre vyāhitaṃ siṃhakarṇavattatasthyā kṛti nirmāṇadvipādadvikarānvitamdaṇḍaṃ kaṃkālapādau dvau rajjunā bandhayedbudhaḥetatkaṃkāla nāmnā tu vāmaskandhopari nyasetbalipātradharaṃ bhūtaṃ vāmāgre gamanānvitamkiṃcitprakāśitaṃ yoni saṃyuktā nagnavāsasaḥlalāṭavāmapārśve tu netrānte tatpuṭāntakenābhessavye yugāṃgulye vāmapādasya gulphakeābhaṃgasyokta mārgeṇa natamānaṃ prakalpayetdakṣiṇe kaṭipārśve tu kṣurikāścaiva bandhayetubhayoḥ pārśvayorhaste nānānāgavibhūṣitamhṛdayāṃjali saṃyukte saṃbhrāntamanasānvitaiḥvīthiṃ saṃmārjayedvāyuḥ parjanyo jalasecanam* * * * * * * * ṛṣayaḥ stotra pāṭhakāḥcarmabandhaṃ ca kaṃsaṃ ca kadambaṃ suṣirameva vātumburu nāradāḥ sarvaiśca geyakarma salakṣaṇamsarvalokopakārārthaṃ indrasya bhavanādiṣu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tvayā vai dhāritasyāsya kaṃkālasyodbhavaṃ kathamtaddehaṃ bhuvanāditvaṃ bhaye yastu svaśaktayaḥprārthaye yustu māṃ bhaktyā teṣāṃ bhayanivṛttayekaṃkālaṃ mocanārthaṃ tu taddhṛtaiva mahadvija !evaṃ kaṃkālamākhyātaṃ haryardhaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape kaṃkālamūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (paṃcasaptatitamaḥ)ārjavaṃ susthitaṃ devaṃ sthānakaṃ samapādakamparaśuṃ dakṣiṇe haste vāme śaṃkhāyudhaṃ parampravālaśyāmavarṇaṃ ca tadyogyābharaṇānvitamkiṃcitprakāśitaṃ cordhvadṛṣṭyā caiva lalāṭakeśiraścakrasamāyuktaṃ tasyalakṣaṇamucyatesuvṛttaṃ cakravadvipra ! padmākṛtirathāpi vāśiraścakrasya nālasya vistāraṃ dvijasattamaagre lalāṭapaṭṭasya śiraścakrasya nālakamcakrādguṇāṃgulaṃ lambya puṣpamālā tu madhyamātityaṃśumānkāśyape haryardhamūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ṣaṭsaptatitamaḥ)pādau pādukasaṃyuktau vāmapādaṃ tu susthitamlalāṭamadhyamātsavye yavāṣṭau vā navāntarehṛnmadhye nābhisavye tu ṣoḍaśaṃ tu yavāntareābhaṃgavattataḥ khyātaṃ samabhaṃgamathāpi vāsuvikīrṇajaṭābhāraṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalameva vālalāṭapaṭṭasaṃyuktaṃ kakoṭiṭyanduśekharamśuddhaśvetanibhaṃ proktaṃ nānānāgavibhūṣitamvāme tu pūrvahastaṃ tu varadaṃ syātkapāladhṛtvāme tu śikhipiṃchaṃ tu kartavyaṃ śītalaṃ dhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śvetayajñopavītaṃ tu nīlakaṇṭhaṃ tripuṇṭravattvameva vaktuṃ tasyaiva hetuṃ me vaktu marhasitaddāvānāma pārśvaṃ syādanaveṣaṃ vadetsadādevatāstu hitāssarve prārthayeyustu māṃ dvijadānavānāṃ vināśārthaṃ brahmamūrtiṃ hanāmyahamtadbrahmāṇḍādhipāḥ sarve mahābhayasamanvitāḥanyānāṃ supratiṣṭhārthaṃ devānāmabhayārthakamtatkapālasyamokṣārthaṃ bhikṣākāro'smyahaṃ dvijaityaṃśumānkāśyape bhikṣāṭanamūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (saptasaptatitamaḥ)umā sahitavatsarvaṃ vāme kiṃcinnatānanamvāme tu kaṭakaṃ varjyaṃ nyastvā caṇḍeśamūrdhaniāsīno'thasukhāsīnaścaṇḍeśaḥ svarṇasaṃnibhaḥcaṇḍeśānugrahaṃ khyātaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrti tatparam(aṣṭasaptatitamaḥ)lambitaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmāṃghrernalakāgrakamlalāṭadakṣiṇe savye netrānte tatpuṭāntakeyavatrayāntaraṃ nītvā lambya vāme tu madhyamenata madhyardhamātraṃ syāt caturbhujasamanvitamdakṣiṇe parahastaṃ tu akṣamālāsamanvitamvāmajānūpariṣṭāttu varade talapṛṣṭhakamvāme tvaparahaste tu vahniṃ vā vyālameva vāsukīrṇamūrdhāṃgaṃ vāpi jaṭāmaṇḍalameva vāhasitaṃ vaktrasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamtriṇetraṃ śaṃkhapatraṃ tu vāme sarvaṃ tu kuṇḍalamrudrākṣaiḥ kaṇṭhamālā ca bhasmanā ca vibhūṣitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārado jamadagniśca vasiṣṭho bhṛgu dakṣiṇenāndinā kiṃnarādyaiśca vaṭavṛkṣasamudgṛhamsūtrātpādajaṃghāpārṣṇyantaṃ trivedamanumātrakamśyāmavarṇamapasmāraṃ nāgalīlāsamanvitamtadeva vāmapādena kuṭīkāsanasaṃyutamśeṣaṃ prāgiva kartavyaṃ etadvīṇākaraṃ bhavetvāmaṃ prasāritaṃ hastaṃ vāmajānurdhvakopariśuddhaśvetanibhaṃ varṇaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretanyonyāṃghritalaṃ vipra ! sphik piṇḍādhaḥ prakalpayetvaradaṃ vāmahastaṃ tu meḍhrapīṭhoparinyasetyogamūrtiriti khyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ paramityaṃśumānkāśyape dakṣiṇāmūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ekonāśītitamaḥ)vasunandadaśāṃśaṃ vā natamānaṃ dvijottamalalāṭadakṣiṇe savyanetramadhye tathaiva canābhimadhyāttu vāme tu sūtrāntaraṃ yavāṣṭakamsthitoṃghrigulpha madhye tu pūrvasūtraṃ prasārayetprathamaṃ nṛttamūrtestu dakṣiṇasthitapādavataṃguṣṭhamuddhṛtāṃghrestu kālasya hṛdaye nyasetcaturhastasamāyuktaṃ aṣṭahastamathāpi vādakṣiṇe parahastaṃ tu paraśuṃ vāmadaṃ tu vāsūcyagrātpūrvasūtrāntaṃ kalāmanvaṃgulaṃ tu vāvāme tvaparahastaṃ tu vismayaṃ parikalpayetuṣṇīṣāntaṃ samuddhṛtya vismaye'nāmikāgrakamcaturhastaṃ samākhyātaṃ aṣṭahastamataḥ śṛṇuvismayaṃ kheṭakaṃ pāśaṃ sūcihastaṃ ca vāmake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kālahāmūrtirākhyātā adhasthātkālamucyatevikīrṇapādau māṃ dṛṣṭvā śāyayedūrdhvavaktrakamityaṃśumānkāśyape kālahārimūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (saptatitamaḥ)liṃgākārasya madhye tu candraśekharamūrtivatbrahmā tu haṃsarūpeṇa ūrdhvagaṃ vāmapārśvakeviṣṇurdakṣiṇapārśve tu vāmapārśve pitāmahaḥraktaśyāmahiraṇyābhaṃ īśaviṣṇupitāmahānityaṃśumānkāśyape liṃgodbhavamūrtilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ekāśītitamaḥ)devānāṃ caiva devīnāṃ śūlārthaṃ vṛkṣamucyatesnigdhe vāsnigdhā bhūmau vā ārjavaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ ghanamśītaloṣṇaṃ ca saṃmiśraṃ alpasneharasānvitamsnigdhe vā snigdhabhūmo ca ārjavaṃ cātimārdavamatimārdavasaṃyuktaṃ atiśītalasaṃyutametat strī vṛkṣamākhyātaṃ devīnāṃ śūlayogyakamatidurbalasaṃyuktaṃ yattad ṣaṇḍamudāhṛtamsālaṃ ca khādiraṃ caiva somaśīrṣakatindukamāmrakaṃ kusumaṃ caiva saptaparṇaṃ ca dhanvanamjīrṇā vakrāntarāśrutyāṃ śiraḥ śūnyāti śālikāḥvakrakoṭarasaṃyuktā vyālapakṣisamāśritāḥgulmavalmīkamāśritya caṇḍālā vā samāśritāḥnṛpamandiraṃ saṃśritya karmakārālayāśritāḥandhā (kra?)caiva tu vṛkṣāśca anyakarmasu yojitāḥtasmātsarvaprayatnena doṣāḍhyaṃ parivarjayetācāryaḥ śilpakaścātra vṛkṣasthāne tu saṃgṛhetvṛkṣādhastādguṇādīni vyapohyāvapanaṃ guruḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etadvṛkṣāśritā devā dānavāśca piśācakāḥyūyaṃ bimbārtha vṛkṣāttu gaccheyuste yathā sukhamraktacandanasaṃyuktaṃ gandhatoyasamanvitamsthaṇḍilaṃ sikataiḥ kuryāddhastamātrapramāṇataḥsamidājyaiścarubhiśca homaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥaghoreṇa caruṃ hutvā pratyekāṣṭaśatāhutiḥtataścāgniṃ samudvāsya vṛkṣaṃ prokṣya śivāmbhasāvṛkṣasya pūrvabhāge tu mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu paścimamdhyātvaivaṃ lakṣayitvā tu paścācchedanamārabhetkṣīraṃ toyaṃ ghṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sṛk sru(?)ve vanyaśobhanamvṛkṣamūlamaśeṣaṃ tu sthapatiśchedayetkramātanyatra patitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ varjayettu prayatnataḥgavyairgandhodakaiḥ snāpya gandhamālyairalaṃkṛtamsyandane śibikāyāṃ vā ropya skandhena vā budhaḥmaṇṭapaṃ mārjanaṃ kṛtvā gomayālepanaṃ kurusthaṇḍilaṃ kārayedvidvān śūladīrghasamāyutamprāgagraṃ śāyayettasmin śūlavṛkṣamadhomukhampaścācchūlaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tvaritaṃ tu na kārayetityaṃśumānkāśyape vṛkṣasaṃgrahaṇapaṭalaḥ (dvyaśītitamaḥ)ūrdhvakāyasamaṃ vaṃ?śa daṇḍadīrghamudāhṛtammūleṣṭāṃśa vihīnaṃ tu tasyāgraṃ a tataṃ bhavettadūrdhaṃ vṛttamākhyātaṃ śeṣaṃ vartulameva vāvistāraṃ sārdhaṣaṇmātraṃ sārdhasaptāṃgulaṃ tu vāagraṃ yugāṃgula vyāsaṃ madhyādagraṃ kramātkṛśamhikkāsūtrādadhastāttu yāvatsyāddvyaṃgulāvadhi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣoḍaśāṃgulamāyāmaṃ kaṭidaṇḍasya deśikamadhye yugāṃgulaṃ chidraṃ nābheḥ paṃcāṃgulādadhaḥvakṣodaṇḍāgrayorvipra ! kaṭidaṇḍāgrayorapiekadvitricatuṣpaṃca ṣaṭsaptāṣṭakaraṃ tu vādvyaṃgulaṃ ca śikhāyāmaṃ hastasaṃkhyāpi tantataḥśikhāvyāsaṃ tadekāṃśaṃ mūlegre tu kṛśaṃ kramātsārdhāṃgulaṃ tu tattāraṃ suvṛttaṃ tadghanaṃ samamaṣṭāṃgulaṃ samāropya ūruśūlāyataṃ bhavetūrumūle suṣiṃ kṛtvā kaṭidaṇḍāgrayorbudhaḥjānumānaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā ūrujaṃghādvayorapiguṇāṃgulaṃ śikhāmānaṃ jaṃghādīrghobhayairyutamjaṃghāmūlaṃ tribhāgaikaṃ śikhā vyāsamudāhṛtamsaṃdhi hīnāṃghriśūlaṃ tu evamevaṃ vidhīyateūrumadhyatribhāgaikaṃ ūrudaṇḍasya vistṛtamjaṃghāmūlatribhāgaikaṃ hīnaṃ jaṃghāgravistṛtamsa?lāgravistṛtaṃ taddvitridvyaṃśa vistṛtānvitamkartavyaṃ suṣiraṃ tasmin jaṃghāgrādadhikāyatambāhumūlaviśālaṃ tu guṇāṃgulamudāhṛtambāhuprakoṣṭhayoścaiva korparaṃ jānuvadbhavetparśvayorvaṃśadaṇḍasya pārśvadaṇḍe tu yojayetvaṃśadaṇḍasamaṃ nīvraṃ ūrdhvādhastācchikhānvitamyojayetsudṛḍhaṃ chidre guṇāṃśaṃ vyantarānvitamhastapādatalaṃ śrotraṃ tāmrapatreṇa yojayetdevānāṃ śūlamevaṃ syāt devīnāmatha vakṣyateaṣṭāṃśa hīnamagrasya viśālaṃ tatsuvṛttakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vakṣodaṇḍāyataṃ śeṣaṃ tasyāntaṃ visṛtaṃ bhavetjaṃghā daṇḍāttu ṣaṇmātraṃ ropayetsthānake budhaḥśūlamevaṃ samākhyātaṃ upadhāśūlamucyateupaśūlāyataṃ proktaṃ aṣṭāṃgulatataṃ bhavetśūlavyāsasamaṃ madhyaṃ chidraṃ tadviśikhānvitamvakṣodaṇḍakaṭīdaṇḍaṃ dhṛtvā vaṃśākhyaśūlakamupathāśūlaśikhāntaṃ ca vakṣodaṇḍapuraṃ samamlohajaṃ dārujaṃ vātha kīlaṃ saṃyojayeddṛḍhamśūlalakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ śūlasthāpanamucyateityaṃśumānkāśyape śūlalakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (tryaśītitamaḥ)karṣaṇoditamāse ca ṛkṣavāramuhūrtakeprāsādasyāgrato vaiśe maṇṭapaṃ ca caturaśrakampaṃktitrayasamāyuktaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃghrisamanvitamyathā lābhaṃ parīṇāhaṃ nirvraṇaṃ dāruṇā dṛḍhamchādayettu vitānena muktāsragdarbhamālikāmcaturdvārasamāyuktaṃ stambhaveṣṭanasaṃyutammaṇṭapasya tribhāgaikaṃ madhye vedī viśālakamguṇāṃgulaṃ viśāloccāttasyādhaścopavedikāmkṛtvānyatrāgni kuṇḍāni tvanena vidhinā kuruśakraśāṃkarayormadhye vṛttakuṇḍaṃ prakalpayetgaurī sahitabimbaṃ cet koṇeṣvaśvattha patravatkuṇḍaṃ lakṣaṇavatkṛtvā sarvakuṇḍāni deśikaḥbrāhmaṇānbhojayettasmin puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥvedikābhyagnikuṇḍāni paryagnikaraṇaṃ kurusthaṇḍilaṃ vedikāyāṃ tu cāṣṭadroṇaiśca śālibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taṇḍulaistiladarbhaiśca lājaiḥ puṣpairalaṃkṛtamdhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ puṣpairarghairathārcayettanmadhye dārupīṭhaṃ tu nyastvā tasyopari nyasetśucivohavyamantreṇa kṛtvā gandhodakairhṛdākautukaṃ bandhayeddevaṃ tayordakṣiṇahastakelambakūrcasamāyuktaṃ navavastreṇa veṣṭayetśayane śāyayecchūlaṃ prākśiraścordhvavaktrakamp. 361) tayoḥ śirontike deśe sthāpayettadghaṭadvayamdroṇagandhāmbu saṃpūrṇaṃ śivakuṃbhaṃ taducyategaurīśūlasamāyukte gaurīkuṃbhamidaṃ varamgaurīkuṃbhaṃ tathā'bhyarcya svasvamantrairviśeṣataḥvidyeśamūlamantraiśca sthāpya gandhādibhiryajetagnyādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ agnikāryoktamācaretyāmye tu saundaraṃ khyātaṃ khādiraṃ nair-ṛtau dvijaḥvaṭaṃ vai saumyakuṇḍe tu tvarkaṃ vai tvīśagocarevinā koṇeṣu kuṇḍāni vinā gaurīṃ dvijottama !aghoreṇa caruṃ hutvā lājaṃ vāmena homayetp. 362) sarṣapaṃ kavacenaiva śikhayā mudgameva cadravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā devī deveśayossamamdiśāsvadhyayanaṃ vedān stotraṃ vai vidiśāsu cadevīdeveśayormūla mantramaṣṭaśatāhutiḥnṛttagītaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ vyapohya cajalasnānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ bhasmasnānamanantaramśuklamālyānulepādyaiḥ bhūṣyapaṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇaiḥācāryaḥ suprasannātmā śivadvijakulodbhavaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dharātaloccaṃ vibhajet trayoviṃśati bhāgayāekāṃśaṃ kaṇṭhamānaṃ tu ūrdhvaṃ padmaṃ śivāṃśakamkampamekena kartavyaṃ dvibhāgaṃ kandharodayamkapotoccaṃ guṇāṃśaṃ tu āliṃgaṃ caikabhāgayāevaṃ tvanekabhedena procyate tu dharātalamardhaṃ vārdha tripādaṃ vā balāṃgada balānvitammūlapādasya māvyāsa pādamūle tripaṭṭikampādabāhyasamāveśaṃ nīvraṃ caiva samaṃ bhavetsiṃhebhamakarairvyālaiḥ bhūtahaṃsairvibhūṣitamtripaṭṭordhve pratiṃ hema sarvatra parikalpayetanye dve kusumāssarve pratibandhāṃghri bandhayetityaṃśumānkāśyape adhiṣṭhānalakṣaṇa paṭalaḥ (ṣaṣṭhaḥ)pratibandhe praterante tadanye paṭṭikāntikenālaṃ kuryādadhaścordhve nālaṃ tasminsuyojayetcaturviṃśāṃgulaṃ yāvat tāvatpaṃcavidhāya tamveśayitvātha vā bhitteḥ abhyantarasamaṃ tu vākalāṃgulāvasānaṃ tu vistāraṃ paṃcadhā kramāttadvistarasamaṃ vyāsaṃ tripādaṃ vārdhatadghanamnālamadhye tu kartavyaṃ nimnonnatavivarjitamgajoṣṭhasadṛśālambya yathā sundaramagrataḥnālamevaṃ prakartavyaṃ saumye prā * mamadhyamenālaṃ gandhodakairgavyaiḥ snāpayitvāmbhasā tataḥsnāpakassuprasannātmā sumuhūrte sulagnakesarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvātodyasamanvitampuṃśilāyā sukartavyā nālaṃ tu caraṇādhipam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhādibhissamabhyarcya pūjanaṃ ca viśeṣataḥsviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa pūrṇāhutimathācaretp. 363) maṇḍūkākhyapade vātha saptasaptāṃśameva vāsthānakaṃ devikāṃśe tu āsanaṃ mānuṣe padeāsanaṃ bhadrapīṭhe tu sthānakaṃ vedikoparikartavyaṃ sundaraṃ tasmin ādhārākhya śilāṃ nyasetsamāśraṃ sāyataṃ vāpi tadardhaṃ tadghanaṃ bhavetādhārākhyaśilāyāṃ tu ratnagartaṃ prakalpayetmūle tu navaratnaṃ vā hemaṃ vā tatra nikṣipetprāgeva kalpayeddhīmān sthāpanārthaṃ balānvitammuhūrte samanuprāpte gurave saṃnivedayetsarvātodyasamāyuktaṃ sarvavādyasamanvitamp. 364) sthāpayedavaṭe śūlatalādhastāddṛḍhaṃ yathātasya vāme tu saṃsthāpya gaurīśūlaṃ viśeṣataḥpaṃcaṣaṭsaptamātraṃ vā gartavyāsaṃ tathā navamprāgukta vidhinā sthāpya gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetyatra śeṣaṃ tu yatkarmaśilpibhistu viśeṣataḥsthapatiścitrakarmajño yojyaścānyairna kārayetācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥśūlasthāpanamākhyātaṃ rajjubandhamatha śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape śūlasthāpanavidhipaṭalaḥ (caturaśītitamaḥ)sarvāsu śūlasaṃdhyāsu tāmrapatraistu veṣṭayetśrīveṣṭakaṃ kunduruṣkaṃ guggulaṃ ca gulaṃ tathāśrīveṣṭanaṃ caturbhāgaṃ kunduruṣkaṃ guṇāṃśakamsarjarasaṃ tu vasvaṃśaṃ gairikaṃ tu guṇāṃśakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛtpātre taṃ vinikṣipya pācetkṣaudrākṛtiryadārajjubandhaṃ tu nābhestu madhyasyodūrdhvagaṃ tridhāiḍā vai tasya vāmasthā pradhānā nāḍayastvimeteṣāṃ nāḍī trayāṇāṃ tu yogaṃ bhrūmadhyame bhavetbhrūmadhyānmūrdhniparyantaṃ trināḍī caikavadbhavetgāndhārī hasti jihvā ca pūṣā caiva yaśasvinīgāndhārī savyanetrāntaṃ hastijihvetarākṣikāḥalambuṣā meḍhramūlāntā vakradantā kuhūrbhavetteṣvādau ca caturnāḍī yavatrayaghanānvitādakṣiṇāvartitāḥ sarve dvivatyaine prakīrtitāḥpradhānanāḍī trayāṇāṃ tu mūlameḍhrāvasānakamvimalā śoṣiṇī pṛthvī mahasī tejasī tathārasavādī mṛdaṃgī ca saṃginī * * * * *ūrumūlaivamāvṛtya parito nalakāntakamśabdāṃgādīni ṣaṭsaṃkhyā iḍāmūle samudbhavāḥnalakāgraikamāvṛtya ṣaṇmā * greka vartitāḥvakṣodaṇḍopariṣṭāttu tiryagbāhugāstvimāḥrasavādī mṛdaṃgī ca saṃginī vāmabāhuketadasyāgrādaṣṭaśākhā syuḥ dakṣiṇe'dakṣiṇe tathāteṣāmagraikavadvipra ! maṇibandhaikamāvṛtamevaṃ hi pratimānāṃ tu mukhyanāḍyaṣṭaviṃśatiḥteṣāṃ bhinnāstathā vipra catuṣṣaṣṭiśca nāḍayaḥdvisaptati sahasrāṇi nāḍayaḥ parikīrtitāḥnālikeraphalatvagmyannatyalpa salilānvitamnāḍayaste'pi saṃkalpya paścādāvṛtanāḍikāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paścānnirandhraṃ rajjubhyāṃ bandhayeddakṣiṇā vṛtamtasyanālaṃ tu nābhyantaṃ suṣumnā sahabandhitammūlamaṃtramanusmṛtya rajjubandhamidaṃ kuruityaṃśumānkāśyape rajjubandhavidhānapaṭalaḥ (paṃcāśītitamaḥ)jāṃgalaṃ cānurūpaṃ ca samaṃśaṃ mṛttridhā bhavettanubālukasaṃyuktaṃ kleśātkhananamakṣamamtayormiśramivākāraṃ miśrabhūstamudāhṛtamnadīdīrghataṭāke vā śvetā sṛk pītakṛṣṇa vāpātre saṃśoṣayetpaṃkaṃ yāvadāladravānvitamkhādinārjunatoyaiśca pātre pākaṃ tu mardayettriphaloṣitāmbhasā caiva śoṣayecca punaḥ punaḥpiṇḍe haste tato rekhā dṛśetpiṇḍaṃ tataḥ kururudrāṃgulaparīṇāhaṃ praśastamṛdudāhṛtamsādṛśaṃ cotkṛtaikāṃśaṃ yojayettu mṛdā sahamṛdeṣāṃśaṃ samāyojya nālikeraphalodakaiḥśrīveṣṭaṃ guggulaṃ caiva kunduruṣkaṃ tathaiva capātre mṛttiṃ samāyojya dadhicāmardayetsudhīḥsamacūrṇaṃ tu kartavyaṃ mṛddaśāṃśena saṃyutamkapittha bilvaniryāsa cūrṇau dvau samatāṃ kurumardayettu kramātsamyak kuṣṭhaṃ ca haritālakamsaṃgrāhya cūrṇaṃ kartavyaṃ mṛddaśāṃsasamanvitamsvarṇaṃ rajatacūrṇaṃ ca valmīka kulirāvaṭegajadante vṛṣaśṛṃge mṛdaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥkapitthaniryāsatoyaiḥ madhu vā mardayedbudhaḥtvaksāraṃ tu parigrāhya ekaṃ sārdhadvayāṃgulam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛccaturthyā samāyuktaṃ madhyalepanamārabhettadrajju vyantaraṃ vipra ekadvitryaṃgulaṃ tu vātāvannirīkṣya kartavyaṃ mṛllepaṃ tu śanaiḥ śanaiḥekāṃśāvadhikaṃ lipya anurūpamudāhṛtamtattaddeśamṛdenaiva tatra vedyāṃśamālipetśeṣaṃ kārpāsa tailena yuktaṃ kalkaṃ tu lepayetityaṃśumānkāśyape mṛtsaṃskāravidhipaṭalaḥ (ṣaṣṭyaśītitamaḥ)nadyāṃ vāpi taṭāke vā dīrghikāyāmathāpi vāsudṛśāgrāṇi tulyāgā sthūla vālukasāśritāḥśarkarāṃ śoṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sūkṣma cūrṇaṃ tu tatkurukapitthaniryāsasyaiva jalaṃ trividhamucyatesṛtasvacchajalaṃ caiva saikaṃ ceti kramoditāḥpaścātkārpāsatūlaiśca miśraṃ kṛtvā suṣeṣayetetatkalkaṃ samālipya prathamaṃ kalkameva himarīcitriphalaṃ hyevaṃ trividhaṃ paripaṭhyatekrameṇa lepayetkalkaṃ dviyavaṃ triyavaṃ ghanamdvimāsaṃ sārdhamāsaṃ vā māsaṃ vā śoṣayettataḥtataḥ svacchajalaiḥ kalkaṃ pramāṇāntantu pūrayetaṃgopāṃgaṃ ca pratyaṃgān kalpayellakṣaṇānvitamupāṃgaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ khyātaṃ pratyaṃgaṃ cihnavāhanampāṭāścādantu kartavyaṃ kalkamālepayettataḥniryāsatoyaṃ kūrcena secaṣeṣyā tu ṣeṣayetpaścādvai cikkaṇaṃ lipya śvetavarṇaṃ tato lipetityaṃśumānkāśyape kalkasaṃskāralakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (saptāśītitamaḥ)śivātparaṃ ca sadbhāvaṃ avyaktācchāntisaṃbhavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmād vyoma samutpannaṃ tasmādanilasaṃbhavamtasmādvai bhuvanaṃ jātaṃ bhuvane varṇasaṃbhavamjale tu śvetasaṃbhāvaṃ agnau raktanibhodbhavamviṣṇurmaheśvaro dhātā rudro varṇādhipāḥ kramātśvetaṃ raktaṃ ca pītaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ vipra caturvidhammuktābhaṃ cenduvarṇābhaṃ śvetavarṇamiti smṛtamrājatābhaṃ ca gokṣīrasadṛśaṃ dhavalaṃ bhavetaruṇaṃ rakta śoṇaṃ ca pāṭalaṃ ca caturvidhamśoṇaṃ kiṃśukapuṣpābhaṃ lākṣāsāraṃ tu pāṭalamsvarṇavarṇasamaṃ svarṇaṃ piṃgaṃ rajanisāravatnīlaṃ śyāmaṃ ca kālaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ caiva caturvidhamśikhikaṇṭhasamaṃ kālaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ syādgṛhapakṣavatgharaṇījandracchedaṃ raktaṃ haṃsāṃghrī saṃbhavamgodāvaryāstu saṃbhūtaṃ haritālamudāhṛtamśyāmapāṣāṇa sāraṃ tu śyāmamityabhidhīyateevamādi kalāvarṇaṃ tasmāttasminnanekadhāpadmaṃ cāviri nīlānyad dhāturityabhidhīyateityaṃśumānkāśyape varṇasaṃbhavapaṭalaḥ (aṣṭāśītitamaḥ)pītāśma tu ca pītā syāttadaśma cūrṇavatkṛtamtatsudhā karma raktaṃ syāt śaṃkhadaṇḍaṃ sitaṃ bhavetitarābhāsaśaktāḥ syuḥ sudhākarmasu suvrataḥsitaraktasamaṃ miśraṃ gauravaṃ ca mudāhṛtamsita kṛṣṇasamaṃ miśraṃ dhūmravarṇa mudāhṛtamsāraśaviridaṃ khyātaṃ varṇakarmasucoditamraktaṃ pītaṃ samaṃ miśraṃ bakulasya phalākṛtiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītasya dviguṇaṃ raktaṃ miśritaṃ cātiraktakamraktasya dviguṇaṃ pītamiśritaṃ gulavarṇakampītaṃ vedāṃśaraktāḍhyaṃ śapharasya nibhaṃ bhavetśvetasya dviguṇaṃ pītaṃ miśritaṃ piṃgalaṃ bhavetkṛṣṇasya dviguṇaṃ pītaṃ miśritaṃ cabusaṃnibhamharitālaṃ śyāmasamaṃ miśraṃ śukapakṣasamaṃ bhavetśyāmaṃ syāddharitālāḍhyaṃ kuṃkuṣṭhārītālārdhakamjambūphalasamanve tu varṇamityucyate mayākṛṣṇanīlasamaṃ miśraṃ keśavarṇamudāhṛtamkṛṣṇaṃ raktasamaṃ miśraṃ madhuvarṇamudāhṛtammānuṣāraktamādhikyaṃ varṇarūkṣaharītakīteṣu yaddravyamalpena bāhumānasamanvitamalpasāramiti khyātaṃ sārelpakalpitaṃ viduḥp. 377) ityaṃśumānkāśyape saṃkaravarṇapaṭalaḥ (ekonanavatitamaḥ)śailadā ṣaṣṭikāgarbhaṃ tridhā vai varṇalepanamupariṣṭāt paṭācchādya tasyordhve śarkaraṃ lipetbimbocitanibhaṃ lipya pratiṣṭhāṃ samyagācaretśarkarāṃ yavamānaṃ tu lipya cikkaṇalepanamśilāgarbhamiti khyātaṃ varṇabhinnastameva vācitraṃ vāpyardhacitraṃ vā pakveṣṭakā sudhānvitamśarkarādīni sarvāṇi śailaje tu yathā tathāevaṃ trividharītyā tu varṇagarbhamudāhṛtamjalaiḥ krameṇa varṇaṃ tu tribhiḥ kṛtvā tu lepayetsitabimbanibhaṃ caivaṃ sumiśraṃ ca tu pāṇḍuvatraktābhīti nibhasyātāṃ pāṇḍuvarṇaṃ prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kapitthasyaiva niryāsaiḥ tribandhaṃ tu prakalpayettaraṇādadhisādṛśyaṃ snigdhaṃ taṃ manturaṃ bhavetkalkamardanakāryaṃ tu kārayenmadhya vāriṇāsudhākarma jalopetaṃ gomahīṣaṃ ca carmayoḥjalapātaṃ vinā yatra * * kapitthakaṃ dvija !kalkaṃ ṣoḍaśadhā bhajya ṣaṭpaṃca caturaṃ tu vāsa kṛccikkaṇamālepaṃ kārayeddvijasattama !jalapāte sudhā dhārā pāte śarkarārdravatcikkaṇārhakabandhaṃ tu daśabhāgavibhājitecikkaṇe bandhakūlaṃ vā sitalepana karmaṇipāṇḍuvarṇasya bandhaṃ syāt triḥkṛtvā pāṇḍulepanambimbasvabhāvavarṇaṃ tu ṣaṭkṛtvā tu samālipetṣaḍvargeṣvādi varṇasya bandhamityumadāyatāḥdvitīyavarṇabandhaṃ syāt tadvadbandhanakaṃ tathāprathamādyucitairbandhaiḥ ṣaḍvarṇaṃ ca lipetkramātpravartaṃ ca ṣaḍaitāni varṇaṃ lepanakaṃ viduḥsarṣapāstaraṇaṃ yadvat tadvadbindumudāhṛtamtadurvaktra namākhyātaṃ tatoccaṃ tadvibhājitamṣaḍvarṇakramamevaṃ hi lepayettu parasparamityaṃśumānkāśyape varṇalepanakramapaṭalaḥ (navatitamaḥ)sarveṣāmatha bhaktānāṃ padaṃ vai tu caturvidhamsārūpyapada viprāśca caturbhedamudāhṛtamtathā sāmīpya devānāṃ mamacihnākṛtistu vābālā ca yauvanā vṛddhā tridhāvasthāḥ prakīrtitāḥteṣvāntavayaso petā bhaktā bālā iti smṛtāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadūrdhva vayasopetā vṛddhā iti bidurbudhāḥsthānakaṃ cāsanaṃ caiva yānanṛttaṃ tathaiva caābhaṃgasamabhaṃgaṃ vā hyatibhaṃgamiti tridhādvau dvau svajāticchihnaṃ tad hṛdāñjali karo'thavāhastaṃ rūkṣasamāyuktaṃ sthānakaṃ hyevamācaretlaṃbantu dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ hastaṃ pūrvavadeva hiṭaṃkaṃ dakṣiṇahaste tu pāśaṃ vāmakare dhṛtamnṛttaṃ trividhamuddiṣṭaṃ sātvikaṃ rājasaṃ yutāmvayasopetabhaktānāṃ yogyamityuditaṃ mayābhaktānāmudayaṃ cāpi mānaṃ kalpoktavadbhavetsa vakraṃ vāmapādaṃ tu padmapīṭhoparinyasetpaṃcaṣaṭsaptamātraṃ vā pīṭhāduddhṛtamānakam* * * * dvihastaṃ syāt sūci hikkāntamucyatetaddhaste korparaṃ nīvraṃ pṛṣṭhasūtrādyamaṃ viduḥmaṇibandhādhvasīmā syāllamba * * pralambayetsthitāṃghrinalakāmadhye brahmasūtraṃ pralambayettatsūtrāddakṣiṇe savya hasta * * * mātrakamlalāṭādgulphāntasūtrāntaṃ akṣāṃgulaṃ bhavetatho kukṣispṛśetsūtraṃ nāsāgre caiva saṃspṛśetuddhṛtaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu śeṣaṃ tadanukūlitamsavastraṃ vātha kaupīnaṃ kalpayetkalpavittamaḥsātvikaṃ nṛttamākhyātaṃ rājasaṃ śṛṇu suvrata !daśanandāṣṭamātraṃ vā pīṭhātpādoddhṛtaṃ bhavetdaṇḍahastaṃ vinā vāmahastaṃ vā makuṭīṃ spṛśetekaṃ vā dvitrimātraṃ vā pīṭhāduddhṛtapādakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāmasaṃ hyevamākhyātaṃ evaṃ syādbhaktalakṣaṇambhaktānāṃ mantramākhyātaṃ tenaivārcanamācaretityaṃśumānkāśyape bhaktalakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ekanavatitamaḥ)rudrasyaiva tu ṛkṣāṃśaṃ caṇḍeśamabhidhīyateśūlaṃ ca paraśuṃ khaḍgaṃ vajramaṃkuśameva cakheṭakaṃ bhindipālaṃ ca pāśaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ tathaiva cajaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktaṃ raudradṛṣṭisamanvitamvikrāntacaṇḍanāmnā tu suvikīrṇajaṭānvitamabhayaṃ śūlaparaśuṃ khaḍgaṃ vai dakṣiṇe karedvāpare tu caturdorbhiḥ hemābhaṃ siṃhavāhanam* * * * * daṃṣṭraṃ * * raudravadanānvitampāśāṃkuśaṃ ca vāme tu bhadrapīṭhoparisthitamkalau tu dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitamkṛṣṇābhaṃ vātha raktābhaṃ saumyanetrānanānvitambhaṃgaṃ ceddakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ kuṃcitaṃ tvitaraṃ sthitamvīracaṇḍeśanāmnā tu sthānakaṃ tvāsanaṃ tu vādakṣiṇaṃ śayitaṃ pādaṃ vāmalambimathāpi vāhṛdayāṃjalihastau vā ṭakamabhyantarocitamīṣaddakṣiṇapārśve tu lambitānanameva vāevaṃ caturvidhaṃ cādicaṇḍeśamabhidhīyatekanyasaṃ daśatālena sarvāṃgaṃ parikalpayetityaṃśumānkāśyape caṇḍeśa lakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (dvanavatitamaḥ)samāśramāyatāśraṃ ca viṣamāgraṃ tathaiva capaṃcāśraṃ ca ṣaḍaśraṃ ca saptāśraṃ cāṣṭakoṇakampūrvātpaścādudīcyantaṃ mānayetsakalasthalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhujenaiva tu jaṃghordhvau ghanaṃ vā pādamucyateviṣamāśre viśeṣo'sti taṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇuṣvathatadalpya dviguṇaṃ kṛtya tanmānaṃ tu mahābhujāḥtribhujeṣveva hastaṃ tu mānadaṇḍena mānayetyavādagrāvasānaṃ tu mānayettanmahābhujāḥkalāṃśaṃ vibhajennāhaṃ paṃcāṃśaṃ tasya vistṛtamśeṣaṃ dvayodaśāṃśaṃ tu vṛttasya tu bhujā bhavetvṛttamevaṃ samākhyātaṃ paṃcāśramadhunocyatekṣemamadhyamamārabhya yāvatpārśvasya madhyamvṛttabāhyagatāṃ caiṣāṃ mānayettu trikoṇavatbhujānteṣu mahāśāsu prāgagraṃ codagagrakamtrikoṇaṃ ca catuṣkoṇaṃ catvārastaṃ prasaṃbhavāvasvaśramevamākhyātaṃ śeṣaṃ yuktyā samācaretpaṃcamāṣaṃ tu pādaṃ syāt catuṣpādaṃ tu pāṭikātritayaṃ karṇamityuktaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ tu yojayetityaṃśumānkāśyape bhūmānavidhipaṭalaḥ (trinavatitamaḥ)tripaṃcadaṇḍamārabhya dvidvidaṇḍavivardhanātbhedaṃ grāmādi vistāramatyābhā samudāhṛtamyāvadaṣṭasahasrāntaṃ jātyekaṃ triṃśatirbhavetāyādi saṃpadārthaṃ tu daṇḍacchedaṃ vināyatambhānudviguṇamādhikyaṃ triśataṃ bhūsuradvija !viprairadhiṣṭhitaṃ vāstu tridhābhā samudāhṛtamsaptaṣaṭpaṃcasāhasraṃ chandobhedaṃ tridhā bhavettathaivāṣṭasahasraṃ ca jātibhedaṃ tridhā bhavetatyantābhāsa bhedaṃ ca navadhā dvijasattama !
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityaṃśumānkāśyape nālashāpanavidhi paṭalaḥ (saptamaḥ)ākāraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ caiva saṃkṣepācchṛṇu suvratasthāṇuḥ sthūṇaṃ ca pādaṃ ca paryāya vacanastvimeadhiṣṭhānasya tuṃgasya dviguṇaṃ vāṃghrituṃgakampādoccapaṃktī nandāṣṭabhāgaikaṃ vāṃghrituṃgakamtadardhaṃ vā tribhāgonacaturbhāgonameva vāprateruttarasīmāntaṃ (anyarāgha?) ṣālastaṃbhamucyatetuṃgaṃ saptāṣṭadhā bhajya navadharmāṃśameva vātanmūlatāramākhyātaṃ tattāraṃ tu tathā bhajetekādiṣoḍaśāntānāṃ talaṃ pratyevamācaretbrahmakāntamiti khyātaṃ vasvaśraṃ viṣṇukāntakamkaṇṭhamānena tanmūle vedāśraṃ tu prakalpayettayormadhyaṃ tu vasvaśraṃ ṣoḍaśāśramathāpi vārudrakāntamidaṃ khyātaṃ mūlādagraṃ tu vartulammūlādagraṃ yugāśraṃ tu madhyeṣṭāśraṃ taducyatetadūrdhve vṛttamevaṃ syāt tribhāgaṃ tuṃgasādṛśamdaṇḍaṃ sārdhadvidaṇḍaṃ vā mūle padmāsanodayamsapadmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu caraṇasthāpanaṃ kurucakravākalatādyaistu bhūṣitaṃ padmapādakammūlebhaṃ tatpramāṇena gajapādamudāhṛtamkuṃbhamaṃḍyādisaṃyuktaṃ tattanāmnā prakīrtitamkuṃbhamaṃḍyādisaṃyuktaṃ śuṇḍupādamudāhṛtamviṣkaṃbha karṇamānena staṃbhāgre caturaśrakamdaṇḍamānena tasyādho vasvaśraṃ parikalpayetcaturaśra samāyuktaṃ tasyādhastāttu pūrvavat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
