sanskrit: aṣṭābhirvardhayeddhīmān guṇavrāsaṃ vasubhirharettriṃśārdhavavaśeṣaṃ tu nandādi nidhayodbhavetāyādhikyaṃ vyayaṃ kṣīṇaṃ saṃpadāmāspadaṃ padamp. 289) vyādhirogabhayakleśaṃ vardhayeyuḥ parasparamvāreṣu sitaśaśī vṛddhiḥ guruvāre ca ṛddhidambhadrā caiva jayā pūrṇā tithayastu śubhāvahāḥkartṛjanmādinādhvāstu * * studinasīmakamvasunandadinaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ janmādi ca punaḥ punaḥviṣāya dvādaśaṃ lagnaṃ matyāvasura varjayetbhuktajanmadinadvāstu nāma ṛkṣavirodhikammeṣe ca mithune karkisiṃhataulikavṛścikegrāmādyārambhaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhārambhaṃ ca śobhanamgrāmārambhaṃ na kartavyaṃ viparītaṃ na kārayetp. 390) viprairadhiṣṭhitaṃ yattan malakṣmyā vidyate dvija !grāmāḥ syadanyavāsaṃ tu kuṭikā ceti kīrtitamsamastajāti saṃyuktaṃ krayavikrayakairyutamsāgarāṇāṃ tu pārśve tu sāgarānugatāyatamjale parvavadhaṃkastivane vā girisaṃgaresamastajāti saṃyuktaṃ sarvadravyasamanvitamprāgukta vidhinā vipra dikparicchedanaṃ kurusakalaṃ pādamevaṃ syāt pecakaṃ tu catuṣpadampaṃcaviṃśatyupapīṭhaṃ syāt ṣaḍviṃśatyupapīṭhakamṣaṇṇavatyādhikaṃ caiva śatabhadra mahāsanamp. 391) rasādhikaṃ ca paṃcāṃśaṃ * śata triyutaṃ bhavettritaṃ ca ṣaṭcaturyuktaṃ karṇauṣakamudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: susaṃhitapadaṃ caiva catvāriṃśaccatuṣpadamsanandapaṃcavedāṃśaṃ paṃcādaśaviśālakamvinyaṣaḍdviśataṃ paṃca * * koṣṭhasamanvitamnavaviṃśatikaṃ saptaśataṃ vipratikāntakamsaikāṣṭapaṃcayutaṃ cāṣṭaśataṃ tu viprāṇāmsaikāṣṭakādhikaṃ daśaśatamīśvarasya kārakamvinyāsārdhaṃ tu grāmāṇāṃ padaṃ ca triṃśataṃ bhavettadante tatsamābhāsaṃ savikalpāttadāntakamyugāṃśe sūtramadhye tu ojāṃśe padamadhyameekadvitricatuṣpaṃcadaṇḍaṃ vā vīthivistṛtambrahmavīthiriti khyātā nābhivīthīti cocyatetadeva jaghanaṃ vīthi rathavīthirihocyatetiryagdvārasamāyuktā yā sā nārā ca saṃjñitāvīthīnārācakādīnāṃ pathanāmnā praśaṃsitājane vīthervaṣṭhā ca gṛhakarmasukhāvahamtasmādyatheṣṭaśaileṣu diṣṭamāne gṛhaṃ kuruprathamadhyapathāgre ca karmabāhye gṛhonnatamnandyāvartaparāgaṃ ca padmakaṃ śrī pratiṣṭhitamdaṇḍākāraikavīthī syāt prāṅmukhaṃ vāpyudaṅmukhammukhe mukhe viniṣṭhāntaṃ yattaddaṇḍakamucyatekarkarī daṇḍakaṃ hyevaṃ caturdigveśmanirgamamparjanyāṃśe ca pūṣāṃśe dauvārike tathaiva cajanavīdhyāvasānaṃ tu tarhivīthī dvijottama !śrīkaraṃ daṇḍakaṃ hyetat sarveṣāṃ daṇḍasaṃpadamprāgagraṃ guṇavīthī syādudagagraṃ tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalpitaṃ prastaraṃ khyātaṃ sarvabhedā dvijottama !prāgagraṃ vedavīthī syāt udagagraṃ tathaiva catrayodaśapadaṃ vātha prakīrṇaṃ navadhā bhavetbhallāṭasyāṃgake caiva praveśaṃ parikalpayetmanu vā ṣaṭkalā vā yat saptādaśa padaṃ tu vāmahendrādiṣvaṃśakeṣu praveśaṃ tu prakīrṇavateka vīthyā trayoviṃśat dantaṃ parāgamaṣṭadhāparjanyāṃśentarikṣāṃśe puṣya * * * * śakeupadvārāṣṭako petaṃ parāgaṃ cedi vidyateaṣṭāviṃśatikaṃ yāvat tāvadekavivardhanātetadvārāṣṭakopetā upadvārāṣṭakānvitādaṇḍakādyaṣṭavastrāṇāṃ bhedaṃ vai hinakā tathābhūtavedāṃśakaṃ kṛtvā nagasaptadaśāṃśakammānasūtrādbahirvipra ! syāntaraṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ bhavettripaṃca saptahastaṃ vā navarudrakaraṃ tu vātricatuḥpaṃcaṣaṭsapta vasvagraṃ vā viśeṣataḥśilābhiriṣṭakābhirvā mudrā vā parikalpayetupacasyāparadvāra vapraśīrṣakamācaretlakṣaṃ samālipedūrdhve iṣṭakāmastayorapitadbāhyābhyantare caiva khallurīveṣṭamānataḥtadbāhye iṣṭakānena pracārabhūmyā vṛtaṃ bhavetvaprasyābhyantare vipra ! devatāsthāpanaṃ bhavetparikhāyāstu sāhye ca tvasaṃkalpya dvijottamabhūtāṃge viṣṇugehaṃ syāt sugrīve sugatālayammandurālayaṃ tu vāyavye sukhye kanyāyanigraham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evameṣu śivaharmyaṃ syāt saunāśāntare'pi vāvāruṇāṃśe tu vā vipra ! kartavyaṃ śivamandiramabhyantaramukho viṣṇuḥ vivasvānpaścimānanamsūtre saṃdhau catuṣke ca śūlaśaivāṣṭake'pi vāvāpīkūpataṭākādi sarvatra parikalpayetbāhye śakre kulālānāṃ nāpitānāṃ tu śāṃkarematsyopajīvanānāṃ tu paścime vāsa ucyatevapra bāhye tvabāhye vā karmakārādayonilemahendrādagnibhāgaṃ syāt bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca vikrayamuttare lavaṇaṃ caiva tailaṃ candanapuṣpakamśāṃkare paribāhye tu śatadaṇḍe śmaśānakamapaṇaṃ mānasūtraṃ tu bāhye sālāntaraṃ bhavetgrāmādi lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ gṛhavinyāsakaṃ śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape grāmādilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (caturnavatitamaḥ)dāravānmṛṇmayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mṛṇmayācchailamuttamamtāmrajaṃ śilairvā kuryāt berāyāmaṃ tadardhāyāmamuttamam* * * * * * * * guṇāṃśamadhamaṃ tathāprakāraṃ pāpanāśaṃ syāt tikāraṃ śāntikaṃ viduḥmūlaberasya mānaṃ tu ālayāṃśena kārayetdvyaṃśenaiva kartavyaṃ pratimānāṃ tu kārayetardhāṃśenottamaṃ vidyāt tṛtīyāṃśaṃtu madhyamamuttamaṃ madhyamaṃ vāpya dhamaṃ vātha kanyasamyuktāyuktaṃ vicāryātha pratimānāṃ ca kārayetbrahmāṇaṃ vajrapāṇiṃ ca śūlapāṇiṃ ca vaiṣṇavamlepite yatklinnaṃ syāt ekarātroṣite tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāsīsaṃ pītalodhraṃ ca gokṣīreṇa tu ṣeṣayetdivasaissakthubhiścaiva ekarātroṣitaṃ tathāpṛthvītraśūlinī brāhmaṃ mahīṃ kṣīraṃ ca ṣeṣitamkṛṣṇamano bhavettatra kṛkalāsamathāpi vāetāni śliṣṇayitvā tu strīstanyenaiva poṣayetkālakūṭaviṣaṃ tatra na tu hastena saṃspṛśetśilā sthāpayitvā tu bhuvaṃ paścāt samīpataḥgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyameva catato'sya pūrvabhāge tu homakarma samārabhettatkarṇadviguṇāṃśaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ vārdhameva vāgarbhagehasya vistāraṃ kuḍyaṃ garbhasamaṃ tu vāagnivyāsamiti khyātaṃ prāgvat * * tu śaktikāttena dvitricaturguṇyaṃ garbhagehasya vistarampūrvavadbhittikākhyātaṃ nāhaṃ rudrāṃśakasya tutenaiva dviguṇāṃśaṃ vā triguṇaṃ vā caturguṇampaṃcabhāgaikabhāgaṃ vā agnyaṃśeṃśamathāpi vāpūjāṃśocce yugāśraṃ tu dviguṇe vā yugāśrakepaṃcāṃguṇaṃ tu vā garbhageha vyāsamudāhṛtamśāntikābhyudayaṃ khyātaṃ pūrvavaddvijasattama !karṇapīṭhatataṃ khyātaṃ taddvayaṃ garbhavistṛtamtricatuṣpaṃca bhāgeṃśaṃ kuḍyasya vyāsamucyatemaṃcāṃśaṃ caturaśrābhe karṇapīṭha viśālakamnāligehaṃ viśālaṃ syāt tadardhaṃ kuḍyavistṛtamagnibhāgaikabhāgaṃ vā garbhakuḍyaṃ tu pūrvavattatkarṇaṃ tu daśāṃśena piṇḍikā vyāsamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nālīgṛhaviśālaṃ syāt tasyārdhaṃ bhitti vistṛtamkuṭṭimasya viśālaṃ tu tuṃgaṃ pūrvavadeva hitena dvitriguṇaṃ vāpi nālīgehaviśālakamśāntikābhyudayaṃ prāgvat kartavyaṃ hi viśeṣataḥdviguṇaṃ dviguṇārdhaṃ vā triguṇaṃ piṇḍikā tataḥpīṭhavyāsasamaṃ sārdhadviguṇaṃ dviguṇārdhakampūjāṃśasyaiva dviguṇaṃ pīṭha vyāsamudāhṛtamtadardhaṃ tripādamagnyaṃśaṃ bhittivyāsamudāhṛtamhīne hīnapramāṇeṣu dvantareṣṭavibhājitekuḍyavyāsaṃ ca harmyaiśca kartavyaṃ navadhā dvija !sādhāraṃ vā nirādhāraṃ prāgukta vidhinā kururatnalohajaliṃgānāṃ pīṭhanālīgṛhāyatamsthūlamūlaṃ śiraḥ sthūlaṃ madhyasthūlaṃ tu ārṣakampāṣāṇaṃ ca śiromānaṃ vinā tuṃgaṃ tu saṃgṛhetteṣvekāṃśakalāṃśeṃśaṃ liṃgamadhyāttu dakṣiṇeprāsādamadhyasūtraṃ ca dvāramadhyaṃ tadeva hiyena liṃgena yanmānaṃ nirmitaṃ sadanasya tusa pādaṃ sārdhapādonadviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ tu vātripādaṃ vā tribhāgaikaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva hivesare nṛttamūrtīnāṃ raudrāṇāṃ yānamūrtināmviparītaṃ na kartavyaṃ sarvodaya phalārthibhiḥityaṃśumānkāśyape liṃgaprāsādapaṭalaḥ (paṃcanavatitamaḥ)jīrṇadehaṃ tyajeddehī tadanyaṃ paripaṭhyatetasmācchīghraṃ prayatnena jīrṇoddhāraṃ samācaretprakāraṃ parivāraṃ vā jīrṇāste tu sa lakṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṃjaraṃ kūṭakoṣṭhaṃ vā mahānāsyalpameva vāyadaṃgaṃ teṣu vicchinnaṃ tadaṃgaṃ prāgvadācarettāṃstyaktvādyeṣṭakādīni prathamāraṃbhavatkurumohāddhīne tu vādhikye karturvittāyuṣakṣayamtasmātsarvaprayatena sadanaṃ prāgvadācaretpunaśśāstroktamārgeṇādhika mānādibhiryutampūrvamānādiṣu kṣīṇaṃ punaḥ karma na kārayetparivārālayaṃ pīṭhaṃ prākāraṃ gopuraṃ tathāpurā sumānanīyāpi punaḥ karmādhikaṃ śubhamprāgvacca sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā saṃprokṣaṇamathācarettadaṃgaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā sthāpanaṃ samyagācaretnalakādiṣu vicchinne pādayorhastayo'stu vāabdatrayaṃ tu tallohaṃ khātvā bhūmau viśeṣataḥmṛṇmaye varṇahīne tu punaḥ kṛtvā tu pūrvavattattadaṃgaṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ śūlaṃ caiva tathaiva hitadeva saṃgṛheddhīmān doṣāḍhyaṃ parivarjayetvyapohya liṃgapīṭhaṃ ca sthāpayet pūrvavadbudhaḥārṣe ca pauruṣe vāpi pūrvamevā kṛtālayekalpayetpaṃcasālānāṃ bāhye bāhyantare'pi vāmahāmaryādi sālasyā bhyantare tu na kārayetmahāmaryādi bāhye tu gatvālayaṃ prakalpayetmaryādermahāśāyāṃ bāhye vā prāgvadantaramkalahaṃsasya nāśaṃ ca sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥkartavyaṃ vijayāyuṣyaṃ putrapautrādivardhanammūlavastu samīkṣyaivaṃ kalpayetkalpavittamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parivāravihīnaṃ tu kalpitaṃ kanyasāntarammūlagehercitaṃ devaṃ cānyaṃ vā tatra pūjayetgāṇavāddevikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tasmātsvāyaṃbhuvaṃ varamphalārthibhiḥ kalpitaṃ tadanukarma dvijottama !ityaṃśumānkāśyape jīrṇoddhārapaṭalaḥ (ṣaṇṇavatitamaḥ)caturaśrāṃ śilāṃ samyak chedayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥsa garbhāntaṃ vijānīyādyatnena tu parīkṣyatepītakoyāsitā sarpaṃ khadyotamadhuvarṇakaiḥraktamaṇḍalikaṃ tatra citravarṇena vṛścikāchāyāścāyād dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇe cakleśo'rtha lābho maraṇaṃ sukhamaiśvaryameva camadhyakoṇaṃ tathā rajju dvārapārśve tu varjayetdevālaye ca cāgneyyāṃ viśeṣeṇa vidhīyateadhomukhaṃ nirīkṣyāṇi pūjitāni viśeṣataḥpakṣacchidrāṇi riktāṃ ca varjayet kṛṣṇa ṛkṣakamguruśukrajñavāreṣu somavāreṣu khānayetevameva vidhānena kūpanyāsavidhikramamabhayā varadopetāḥ ṭaṃkaśūlasamanvitāḥaruṇābhāṃjanaprakhyaṃ kramādvarṇa pramāṇakamāyudhānāṃ mukhaṃ dīrghaṃ kārayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥpūrṇamuṣṭistu nāhaṃ syāt kārayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥliṃge bere tathā cānye pīṭhe vā pūjayecchivamtayostu pīṭhamākhyātaṃ kalpayet kalpavittamaḥdvāraṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa paścimaṃ muktidaṃ guha* * * * * * * * pūrvādi parikalpitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svāyaṃbhūrdevikaṃ bāṇaṃ sarvadevadigāśrayamberaṃ caiva tathai * haṃ devike cārṣake'pi vāsaudhajenaiva sidhyarthaṃ śailajaṃ muktidaṃ paramsthānakaṃ cāsanaṃ yānaṃ nṛttarūpaṃ tathaiva casthānakaṃ cāsanākhyaṃ ca tāmasaṃ śayanaṃ guha !liṃge caiva viśeṣeṇa sthānakāsanakaṃ śṛṇuyā karma śivaṃ jñeyaṃ evaṃ tadbhedamucyateliṃgaberavaśāddhāma kārayedvā vijāyatetriṇetraṃ caturbhujaṃ vāpi dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ tu vāpaṃcavaktrayuto vāpi śatasāhasrameva vāekapādaṃ dvipādaṃ vā tripādaṃ sahasrameva vānīlavarṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇamevaṃ vidhīyatenāgakhaḍgāyudho vāpi śūlapāśāyudho'pi vānirāyudhakaro vāpi evamevaṃ tu kārayetjaṭāgre jāhnavīṃ caiva tridhārūpaṃ tu meva vāharyardhaṃ girijārdhaṃ vā kalpayettu mahāśivamvāme tu girijārdhaṃ syād dakṣiṇe rudrarūpakamviṣṇuṃ prajāpatiṃ caiva dhanado vijayo'pi vāprāgvacca sthāpayedvāpi kārayeddvividhā mataḥtayoryogapratiṣṭhāṃ cet sakalaṃ bhittimāśritamcalaliṃgaṃ tu vā vatsa ! pūjayecchivasaṃnidhaupaṭṭikāntaṃ galāntaṃ vā homāntaṃ kumudāntakampūrve vā cottare vāpi nālasthānaṃ vadāmyahamadhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā śaktimārgeṇaiva tu kārayetnāgaraṃ drāviḍaṃ vāpi vesaraṃ caturāyatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vistāradviguṇottuṃgaṃ alpya harmyeti cocyatenāsikārahito vāpi vāhanaṃ rahito'pi vādiṅmūrtirahitaṃ vāpi ebhimūrtirathāpi vānānānāsisamāyuktaṃ nānāyonisamākulamberasyocchrārdhamānāśca mānenaivāsanaṃ guruḥmekhalatrayasaṃyuktaṃ dalāṣṭakasamanvitamarcārūpamidaṃ proktaṃ pūjābhāganna vidyateāvahanodvahaṃ noktaṃ pūjayetprati saṃdhiṣuyuge yugeṣu pe vatsa pūjāṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥpūjayeddeva deveśaṃ anyatantrairnakārayetrathāṃgānāṃ catuṣkaṃ ca dvayaṃ tatraiva kīlakamrathāṃgaṃ ca trayaṃ pūrvaṃ kīlake bhatrayaṃ tathāpaścādrathāṃgaṃ pīṭhaṃ ca kramādakṣāṇi vinyasettvak sthāne śāstu mandārā sthitā tatra vināśadātadigbhāgarathāṃge tu bhinnaṃ bhavati bhūtaleraviluptakarā nīcāḥ tasya bhaṃgaṃ vinirdiśetkṣīṇe nīcārimūḍhasthāḥ candrayoge dhruvaṃ phalamrathacakraṃ vijānīyād dārubhindanna saṃśayaḥrathacakraṃ naraṃ hanti rajjubhīnnaṃ na saṃśayaḥrathārohe dhvajārohe care cobhaya rāśiṣukaroti vasudhā nāśaṃ taddvāre'pi śuyāsataḥcāvasthitaḥ sakala pāpāḥ śubhakarāḥrathānāṃ yātrā syuḥ śucini nidhane paṃcama padebhāryārtha hānimrathamāyāti tacchīghraṃ śaratkāle ca bhānuvat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tanmadhye paṭṭaṃ vasvaśraṃ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ tadudāhṛtammulādagraṃ yugāśraṃ syāt tripaṭṭaṃ kṣepaṇānvitamstaṃbhatāratribhāgaikaṃ caturbhāgaikameva vāstaṃbhamūle tu padmādīn staṃbhamānena kalpayetityaṃśumānkāśyape staṃbhalakṣaṇa paṭalaḥ (aṣṭamaḥ)mūlapādasamavyāsaṃ śreṣṭhamadhyena madhyamamvistārasadṛśotsedhaṃ paṃcadaṇḍāyatānvitamcaturdaṇḍāyato petā madhyamā sā prakīrtitākanyasā bodhikā khyātā tvaṃghrīyo bodhikānvitāmadhyemaṃśe taraṃgasyā latādyairbhūṣitaṃ tu vādaṇḍaṃ tripādamardhaṃ vā chāyāmānaṃ ca dagrayoḥadhastādbodhikāṃśena alaṃkāraṃ vadāmyahampārśvayorubhayoḥ śeṣaṃ taraṃgasthānamucyatepārśvayostu taraṃgaḥ syāt samāścānyonyahīnakamtannivrasadṛśaṃ vyāsaṃ saṃbhojakārakalpitamūrdhvapadmamathāṃśena karṇamardhena kārayetadhaḥsthāmbujamardhāṃśaṃ kalpayettu krameṇa tuagraniṣkrāmayuktaṃ vā chatrākāramathāpi vābhūtaiśca makarairvyālaiḥ nāṭakādyairvibhūṣitambodhyagrayostaraṃgaḥ syāt tanmadhye daṇḍamānataḥnānācitrairalaṃ kṛtya bodhikā citrabodhikāmahārṇavataraṃgābhān taraṃgāṃstu prakalpayetcaturaśrāṣṭavṛttānāṃ kramātsādhāraṇaṃ tu vāagrapādasamaṃ tāraṃ tripādaṃ tuṃgamucyateadhasthādvīrakāṇḍasya phalakālakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cidyaḥ syācchadilagnage rathapatibhūmau niveśastathācakraṃ nipatitaṃ bhūmau kīlena saha bhidyaterathamāyāti tacchīghraṃ śaratkāle ca bhānuvatnighnanti rajjukīlādyaiḥ taccakraṃ ca patedbhuvivināśayati tacchīghraṃ cakraṃ kīlena rajjubhiḥāditye sabale kendre na gacchati * kaṃ patiḥtriṣaḍāyagatāḥ pāpāḥ rathaṃ samyak pravartatekartā maraṇamāyāti sa rāṣṭraṃ nāśayatyasauvināśatī ca taccakraṃ sarathaṃ rajjunā sahakendra trikoṇage pāpe śubhaṣaṣṭhāntyago yadikendra trikoṇage mande dvādaśāṣṭamago yadikendre candre gurau koṇe bhṛṇu saumya nirīkṣitedvādaśe navame pāpe pāpalagne śubhekṣitepīṭhe rāhusamāyukte rathāṃge śanisaṃgatepīṭhe dinamaṇau bhaume rathāṃge pāpasaṃyuteacirādrathayānaṃ syāt pīṭhe de * ndu pūjiteprācyāṃ vai sthāpite pīṭhe śrīkaraṃ ceti kīrtitampaścime sthāpite pīṭhe śrībhadramiti kīrtitamprācyāṃ śrīkarasya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu vṛddhayeśrībhadrasya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ vaiśyānāṃ ca vivṛddhayeevameva prakāreṇa caturdvāre viśeṣataḥpīṭhasyādhipatīnāṃ tu pūrvādīnāṃ yathākramamtribhāgaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ dvibhāgamadhamaṃ smṛtamdvārārdhamadhamaṃ vidyāt utsedha samavistṛtambhāgenopānakoccaṃ tu caturbhirjagatī bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karṇaṃ kuryāttribhāgaiḥ ekenaivordhva paṭṭikākarṇikā caikabhāgena proktamutsedhamuttamamsamastāṃśamupānantu manvaṃśaṃ jagatī tathāaṣṭāṃśaṃ kaṇṭhavistāraṃ daśāṃśaṃ cordhvapaṭṭikā* * * * * * * * trayaṃśena tu karṇikāsthāpanānte tvathaitāni pūjayet tu viśeṣataḥtripādaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ dvāratuṃgārdhakanyasamdviguṇaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ triguṇaṃ śreṣṭhamucyatedvihastaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ trihastaṃ śreṣṭhamucyateupānoccaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syāt ṣaḍaṃśaṃ jagatī bhavetvedāṃśaṃ karṇamānaṃ tu ūrdhvakaṃpaṃ śivāṃśakamvedāṃśaṃ padmatuṃgaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ karṇikodayampadmoccaṃ paṃcabhāgaṃ tu mahāpaṭṭī dvibhāgataḥantarmaṇḍalamadhye tu bhityāśrayamathāpi vāadhamaṃ dviguṇaṃ madhyaṃ triguṇaṃ cottamonnatamvistārasamatuṃgaṃ syāt tripādaṃ cārdhameva vāekamekhalayā yuktaṃ ūrdhve padmasamanvitammātṝṇāṃ navapīṭhaṃ syāt jyeṣṭhāyāṃ pīṭhakatrayamantarmaṇḍaladeśe tu indrādi balipīṭhakamantarmaṇḍalatārasya sadṛśaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu vātasyāstu madhyame bhāge parivārāṣṭa vinyasetyasya vistārapacata āyāmaṃ ca vidhīyatetribhāgenādhikaṃ caiva dviddhaṃ paṃcārdhamādhikamdviguṇārdhaṃ tu āyāmaṃ gopureṣu vidhīyatemūlaharmyaṃ samārabhya ṣaḍaṣṭadaṇḍamānataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣoḍaśāṣṭādaśo vāpi mahāpīṭhaṃ prakalpayettṛtīya sāle catuṣpaṃcasāle caiva tu madhyamemūladhāmasya dvāroccaṃ uttamaṃ pīṭhavistṛtamśuddhadvārasya vistāraṃ adhamaṃ pīṭhavistṛtamtadvistārasamaṃ tuṃgaṃ kṛtvā caivāṣṭaviṃśatikumudoccaṃ tu bhūtāṃśaṃ kaṃpamekāṃśamucyatemahāpaṭṭī guṇāṃśaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ vā viśeṣataḥupānoccaṃ śivāṃśena dvibhāgaṃ karṇikodayampadmoccaṃ paṃcabhāgaṃ tu mahāpaṭṭī dvibhāgayāathavā pīṭhodayaṃ vipra dharātalaṃ yathā kuruadhiṣṭhānoktamārgeṇa veśaniṣkrāntamācaretpīṭhāgāraṃ yugāśraṃ vā vṛttaṃ vāṣṭāśrameva vālohajaṃ śailajaṃ vātha iṣṭakāmayameva vābhūtaiśca makarairvyālaiḥ vṛṣabhaiśca vibhūṣitampīṭhavyāse tu ṣaṭsapta vasunandāṃśake'pi vātadūrdhve tu mahāpīṭhaṃ uktavasyodayānvitamāmodaṃ prāgdale caiva pramodo yāmyadigdaleavighnastvīśadigbhāge vighnakartāramānaletāmasaṃ karṇikāmadhye nīlarudrasvarūpakamtatsarvātmakamityuktaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ dvijottama !vṛṣasthāne kumāraṃ tu kaumāre vṛṣabhaṃ nyasetparivāravidhiḥ proktaḥ paścālliṃgasya lakṣaṇamcampakā devadāruśca stavakā jāti bilvakamprāsādasya samaṃ vāpi prāsādagrīvameva vādvitala tritalāntaṃ vā daṇḍasyotsedhamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aśvatthaṃ khādiraṃ caiva nyagrordhasāra tiṃtriṇīmadhūkasāravṛkṣaṃ ca dhvajadaṇḍamihocyatedaṇḍamānamiti proktaṃ dhvajadaṇḍamihocyategehagopurayormadhye balipīṭhaṃ tu vinyasetmahatyalpaṃ ca dvividhaṃ dhvajamuttuṃgamiṣyatestūpyantaṃ śikharāntaṃ ca nāsikāntaṃ galāntakamhastārdhapādahīnaṃ tu ekahastāvasānakammūlaprāsādavistāraṃ tatsamaṃ vā tripādakamgopurātpūrvā parāntaṃ tu prāsādasamameva vāhasta tripaṃcasaptābhi navahastāntameva vāekāṃśaṃ padmatuṃgaṃ tu kampamaṃśāṃśamambujammadhokaṃpapadmāṃśaṃ proktaṃ vedāṃśaṃ kaṇṭhamucyateekapatrapadmamadhā kampamaṃśaṃ mathakarṇikācakraṃ vāpi triśūlaṃ vā prāsāda syārdhameva vāekādi navahastāntaṃ mānanirṇayamiṣyatenārāyaṇyamekabhūmaṃ pradhānamārṣakaṃ sthānakaṃ caiva svāyaṃbhuvamathāsanamdevikaṃ yānakaṃ proktaṃ evaṃ lakṣaṇamucyateyānakaṃ tvaśramevoktaṃ aṣṭāśraṃ śayanaṃ bhavetvṛttapīṭhasthitā gaurī bhadrapīṭhaṃ tu cāsanamāmodaśca pramodaśca pramukho vimukhastathāvistārastambhato bāhye janmāt stūpyantamunnatamdaivikaṃ tu bhavādīnāṃ indrādīnāṃ tu mānuṣamvasūnāṃ bāṇaliṃge tu vidyeśānāṃ tu daivikambhavaśśarvastatheśānaḥ paśupatirnīlalohitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ aruṇaṃ bhinnāṃjanaprabhamabhayavaradāḥ sarve pāśāṃkuśa caturbhujāḥjaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktā mūrtirūpāḥ prakīrtitāḥathavā daṇḍamānena mūlaṃ prāsādamārabhetrudratrayodaśāntaṃ vā daśapaṃcasusaptakampaṃcabhāgadvibhāgaṃ tu saptabhāge tribhāgikampūrvaṃ śūnyaviśālaṃ cet yathāśobhaṃ yathā ruciantarmaṇḍala sālādimadhyagopuramadhyataḥpradhāna svagradeśasthā dhvajaṃ tatsaṃkhyayā matāḥūrdhvāgraṃ tatprakartavyaṃ athavā randhramucyatebāṇaratnādikaṃ caiva devī pīṭhasya lakṣaṇamrandhrasyaiva dvibhāgena tanmūle bhramare likhetdaśāṃśaṃ sikatairyuktaṃ paṃcāṃśaṃ bandhayet kramāttanmānaṃ padavistāraṃ aṣṭabandhaṃ tathocyatejīrṇaberaṃ tu na tyājyaṃ pūjitaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavetmohena pūjanaṃ kuryāt tatkartā maraṇaṃ vrajettābhireva punardevyā yojyānanya sṛjet punaḥliṃge jīrṇe punaḥ sṛṣṭe yoge prācyā patisthitaḥnodvāhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ santadevāsu pūjanepīṭhasya jīrṇite satti pīṭhamātraṃ parityajetbhogavīraṃ tathā prācyā yojyānanyat sṛjet punaḥdaivikaṃ cārṣakaṃ caiva gāṇavaṃ mānuṣaṃ tathādīrghākāraṃ bhavelliṃgaṃ nimnonnatasamanvitampārvatāgrākṛtiṃ liṃgaṃ vahvagraṃ tvagrataḥ śikhāityetairlakṣaṇairyuktaṃ liṃgaṃ daivikamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhyasthūlaṃ tu liṃgānāṃ nālikeraphalākṛtiliṃgamārṣakamākhyātaṃ brahmasūtravivarjitamurvārukaphalākāraṃ kapitthasya phalākṛtidvāraṃ vā garbhamānaṃ vā hastamānamathāpi vāekavarṇaṃ susaṃsnigdhaṃ brahmasūtrasamanvitamatha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa śivarātriṃ supūjayetyuge yuge tu saṃpūjya kṛtāyāṃ tu guho yajetbrahmendra ṛṣibhiścaiva kalau saṃpūjito haraḥcaitramāse trayodaśyāṃ vaiśākhe kṛṣṇapaṃcamīdvādaśyāṃ śrāvaṇe caiva pūrvāṣāḍhe tu paṃcamīdvādaśyābhārdramāse tu puṣyamāse tu saptamīmāghamāse caturdaśyāṃ tatphalaṃ śivarātrikamśivaṃ saṃpūjya tadrātrau tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥtasmāt sarvaprayatnena sarvarātrau viśeṣataḥtadrātrau śivarātriḥ syāddevasānnidhyameva catasmāt sarvaprayatnena sarvamāsaṃ krameṇa tuyāmaṃ prativiśeṣeṇa śivapūjāṃ viśeṣataḥaṃkurāṇyarpayet paścāt pūrvokta vidhinā sahapaṃcagavyena saṃpūjya kautukaṃ bandhayet tataḥvastreṇa veṣṭayeddhīmān bilapatrādhivāsanampūrvāhne tarpaṇaṃ caiva madhyāhne tu pradakṣiṇambrahmakṣattriya viṭchūdrā upavāsasamanvitāḥsarvāsāṃ caiva nārīṇāṃ upavāsaṃ tathaiva cayatphalaṃ sarvasiddhiṃ ca iṣṭakāmyaṃ tathaiva caamaṃgalyopavāsī ca punarjanma sumaṃgalī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iṣṭakāmyaphalaṃ kāmyaṃ śivarātryupavāsaketasmāt sarvaprayatnena upavāsamanidrakambrāhmaṇairmunibhissārdhaṃ deśikassaṃprapūjayetśālibhiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥtṛtīye snānamāpyaṃ tu ikṣusāraṃ caturthakepūrve tu snapanaṃ proktaṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ bhavettṛtīye snapanaṃ caiva paṃcaviṃśati saṃkhyayāyāmaṃ prati viśeṣeṇa snapanaṃ kārayedbudhaḥdvitīye padmapuṣpaiśca tṛtīye jātipuṣpakaiḥcatussaṃdhyārcanaṃ kuryāt bilvapatraissamanvitamtṛtīye kṛsarānnaṃ syāt śuddhānnaṃ syāccaturthakeyāmaṃ prativiśeṣeṇa balihomaṃ samācaretnityaṃ namāmi manasā mahanīyakīrtitamtatsarvamamba tava rūpamanusmarāmi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityaṃśumānkāśyape bodhikālakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (navamaḥ)tridaṇḍaṃ phalakāvyāsaṃ kanyasārdhādhikaṃ samamathavā phalakāvyāsaṃ kuṃbhakarṇasamaṃ bhavettadutsedhaṃ tridhābhajya ūrdhvāṃśotsaṃdhirucyatenāgavaktrasamākāraṃ āpotrātpādarūpavatphalakeva prakartavyā tasyādhastādghaṭaṃ kurusapādadaṇḍatuṃgaṃ vā ghaṭoccaṃ tu caturvidhamyathā krameṇa nāmāni kalaśānāṃ kramoditamvedāṃśaṃ kalaśotsedhaṃ kaṇṭhamekāṃśamānataḥardhena vṛttamardhena hīnau saṃkalpayedbudhaḥevamuccaṃ samākhyātaṃ niṣkaṃbhamadhunā śṛṇuāsyaṃ karṇaṃ viśeṣeṇa kuṃbhasyaiva tu vistṛtamtasyādholaśunaṃ mūlatuṃgadaṇḍaikamānataḥabjāthasvardhadaṇḍena vaktrasthānamudāhṛtamlaśunaṃ cābjapatraṃ ca muktādāma tathaiva caathavā bodhikādīnāṃ udayaṃ tu vadāmyahamūrdhvabhāgaṃ tu saṃgrāhya dvāviṃśatyaṃśakaṃ bhavetbhūtāṃśaṃ phalakotsedhaṃ ghṛtamānāṃśakaṃ bhavettadāsyodayamekāṃśaṃ padmamekena kārayetlaśunābjalatā muktāmālāmānādi pūrvavatityaṃśumānkāśyape stambhabhūṣaṇa paṭalaḥ (daśamaḥ)adhiṣṭhānopariṣṭhāttu staṃbhamūle tu kalpayetadhyardhadaṇḍamānaṃ tu kanyasā vedikāmadhamathavānya prakāreṇa vedikotsedhamucyateekāṃśaṃ vedikāmānaṃ kramācchreṣṭhāntarādhamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrdhve bhūmyaṃghri tuṃgaṃ tu saptabhāgaṃ vibhājitetricatuḥpaṃcabhāgaṃ tu galotsedhaṃ vibhājiteāpetotsedhāṃśamānaṃ vā galamūle tu vedikāgalordhve kaṃpamekāṃśaṃ ekenābjaṃ prakalpayetsaptāṃṣṭāṃśe tu vedyucce vedabhūtaṃ kramādgalamkarṇamānena tanmūle kaṃpamekena kalpayetadhyardhāṃśaṃ tu vā padmaṃ tuṃgaṃ dvyaṃśamathāpi vāsarvāsāṃ vedikānāṃ tu galamaṃghrivibhūṣitamprastaroparivedīnāṃ veśanaṃ śṛṇu suvrata !caturbhāgaikaveśaṃ vā * * * * * * * *evaṃ vānyaprakāreṇa vedikā vistṛtaṃ śṛṇuṣaṭsaptāṣṭanavāṃśaṃ vā daśabhāgaṃ tu vā bhajetyugāśravedikākārā nāgare prastaropariathavā vesare harmye vedikā vṛttameva vāvedikālakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ śṛṇu jālākalakṣaṇamityaṃśumānkāśyape vedikālakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ekādaśa)pādavarge gale caiva jālakasthānamucyatevātāyanaṃ prakartavyaṃ anena vidhinā budhaḥvedikājālakārdhaṃ tu chedyaṃ sarvavināśanamdvidaṇḍaṃ kanyasaṃ vyāsaṃ tridaṇḍaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetvistārasadṛśotsedhād ekadaṇḍa vivardhanāteṣu tuṃgaviśāleṣu yadiṣṭaṃ tatparigrahetvistārārdha ghanaṃ vyāsaṃ tricaturthāṃśameva vāyugmapādasamāyuktaṃ yugmakaṃ penamucyatepuṣpaghaṇḍaṃ rasakaṇṭhaṃ ca jālakaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 48) yugāśraṃ kaṇṭhagacchidraṃ hastinetramudāhṛtamnandyāvartasya puṣpābhaṃ nandyāvartamudāhṛtampuṣpakhaṇḍaṃ ca karṇaṃ ca nandyāvartamivākṛtiḥyugmāyugmakavāṭaṃ vā ghāṭanādghāṭanakṣamamlohaidrumotpalairdravyaiḥ veṣṭakābhistu jālakamjālakaṃ hyevamākhyātaṃ tatastoraṇalakṣaṇamityaṃśumānkāśyape jālakalakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (dvādaśa)pādodaye daśāṃśe tu saptāṃśaṃ caraṇodayamnavāṃśe pādatuṃgaṃ tu ṣaḍaṃśaṃ caraṇāyatampaṃcāṃśaṃ caraṇottuṃgaṃ jhaṣotsedhaṃ guṇāṃśakamtoraṇasyaiva pādbāhye vyāsamevaṃ caturvidhamanena vidhinā vāpi kartavyaṃ bhittibāhyaketṛtīyaṃ citrasaṃjñā tu trividhaṃ toraṇākṛtiḥpatratoraṇamākhyātaṃ tatomakaramucyatemadhye pūrīsasaṃyuktaṃ nānāvidhalatānvitamtadeva pārśvayormadhye purīmasya dvayorapisiṃhebhavyālahaṃsādyaiḥ pālāsraṃ muktadāmakaiḥcitratoraṇametatsyāt procyate toraṇatrayamp. 50) pādoccaṃ paṃcaṣaṭsaptabhāgedvau toraṇāgrakamcaturāśrāṣṭakaṃ vāpi vṛttaṃ vā toraṇāṃghrikambodhikā sahitaṃ vāpi vīrakāṇḍasamanvitamtoraṇāṃghriviśālaṃ tu procyate dvijasattama !yathākrameṇa saṃkalpya anena vidhinā budhaḥtadardhaṃ vājanoccaṃ tu tasyārdhaṃ dalamānakamuttaraṃ bodhikordhve vā vīrakāṇḍe tu vā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: toraṇāgraviśālaṃ tu kuḍyastaṃbhodayārdhakamaṃghrivetrāvasānaṃ vā tasmāddaṇḍādhikaṃ tu vākuḍyatoraṇamākhyātaṃ dvāratoraṇamucyateuttaraṃ vājanaṃ cābjakṣepaṇaṃ cāṣṭamaṃgalampatrākhyaṃ makarākhyaṃ vā citratoraṇameva vādarpaṇaṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ yugmacāmaramśrīvatsaṃ madhyame kuryāt śeṣāstu tasya pārśvayoḥdvāratoraṇamevaṃ hi staṃbhatoraṇamucyatepādaṃ sarvāṃgasaṃyuktaṃ bodhikārahitaṃ kurutadūrdhve jhaṣakhaṇḍaṃ tu nānācitrairvicitritamdyuḍānalātmasaṃyuktaṃ etatsyātstaṃbhatoraṇamśālāmadhyāntarālāyāṃ kartavyaṃ sarvadhāmasuityaṃśumānkāśyape toraṇalakṣaṇa paṭalaḥ (trayodaśa)staṃbhamūle tu vedyūrdhve padmāsanaṃ prakalpayetpadmoccaṃ vasudhā bhajya kampamekāṃśamucyateūrdhvapadmaṃ dvibhāgaṃ tu kampamekena kārayettattuṃgadviguṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ vyāsamityucyate mayākuṃbhamaṃḍyādisaṃyuktaṃ vīrakāṇḍavihīnakamkuṃbhaṃ kuṃbhaṃ latāṃ hyetāṃ anyathā vakṣyate budhaiḥbodhikārahitaṃ yattat staṃbhakuṃbhalatā smṛtāevaṃ trividhinītyā tu procyate kuṃbhalatā dvija !ityaṃśumānkāśyape kuṃbhalatāvidhipaṭalaḥ (caturdaśa)ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ samārabhyaṃ dvidvyaṃgulavivardhanātvitārārdhaṃ tu tannivraṃ tridvyaṃśaṃ vā tribhāgikamsakandharaṃ tadūrdhve tu śukanāsyānvitaṃ tu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: staṃbhotsedhayugāṃśe tu dvibhāgaṃ caraṇāyatamtadeva kūṭamānaṃ tu tattaduktāvasānayetvṛtta shuṭitamevaṃ hi latāmaṃḍalamaṇḍitamvṛttākhya sphuṭitaṃ caiva hārāntareṣu kalpayetityaṃśumānkāśyape vṛttasphuṭita lakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (paṃcadaśa)pādoccaṃ daśadhā bhajya śuddhadvāraṃ navāṃśakamathavāṃ ghrikatuṃgaṃ tu vasubhāgavibhājitesārdhavahnyaṃśamūrdhve tu bhuvaṃgasyocchrayaṃ bhavetśuddhadvārasya tuṃgārdhaṃ śuddhadvārasya vistṛtamtuṃgārdhādadhikaṃ hīnaṃ tāramekona viṃśatisarveṣāmapi harmyāṇāṃ dvāraṃ madhye tu yojayetdvārayogasya vistāraṃ tasyārdhaṃ dhanamucyateyoga tuṃgaṃ tu vedāṃśe tyekāṃśāśramayogatambāhyābjaṃ kṣepaṇopetaṃ bhuvaṃgatāraṃ ca yogavatbhuvaṃgaṃ ca pataṃgaṃ ca madhyastha balayānvitamtadvistāratribhāgaika śikhāyoge praveśitaubhuvaṃgapataṃgayocchidraragrayorveśanānvitausunakṣatre śubhe vāre śubhahomamuhūrtakebhittivyāse tu paṃcāṃśe dvābhyāṃ paṃcāvasānakamtadbāhye'bhyantare caiva yogavyāso gatāśritamubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ paścāt kavāṭe yogamāśritauantassaradamairvipra kaṃvāṭaṃ tu dṛḍhīkṛtamsnigdhasāradrumai bāhyābhyantare yaṣṭibandhitaupaṃcasaptadaśaivātha yaṣṭisaṃkhyaikapārśvakamp. 54) vāmapārśve kavāṭe tu yojayedvādupaṭṭikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tattribhāgaikabhāgaṃ tu tasya nīvramudāhṛtamkavāṭāgre ca madhye ca vāmapaṭṭikapārśvayoḥlohajaṃ dārujaṃ vātha bāhyābhyantara yaṣṭayaḥbadhvā kapāṭayogau dvau dārulohairdṛḍhīkṛtampareṣāṃ ghāṭanodghāṭayantramavyaktamācaretdvāramevaṃ samākhyātaṃ kampadvāramataḥ śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape dvaralakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ṣoḍaśa)prāsādamaṇṭapādīnāṃ caturdikṣu vidikṣu catatraiva kalpayetsamyak kaṃpadvāraṃ dvijottama !sthālāduttarasīmāntaṃ kaṃpadvārodayaṃ bhavetkṛtvā dṛḍhataraṃ badhva yojayedantaraṃghrayaḥmūlāgrayoḥ śikhehyetā tārāṃghriṃ parikalpayetcatuḥ paṃca ṣaḍaṣṭau vā daśa dvādaśa eva vāantarāyantarāmatyā gamāgamakṣamaṃ vināyojayettu kavāṭaṃ ca vyomai pratyekameva vākalpayetsudṛḍhaṃ dvāraṃ na calaṃ hastināpi caityaṃśumānkāśyape kaṃpadvāralakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (saptadaśa)staṃbhārdhaṃ maṃcamānaṃ tu āpotsedhāṃśameva vāvājanaṃ caikabhāgena bhūtamālāṃ tataṃ tribhiḥsaptāṃśaṃ tu kapotoccaṃ āliṃgaṃ caikabhāgayāvājanaṃ tvekabhāgena athavānyaprakārataḥbhāgena vājanaṃ kuryāt agnyaṃśairvabhī bhavetāliṃgamaṃśamaṃgena kuryādantaritaṃ bhavetutsedhaṃ caivamākhyātaṃ aṃganīvramathocyatevājanasya tu niṣkrāntiṃ uttarādvājanonnatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tripādaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā prāgvad vājananīvrakamp. 59) upānasīmāvasānaṃ vā jagatyantaṃ tathāpi vāvājanaṃ tu kapotasya nivroccālaṃghanaṃ samampādabāhyasamaṃ proktaṃ āliṃgapratirucyatevājanoccasamaṃ proktaṃ vājanasya tu nirgatiḥuttarasyānukūlyaṃ tu vājane nīvraveśanamnānāpatralatādyaistu kapote karṇapālikāḥevaṃ prastaravargaṃ tu procyate dvijasattama !ityaṃśumānkāśyape prastaralakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (aṣṭādaśa)ūrdhvabhūmaṃ ca tuṃgaṃ tu galamānamudāhṛtamtaduccaṃ tricatuṣpaṃca aṃśaṃ vā vedikodayamvedikāyāstu vistāraṃ catuṣpaṃca ṣaḍaṃśakaiḥaṃghrorvedyaṃghriveśaṃ yat tadvedārgalaveśanamevaṃ tvanekabhedeṣu karturicchāvaśānnayetvṛttaṃ tu vesare harmye śiṣṭānukūlakaṃ nayetbhānudvyaṃśegalotsedhe kalāṃśaṃ tu galodayamagnyaṃśaṃ valabhīmānaṃ vyomāṃśaṃ vājanodayamathavā nānu bhāgaṃ tu galodayamudāhṛtamtadūrdhve muṣṭibandhoccaṃ adhyardhāṃśamudāhṛtamp. 61) sārdhāṃśaṃ daṇḍikotsedhaṃ vyomāṃśaṃ varṇapaṭṭikāvājanādīni niṣkrāntaṃ tattaduccasamaṃ bhavetityaṃśumānkāśyape galabhūṣaṇalakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ekonaviṃśaḥ)ūrdhvabhūmyaṃghrituṃgasya sadṛśaṃ śikharodayamvedivistāratulyaṃ vā śikharasya kapotakamdvidaṇḍaṃ sārdhadvidaṇḍaṃ vā nīvraṃ nālaṃbanaṃ samam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śirastāraṃ kapotordhve valabhīvājanaṃ samamtattripādārdhapādaṃ vātāramevaṃ caturvidhamp. 62) śikhare balikāsthānaṃ bhūtāṃśe tu śirodayetattāre tu caturthāṃśaṃ tanmaṇḍalaghanaṃ bhavetbalikānāmadhaścordhve vetraṃ tadardhamānataḥśikharasya tu mānāntaṃ padmatuṃgamudāhṛtamkuṃbhatāraṃ tribhāgaikaṃ kuṃbhasyādho balagnakamkandharaṃ triguṇaṃ pālitattribhāgaikakuḍmalamvalagnāntaṃ śiromadhyāt anupūrvātkṛśaṃ kurutasmatkapotanīvrāntakrameṇaiva bṛhantaramdvāviṃśadvibhajeduṃccaṃ padmamānārdhabhāgayātatsamaṃ cordhvakaṃpaṃ tu padmamaṃśena kalpayetpadmamaṃśena kartavyaṃ kaṃpamardhāṃśamānataḥpadmamardhena kartavyaṃ pālikoccaṃ tu ekayāśikharākṛtivatkuṃbhaṃ pālikākuḍmalaṃ tathāvṛttaṃ vesaraharmyaṃ tu tattatadvarvartanaṃ kramātśikharaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ nāsikā lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape śikharalakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (viṃśaḥ)lalāṭanāsikā khyātā śikhare tārasādṛśāḥkramānnāsīviśālāṃśaṃ uttamāmadhyamādhamāp. 64) samaṃ tripādamardhaṃ vā śikharānnāsinīvrakamnāsikātuṃgamākhyātaṃ tanmadhyoccamathāpi vātribhāgaṃ vā tribhāgaikabhāgaṃ vātha tadunnatamdvibhāgaṃ kiṃpurī vaktraṃ śeṣāṃśaṃ galamānakamśaktidhvajopariṣṭāttu patraṃ vātha saśūlakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: patraṃ cettena mānena yathā saundaryamācaretvallimaṇḍalacitrādyaiḥ bhūṣayenmukhapaṭṭikāśayitasthitapaṭṭyābhā mṛṇālyādi vibhūṣitammālikā kūṭakoṣṭhādi maṇḍitaṃ vā vimānavatsabhadraṃ tu mahānāsī pādasarvāṃgasundarāḥkalpayitvā viśeṣeṇa karottaradi mānataḥnāsikāstaṃbhavistāraṃ kaṇṭhottarāntamunnatamnāsikāyāstu vistārād dvidaṇḍaṃ vā tridaṇḍakamnāsikāṃghridvayormadhye diṅmūrtisthāpanaṃ kurusārdhadaṇḍaṃ dvidaṇḍaṃ vā * * * vātha vistṛtamkapotālambanātkakṣaṃ nāsikoccaṃ tu kalpayettaduccaṃ tu tridhābhajya ekāṃśaṃ kaṇṭhamānakampādaṃ pratikapoteṣu kalpayetsvastikākṛtimp. 66) kalpayettu viśeṣeṇa śikhare bhadranāsikāḥkalpayetpaṃjarasthāne mahānāsyākhya nāsikāityaṃśumānkāśyape nāsikā lakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ekaviṃśaḥ)prāsādaṃ sadanaṃ sadma harmyaṃ dhāma niketanamāspadaṃ cāśrayaṃ caiva ādhāraṃ ca manoharamyasmādaṇupaśo nāsti paramāṇussa ucyatepicūṇāmaṣṭako yāstu keśāgramiti saṃjñitamtatkeśāgrāṣṭakāyāstu likhyaṃ taducadāhṛtamp. 67) yavamaṣṭaguṇaṃ mānaṃ aṃgulaṃ tadudāhṛtamṣaṭsaṃkhyāyavatāraṃ syāt adhamāṃgulamitismṛtamtrisārdhāśālidīrghaṃ tu madhyamā iti saṃjñitāḥśvetaśālīmahāśālī raktaśālī tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raktaśālyāyataṃ teṣu aṃgulārdhaṃ tu saṃgṛhetcandrasthivo'vakāśaṃ ca vyomamekāṃgulākhyakamkālaṃ cānalarudrākṣaṃ śūlaṃ cālekhanaṃ guṇamcaturaṃgulisaṃjñāste bāṇaṃ bhūtendriyāmṛtamrasagāyatrikṛttikā ṣaḍaṃgulasya saṃjñakāmātṛlokasvarāścaiva saptāṃgulābhidhāyakaḥaṣṭāṃgulasya saṃjñāste śaktidvāra grahāstathānāḍikāṣṭhāyudhaṃ dharma daśāṃgulasya saṃjñakāḥabdaṃ bhāraṃ ca bhānuṃ ca dvādaśāṃgulasaṃjñakāḥṛṣidvayamanuścaiva caturdaśāṃgulākhyakāḥkalāmūrtidvayaṃ caiva ṣoḍaśāṃgulasaṃjñakāḥpaṃcāśatṣaṣṭisaptatyāśītiśca navatīśatamśakvarī saśakvarī ca tuṣṭipuṣṭidhṛtistathāekaṃ daśa śataṃ caiva sahasramayutaṃ tathākharvaṃ ca śaṃkha padmaṃ ca samudramadhyamaṃ taramp. 69) śreṣṭhamadhyāntarairvānyaiḥ tālaṃ bhānvaṃgulaṃ bhavetśreṣṭhamadhyādhamairmātraiḥ kalpya hastaṃ tathoditampaṃcaviṃśati mātraṃ syāt prājāpatyaṃ karaṃ budhaḥaṣṭāviṃśāṃgulaṃ prācyaṃ vaidehaṃ navaviṃśatiḥevamaṣṭavidhaṃ hastaṃ pratyekaṃ dvijasattama !dhanurgrahaprakīrṇābhyāṃ dvijānāṃ gṛhamārabhetprājāpatyakaraṃ caiva vaidehaṃ vaiśyayogyakamadhikajātyahaṃ hastaṃ hīnaṃ tattad visarjayetsarveṣāmuditaṃ hastaṃ mānaṃ sadmani pūjitamathavā kikṣuhastaṃ tu sarvajātyarhakaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ārāmodyānakhādīni prājāpatyakareṇa tudhanurgraheṇa vāpyādi nadyādhvānaṃ ca mānayettricaturhastamārabhya dvidvihastavivardhanātevamaṣṭavidhaṃ mānaṃ yugmāyugmaṃ catuścatuḥrudrabhānukarāntaṃ tu ābhāsa dvitakā'ṣṭadhātithikalākarāntaṃ tu ābhāsa tritalaṃ daśacatuṣpaṃcatalaṃ vātha yugmāyugmaṃ ca te daśarasabhūtayugāṃśaṃ tu vistārā dropayetkramātpaṃcadhābhyuditaṃ tuṃgaṃ ābhāse sadane dvija !p. 71) sārvakāmikamityete abhidhānaṃ kramādbhavetābhāsaṃ harmyamākhyātaṃ vikalpamadhunā śṛṇudvidvihastavivṛddhyā tu caturviṃśati saṃkhyayāadhamaṃ madhyamotkṛṣṭaṃ trayobhedatalaṃ pratiṣaṭsaptāṣṭādhikāśītyantaṃ uccaṃ prāgiva saṃkhyayātricaturdaśahastādi dvidvihasta vivardhanātvedabhūmiṃ samārabhya bhānubhūmāvasānakamsaptāṣṭadaśahastādi tritrihastavivardhanātadhamaṃ madhyamotkṛṣṭaṃ tuṃgabhedaṃ talaṃ pratisaptāṣṭadaśahastādi dvidvihastavivardhanātcaturbhūmisamārabhya yāvadarkatalāvadhiekadvāviṃśahastādi tritrihastavivardhanātadhamaṃ madhyamotkṛṣṭaṃ utsedhaṃ vai kramoditamjāticchandavikalpaṃ ca ābhāsena dvijottama !yugāśretyuktamāne tu mānasūtraṃ tu vinyasetyatraiva varjitaṃ yattatmānasūtraṃ vidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatpādābhyantarāntaṃ vā tatpādamadhyamaṃ tu vāsabhāmaṇṭapaśālānāṃ bhittimadhyāvasānakambhitti bāhyagatāṃ ghrau tu bāhye vā'bhyantarepi vāp. 73) bhittivyāse tu bhānvaṃśe bāhye'thātvaṃśakaṃ vrajetbhitti madhyāṃghrivistāraṃ aṃghristhāne nivocyateśālāṃnāṃ bhitti madhye vā bāhye vā'bhyantare'pi vāmānasūtraṃ samākhyātaṃ sarveṣāṃ sadanādināmkūṭasyokta viśālaṃ vā tripādaṃ vārdhameva vāathavādaṇḍamānena kūṭādīnāṃ tu nirgatiḥtridaṇḍaṃ vātha niṣkrāntaṃ mānasūtrāttu bāhyataḥtasmātsarvaprayatnena mānasūtrādbahirgatamhomabāhyagataṃ sūtraṃ avasānamudāhṛtamkhyātaṃ saṃkṣepato viprā ! śṛṇuṣvāyādi lakṣaṇamityaṃśumānkāśyape mānādisūtralakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (dvāviṃśaḥ)harmyavistārahastaṃ tu guṇavṛddhyāvasubhirharetvardhayedvasubhirhrāse nakṣatreṇāhayādibhamśeṣamarkādivāraṃ syāt vyāsāyāmakaraṃ guṇaiḥtithayastu samākhyātā tuṃgahastāṣṭa vṛddhitautuṃgaṃ navena vṛddhyā tu prāgi vai nāḍibhirharetketusiṃhovṛṣo hastī śubhayonimiti smṛtamyajamānasya janmarkṣā na virodhadinaṃ tathāevaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā aṃśumānaṃ tu saṃgrahetbhānurvā eva śeṣaṃ tu āyamityucyate budhaḥp. 75) vasubhirguṇite ṛkṣe hate śeṣaṃ hayādikamnava vṛddhyā parithau hastaṃ saptasaṃkhyā tu hrāsayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāgvacchubhāśubhaṃ vīkṣya śubhamānaṃ tu saṃgṛhetsadeṣṭasiddhidā ṛkṣāḥ proktāḥ śeṣāstu varjitāḥgaṇayenmatimānvipra ! śubhamānaṃ tu gṛhyatām* * śūlādiduṣṭāḍhya duṣṭayogamudāhṛtamityaṃśumānkāśyape āyādilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (trayoviṃśāḥ)himādrikanyayoranta * to deśamudāhṛtamp. 76) yathaiva dehināṃ devaṃ haṃ vātapittakaphātmakamsātvikaṃ tāmasaṃ caiva rājasaṃ ca tridhā smṛtāḥsiddhādi kṛṣṇavarṇāntaṃ tāmasākhyaṃ mahītalamnāgaraṃ sātvikaṃ deśaṃ tāmasaṃ vesaraṃ tathāsātvikaṃ nāgaraṃ harmyaṃ tāmasaṃ vesarālayamviṣṇurmaheśvaro dhātā kramāddharmyādhidevatāḥdrāviḍaṃ tu nṛpo jñeyo ākṛtiṃ śṛṇu suvrata !unnatāvanatopetau kūṭakoṣṭhau yathā kramamkṣudrakoṣṭhasamāyuktaṃ mahānāsyapare dvija !ekānekatalaṃ vāpi sālindaṃ vā vihīnakamnāgaraṃ bhavanaṃ khyātaṃ taddeśaṃ tu prakalpitammānasūtrādbahiḥ kūṭaṃ nīvraṃ kūṭaṃ tu koṣṭhakampaṃjaraṃ mānasūtre vā kūṭaniṣkrānta sādṛśamunnataṃ sāntaraṃ maṃca tata prastarahīnakamnānāmasūrakastaṃbhe vedikājālaka toraṇaiḥhārāntareṣu maṃcordhve kṣudrakoṣṭhayutaṃ tu vāsādhāraṃ vā nirādhāraṃ ekānekatalaṃ tu vāyugāśraṃ vā śiraśchandaṃ vimānaṃ drāviḍaṃ bhavethārāntare viśeṣeṇa kalpyā vṛttasphuṭādayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 78) hīnau vāntaramaṃcau dvau nīvraṃ ca samasūtrakaukapotapaṃjaraṃ madhyaṃ vā sāntaraprastarānvitamvasvaśraṃ vedikopetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śīrṣakaṃ galametacca drāviḍaṃ khyātaṃ hemādikuḍmalaṃ tathāevaṃ trividhaṃ nītyā su procyate drāviḍālayamvṛttākāraṃ śiropetaṃ karṇakūṭaṃ prakalpayetvṛttagrīvaśiropetaṃ yatheṣṭaśikhareṇa vāsamāśraṃ sāyatāśraṃ vā vṛttaṃ vṛttāyataṃ tu vāunnatāvanatopetau kūṭakoṣṭhau yathākramamvesaraṃ bhavanaṃ khyātaṃ athavānyaprakārataḥvasvaśraṃ śīrṣakaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ drāviḍaṃ bhavanaṃ bhavetkūṭakoṣṭhavihīnānāṃ harmyāṇāṃ kathitāstvimesarvatra vṛtta pādaṃ vāṃ vesare bhavane kurusarvasaṃpatsamṛddhiḥ syāt nṛpasya vāstujanmināmtasmātsarva prayatnena ekajātyeva mācaretbhogavīraṃ ca nṛttaṃ ca drāviḍe bhavane bhavetnāgarādi vidhiḥ proktaḥ garbhanyāsavidhiṃ śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape nāgarādividhipaṭalaḥ (caturviṃśaḥ)p. 80) prāsādaṃ dehamityuktaṃ tasya prāṇastu garbhakamahamanye ca devāśca na vāse punnagarbhakeśrīpradaṃ prāṇināṃ garbhaṃ itare śrīkaraṃ bhavetadhiṣṭhāne praterūrdhve bhūsurāṇāṃ hitāya vaihomordhve garbhavinyāsaṃ śūdrāṇāmabhivṛddhidamprāsāde maṇṭape caiva prākāre gopure tathāyatraivādyeṣṭakānyāsaṃ tatragarbhaṃ nidhāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāṃsyenaivāyasā vāpi kartavyaṃ garbhabhājanamekāṃgula vivṛddhyā tu kalāsaṃkhyā tu bhājanamgarbhabhājanatārāste svāṃghrimūlatadantu vābhājanocca tribhāgaikaṃ pidhānasyocchrayaṃ bhavetyavaikavyāsamārabhya yāvārdhaṃ tu vivardhanātprāguktānāṃ tu phelāyāṃ kramaśaḥ parikalpayetphelābhitti viśālārdhaṃ ekorvā bhittestu dvijasattamatadbāhye ṣoḍaśe koṣṭhe pūrvādi kramayogataḥratnalohāni dhātūṃśca phelāyā bhyantare nyasetphelāśuciṃ tato gavyaiḥ astramaṃtramudāharananante vinyasedvajraṃ sūkṣme tu mauktikaṃ nyasetekarudre tu śaṃkhaṃ syāt trimūrtau puṣyarāgakamp. 82) svarṇe naiva gajaṃ kṛtvā akāre vinyasedbudhaḥtāmreṇaiva kṛtaṃ kuṃbhaṃ ukāre dvijasattamasvarṇena vṛṣabhaṃ kṛtvā kūṭākṣare nidhāpayetūkāre jātiliṃgaṃ tu ṛkāre gairikaṃ nyasetgorocanaṃ tathaukāre visarge haritālakamyavanī vāraśālī ca priyaṃgutilasarṣapambhājanordhve pidhānena susnigdhaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kuruṣoḍaśastaṃbhasaṃyuktaṃ prapāṃ kṛtvāti sundaramdvāratoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ darbhamālādi bhūṣitamhastamātrasamutsedhaṃ tālamātramathāpi vācaturaśraṃ dhanurvṛttaṃ padmaṃ prāgādiṣu kramātdarpaṇodarasaṃkāśaṃ kuṇḍavedīṃstvalaṃ kurupiṣṭacūrṇairalaṃ kṛtya puṇyāhaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ kuru
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tilataṇḍulalājaiśca darbhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristaretgavyābhiṣicya phelāyāṃ snāpayedgandha toyakaiḥsthaṇḍile sthāpayetphelāṃ kūṭākṣaramudāharansakūrcānvastrasaṃyuktān gandhāmbuparipūritānkuṇḍāni paṃcasaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā homaṃ samācaretsamidājya caruṃ lājān tilasarṣapataṇḍulānp. 84) homaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa pratyekāṣṭaśatāhutimjayādirabhyātānaiśca rāṣṭrabhṛccaiva homayetsunakṣatre sulagne ca sutithau ca suvārakesnānadvayasamāyuktaṃ sakalīkṛtavigrahamācāryaṃ pūjayetsamyak vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥgarbhasthānaṃ praviśyātha kartācācārya śilpibhiḥtrīṇi vābhyantare varjya śeṣāṃśe bhājanaṃ nyasetnāgadante vṛṣaśṛṃge vā aṣṭamṛdgrāhya deśikaḥmadhyetvaṃbujakandaṃ ca pūrve kumudakandakamsaumye kaśerukandaṃ ca bījaṃ tadupari nyasetpaścime kodravaṃ nyastvā māṣamuttarato nyasetpriyaṃguṃ vāyubhāge tu vaiśānyāṃ tu kulasthakamsarvātodya samāyuktaṃ nṛttageyasamākulamprāsādabījamuccārya sthāpayedgarbhabhājanamśailairvāceṣṭakābhirvā saikataissudṛḍhaṃ kuruityaṃśumānkāśyape garbhanyāsavidhipaṭalaḥ (paṃcaviṃśaḥ)tasya vistāratuṃgaṃ ca proktaṃ prāsādamānakeaṣṭāśraṃ cākṛtiṣveṣāṃ śikhare'pi tathaiva caharmya tārasamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tayormadhyeṣṭa bhājite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāsāda sadṛśaṃ vyāsaṃ uttamatraya maṇṭapamdvidaṇḍaṃ vā praveśaṃ tu mānasūtrāddvijottama !yugmastaṃbhasamāyuktaṃ yuktyā sarvāṃgaśobhitamsāvakāśāntarālaṃ cet taddīrghaṃ dvitricatuṣkaramprāsādabhittivistāratulyaṃ vārdhaṃ tripādakamkūṭakoṣṭhādi yuktaṃ vā bhinnaṃ mukhamaṇṭapamekānekatalaṃ vātha kartavyaṃ mukhamaṇṭapampaṃcabhāge tribhāgaṃ ca vedāṃśaṃ saptabhājitep. 87) trayodaśāṃśe saptāṃśaṃ vasvaṃśaṃ tithi bhājitegarbhagehasya vistāraṃ navadhā kīrtitāṃ mayāekadvitricatuṣpaṃca bhittiḥ syādekabhūmikedvibhāgaṃ caraṇāyāmaṃ prastarārdhaikabhāgayāekāṃśaṃ stūpi tuṃgaṃ tu kalpyevaṃ śāntikaṃ bhavetekāṃśaṃ rahitaṃ śeṣaṃ maṃcaṃ vā prāgvadeva vāsadanocce navāṃśe tu śivāṃśaṃ tu talodayammaṃcamānaṃ tathaikāṃśaṃ sārdhapādāṃśakaṃ galamstūpyutsedhaṃ tathaikāṃśaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ sadanānvitamsārdhadvyaṃśaṃ tu pādoccaṃ prastaraṃ tu śivāṃśakamekāṃśaṃstūpimānaṃ tu jayadaṃ tadudāhṛtamsārdhadvyaṃśaṃ tu pādoccaṃ prastaraṃ tu śivāṃśakamśeṣaṃ stūpyudayaṃ khyātaṃ tvadbhutaṃ sadanaṃ bhavetpakṣāṃśaṃ pādatuṃgaṃ tu tripādāṃśaṃ tu prastaramstūpyutsedhaṃ tathaikāṃśaṃ etatsyātsārvakāmikamviparīte nṛpādīnāṃ vipattiṃ nityamāvahetrudrāṃśe sadanotsedhe talamekāṃśamānataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: upagrīvastu sārdhāṃśaṃ tripādaṃ prastarodayamekāṃśaṃ stūpimānaṃ tu evaṃ caivādbhutaṃ smṛtamp. 89) pakṣamādhārapādaṃ ca maṃcopagrīvamaṃcakamsopagrīvasamaṃcau tā ekabhūreva vidyetekṛtvācādhārapādaṃ ca maṃcopagrīvamaṃcakamūrdhvamaṃcopariṣṭāttu catuṣkoṇeṣu suvrata !adhiṣṭhānādi sarvāṃgaṃ prāgivaiva prakalpayetśikhare tu mahānāsī catvārastu mahādiśiprastare cālpanāsīṃ vā vijayaṃ tadudāhṛtamnāgarādyucitaṃ karṇakūṭākāraṃ prakalpayetantarālaṃ ca tattulyaṃ kṣudrapaṃjarasaṃyutammadhyanāsī viśālaṃ vā madhya bhadraviśālakamkūṭamekadvibhāgaṃ vā madhyabhadraviśālakamtadeva sadane bāhye madhyabhadrayutaṃ tu vātadeva vedikākaṇṭhaṃ śikharaṃ ca ghaṭaṃ tathāabhadranāsī catvāra śikhare tu vidik sthitāḥtadevamadhyabhadraṃ ca karṇakūṭavihīnakamśikhare tu mahānāsī prastare'ṣṭau dviraṣṭa vātadeva śikhare cāṣṭāvalpanāsī samanvitamtāni vaidvayaśra vṛttābhaṃ hasti pṛṣṭhamudāhṛtampaṭṭaṃ pratimahānāsyaṃ kalpayetskandakāntakamp. 91) mahānāsyapare koṣṭhasaṃyuktaṃ śīrṣakaṃ bhavetkoṣṭhadīrghasamākhyātaṃ utsedhaṃ nāsikāsamamvṛttamastakakarṇāsyaṃ vasvaśraṃ vā galaṃ śiraḥprāsādasya tu vistāraṃ paṃcasaptāṣṭa vā bhajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daṇḍaṃ vādhyardhadaṇḍaṃ vā dvidaṇḍaṃ vā tridaṇḍakamcaturmahānāsikopetaṃ śikharāyatavṛttakamkalyāṇasundaraṃ khyātaṃ sarvadevārhakaṃ bhavetlalāṭanāsikopetaṃ pārśvayordvijasattama !talaṃ prativimānānāṃ diṅmūrtimatha vakṣyatepaścime viṣṇumūrtiṃ vā liṃgodbhavamathāpi vāmaṇṭape dakṣiṇe bhadre sthāpayettu vināyakamdurgāmuttaradigbhāge kṣetrapālaṃ tathaiva caevaṃ dharātalordhve tu kartavyaṃ dvijasattama !hastī vinābjakānāsī nāsikā ragnivistarampaścime nārasiṃhaṃ tu saumya mūrtimathāpi vāprastaroparikartavyaṃ ekadvitritale tathāumāskandādi sahitā maheśāḥ parikīrtitāḥkalāntaṃ yugabhūmyādi grīve ca prastarāntakegalādhastāttu maṃcordhve koṇeṣu vṛṣabhaṃ kurubhūtaṃ vātha catuṣkoṇe hṛdayāṃjali saṃyutamp. 93) āmodamagni koṇe tu pramodaṃ nair-ṛte bhavetśvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇamagnyādiṣu kramātkarālamudgīkulmāṣakalkacikkaṇa lepanamnānākrīḍāsamāyuktaṃ sudhayā dārubhistathāevamekatalaṃ khyātaṃ dvitalaṃ tu tato viduityaṃśumānkāśyape ekatalavidhipaṭalaḥ (ṣaḍviṃśaḥ)prāsādamūlavatkāryaṃ vistāroccaṃ tu nirgamamekāṃśaṃ kūṭavistāraṃ koṣṭhaṃ taddviguṇā yatamśeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ koṣṭhaṃ pārśvayostu sapaṃjaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṃjaravyāsamākhyātaṃ kūṭabāhyasamogatimpaṃjaraṃ karṇakūṭābhaṃ nāsikākāra eva vāprāsādoccaṃ tu vibhajedaṣṭāviṃśati saṃkhyayāprastarotsedhamagnyaṃśaṃ bhūtāṃśaṃ caraṇodayamdvibhāgaṃ galamānaṃ tu sārdhavedāṃśaśīrṣakamcatustriṃśati bhāgaṃ tu kṛtvā tu sadanodayamprastaroccaṃ guṇāṃśaṃ syāt talipaṃ sārdhaṣaḍbhavetsārdhadvyaṃśaṃ galotsedhaṃ bhūtāṃśaṃ śikharodayamtadeva galamānaṃ tu sārdhadvyaṃśena kalpayetp. 95) jayadaṃ sadanaṃ hyetat sarvadeva priyāvahamvasvaṃśapādamānaṃ tu sārdhāgnyaṃśaṃ tu prastaramekāṃśaṃ vedikoccaṃ tu guṇāṃśaṃ tu galodayamadbhūtaṃ sadanaṃ hyevaṃ kalpayetkalpavittamaḥadhiṣṭhānoccaṃ tu vedāṃśaṃ staṃbhaṃ taddviguṇāyatamtribhāgaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ dvibhāgaṃ vedikodayamśeṣaṃ śikhodayaṃ vidyādvimānaṃ sarvakāmikamcatuṣkūṭaṃ catuśśālā paṃjarāṣṭakasaṃyutamśikhare tu caturdikṣu mahānāsīsamanvitamevaṃ svastikamākhyātaṃ sarvadeva priyāvahamsvastibhadramitaṃ khyātaṃ mama prītikaraṃ bhavetnatapaṃjarasaṃyuktaṃ etadvipulasundaramnatapaṃjarasaṃyuktaṃ yatheṣṭākṛti śīrṣakamtadeva navaśālāḥ syuḥ kūṭonnatasamaṃcakāḥtadeva kūṭakoṣṭhau dvau nimnonnatavihīnakauhārāntare viśeṣeṇa yugmaṃ vā yugmapaṃjaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vasvaśravedikopetaṃ vartulaṃ śīrṣakaṃ galamvedikā toraṇāḍhyaṃ tu rudrakāntamidaṃ paramviṣṇukāntamidaṃ nāmnā sarvadevārhakaṃ bhavetp. 97) catuśśālāṣṭakūṭāḍhyaṃ saptāṣṭaivālpanāsikāḥkūṭātkoṣṭhasya niṣkrāntaṃ daṇḍaṃ vādhyardhadaṇḍakamnānādhiṣṭhānasaṃyuktaṃ nānāstaṃbhasamanvitamtadeva śikharoccārdha koṣṭhakaṃ tu catuṣṭayamṣaḍaṣṭanāsikopetaṃ svastibandhamidaṃ smṛtamhārāpaṃjarasaṃyuktā navāṣṭaivālpanāsikāḥtadeva śikhare cārdhakoṣṭhakaṃ tu vivarjayetnānālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ etatpāṃcālamiṣyateśikhare'ṣṭau mahānāsī yuktaṃ vai viṣṇukāntakampaṃjarāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ vṛttaśīrṣakakandharamkarṇakūṭāttu koṣṭhādiniṣkrāntaṃ parikalpayetetadīśvarakāntaṃ syāt īśvarasya priyāvahamtathā śīrṣakakaṇṭhaṃ ca vedikāṃ ca prakalpayettadevāyatavṛttābhaṃ gāndhāramiti vidyatedvyaśravṛttaṃ śiroyuktaṃ vedikā ca galaṃ tathādvyaśravṛttamupānādi kalpitaṃ vā tadeva hivṛttagarbhagṛhopetāṃ kūṭakoṣṭhādisaṃyutamkūṭakoṣṭhaṃ ca nīḍaṃ ca samasūtre tu kalpayetupānātstūpi paryantaṃ vṛttaṃ caiva bahirbahiḥp. 99) caturaśramadhiṣṭhānaṃ garbhagehaṃ tathaiva cakūṭakoṣṭhādi sarvāṃgaṃ yuktaṃ vṛttagrahaṃ bhavetrasāśraṃ śikharaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ kūṭakoṣṭhādi saṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ tu dvitalaṃ yogyaṃ bhedā aṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥkalpitaṃ saṃcitaṃ harmyaṃ pumāneva ghanīkṛtammiśreṣvādaudṛṣatkāryaṃ tadūrdhve tviṣṭakā kriyāiṣṭakādāruṇā caiva tanmiśraṃ ṣaṇḍamucyateaṃśena rahitaṃ kāryaṃ saṃcitaṃ smṛti vidyatevaktramaṇṭapamānaṃ ca garbhagehaviśālakamdvārasyobhaya pārśve tu pādayorantare dvija !bimbodita viśālaṃ tu daṇḍamātraṃ tu veśaramevaṃ dvitalamākhyātaṃ tritalaṃ tu tathā viduḥityaṃśumānkāśyape dvitalamānapaṭalaḥ (saptāviṃśaḥ)tasya vistāratuṃgaṃ ca puroktaṃ harmyamānavatekāṃśaṃ kūṭavistāraṃ viśālāyāmaṃ tu taddvayamśeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ khyātaṃ niṣkrāntādīni pūrvavatśālāyāmadvibhāgaṃ tu śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavetūrdhvabhūmikabhāgaika madhye bhadraṃ vidhīyatep. 101) prāsādasyocchrayaṃ bhānudviguṇāṃśaṃ vibhājitemaṃcamānaṃ dvibhāgena pādona caturaṃśakaiḥsārdhatribhāgaṃ pādoccaṃ sapādāṃśaṃ tu maṃcakamsārdhatryaṃśaṃ tu śikharaṃ stūpyuccaṃ tvekabhāgayācaturviṃśadvimānoccetaloccaṃ tu dvibhāgayāpādona caturaṃśaṃ tu talīvodayamiṣyateadhyardhāṃśaṃ tu maṃcoccaṃ ardhāṃśaṃ vedikodayamsapādāṃśaṃ śikhāmānaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tadudāhṛtamdvibhāgaṃ dharātalotsedhaṃ yugāṃśaṃ caraṇodayampādonadvyaṃśamaṃcāśca talīpoccaṃ tu taddvayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvibhāgaṃ grīvamānaṃ tu vedabhāgaṃ tu śīrṣakamcatvāriṃśaddvayādhikyabhāgaṃ kṛtvā gṛhoccakamtalocca sadṛśaṃ maṃcatalipaṃ sārdhaṣaṭkakamsārdhadvyaṃśaṃ tu maṃcoccaṃ ekāṃśaṃ vedikodayamdvibhāgaṃ stūpi tuṃgaṃ tu proktamadbhutaharmyakeadhiṣṭhānaṃ yugāṃśaṃ tu vasvaṃśaṃ caraṇodayamsārdhatribhāgamaṃcoccaṃ saptāṃśaṃ caraṇodayamgalamānaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syāt rasāṃśaṃ śikharaṃ bhavetaṣṭakūṭāṣṭaśālābhaṃ kalāpaṃjarasaṃyutamp. 103) nānādhiṣṭhāna saṃyuktaṃ nānāpādairalaṃ kṛtamkūṭakoṣṭhobhatādīni nāgarādyucitaṃ bhavetcaturmahānāsikopetaṃ alpāṣṭakavivarjitamtadeva vṛttaśikharaṃ galaṃ vai vedikā tathātadeva śīrṣakoṇeṣu alpanāsīdvayaṃ bhavettadeva vedikākaṇṭhaṃ śīrṣakaṃ ca ghaṭaṃ tathāvinyāsasūtrayorantaḥ navabhāga vibhājitekoṣṭhaṃ prati dvikoṣṭhaṃ syāt ardhāṃśaṃ paṃjarastatamcatuṣkūṭāṣṭaśālā ca bhānupaṃjarasaṃyutamsaptāṃśaṃ vibhajedbhāgaṃ ekāṃśaṃ kūṭavistaramardhāṃśaṃ paṃjaravyāsaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavetkalpyahārāntaropetaṃ dvitīyaṃ bhūtalaṃ kuruaṣṭakūṭā ca śālā ca viṃśatpaṃjarasaṃyutammahānāsyaṣṭakopetaṃ śikharantu dvijottama !tadevāṣṭāśra vedī ca vṛttābhaṃ śikharaṃ galamtadeva śikharaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ yugāśraṃ brahmakāntakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vasubhāgaṃ tu vistāraṃ āyāmaṃ daśadhā bhavetśeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ khyātaṃ prāgivaiva prakalpayetekaikāṃśena kūṭaṃ syāt koṣṭhadīrghaṃ dvayāṃśakamūrdhvabhūvistṛtaṃ cāgnibhāgaikaṃ madhyabhadrakamcatuṣkūṭāṣṭaśālā ca bhānupaṃjarasaṃyutamcatuṣkūṭaṃ catuśśālā paṃjarāṣṭakasaṃyutamlalāṭanāsikā vaktraṃ pārśvayorbhadranāsikāḥnānādhiṣṭhānasaṃyuktaṃ nānācāṃghrisamanvitammānasūtrāntaṃ navanavadhā tu vibhājiteparito'lindamekāṃśaṃ hārāvyāsaṃ śivāṃśakammadhye koṣṭhaṃ guṇāṃśaṃ syāt ekāṃśaṃ paṃjarastathāathavā paṃjarāṇāṃ tu ṣaḍaṃśaṃ vā vidhīyatep. 106) koṣṭhamadhyatridaṇḍena mahānāsī vinirgatamardhāṃśaṃ paṃjaravyāsaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavetcaturaśramadhiṣṭhānaṃ vasvaśraṃ śīrṣakaṃ galamaṣṭāśraśīrṣakaṃ madhyāt ūrdhvabhūmau prakalpayetśatālpanāsikopetaṃ śikhare'ṣṭaṃ mahattaramtadeva karṇakūṭānāṃ śīrṣakaṃ vartulākṛtiśikhare tu caturdikṣu bhadranāsī samanvitamtadeva śikharaṃ koṇe kṣudranāsyaṣṭakānvitamśeṣaṃ prāgiva kartavyaṃ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ tadudāhṛtamśālāmadhye mahānāsī bhadraṃ vinā prakalpayetstūpi trayasamāyuktaṃ etannāmnā sumaṃgalamgarbhagehaṃ tu vedāṃśaṃ gṛhapiṇḍyaṃśamāvṛtamteṣvekakūṭavistāraṃ madhye koṣṭhāyataṃ dvayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hārāntaramathāṃśena paṃjarasya tu pārśvayoḥśālā taddviguṇāyāmaṃ tayormadhye tu paṃjaramūrdhva(bhūma)maṃcaṃ caturbhāgaṃ dvibhāgaṃ madhyabhadrakamvedāśraṃ ca madhiṣṭhānaṃ tadvatkarṇaṃ ca śīrṣakamśatālpanāsikopetaṃ vṛṣasthalasamanvitamunnatau kūṭakoṣṭhau dvau cāntaraprastarānvitaup. 108) śrīviśālamitikhyātaṃ vartulaṃ vedikāgalamśrībhogamiti vikhyātaṃ sarvadevārhakaṃ paramkūṭakoṣṭhādi sarvāṃgaṃ prāgivaiva prakalpayetvarṣasthalavihīnānāṃ karṇaṃ śīrṣaka saṃyutamnānālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ nānācitrairvicitritamekabhūmi vidhānoktaṃ dvitalaṃ tu viśeṣataḥityaṃśumānkāśyape tritalavidhānapaṭalaḥ (aṣṭāviṃśaḥ)vistarotsedhamānaṃ tu proktaṃ prāsādamānakep. 109) gṛhapiṇḍyāliṃdahārādi pratyekaṃ caikabhāgayākarṇakūṭaṃ tatāṃśaṃ tu koṣṭhaṃ tad dviguṇāyatampunarapyūrdhva bhūmiṃ ca vasubhāgavibhājitetadūrdhve aṣṭabhāge tu śivāṃśaṃ kūṭavistṛtamśeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ proktaṃ hīnādhikyaṃ tu nāśrayetdaṇḍaṃ vādhyardha daṇḍaṃ vā dvidaṇḍaṃ vātha nirgatamsārdhāṣṭāṃśaṃ adhiṣṭhānaṃ bhūtāṃśaṃ caraṇodayamsapakṣāṃśaṃ ca maṃcoccaṃ kalpayeddvijasattama !sapādavedabhāgaṃ tu caraṇodayamiṣyatekarṇoccaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ syāt sārdhavedāṃśa śīrṣakamcatvāriṃśad dvayādhikya bhāgaṃ kṛtvā gṛhonnatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prastaraṃ cāgnibhāgena bhūtāṃśaṃ talipāyatamsapādadvibhāgamaṃcoccaṃ sārdhavedāṃghriṇodayamadhyardhāṃśaṃ galotsedhaṃ yugāṃśaṃ śikharodayampaṃcāśadvibhajeddhāmatuṃgaṃ stūpyavasānakamtadardhaṃ maṃcamānaṃ tu ṣaḍaṃśaṃ caraṇodayamtribhāgaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ pādoccaṃ sārdhapaṃcakamdvibhāgaṃ galamānaṃ tu śarāṃśaṃ śikharodayamupānādi sthūpiparyantaṃ paṃcāśadvibhajedbudhaḥp. 111) talocca sadṛśaṃ maṃcatalīpaṃ sārdhaṣaḍbhavetpādoccaṃ rasabhāgena guṇāṃśaṃ prastarodayamekāṃśaṃ vedikāmānaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syādgalodayamadbhutaṃ sadanaṃ hyevaṃ kalpayetkalpavittamaḥsārdhāgnyaṃśamadhiṣṭhānaṃ dhālvaṃśaṃ caraṇodayamsapādāgnyaṃśa maṃcaṃ syāt talipaṃ sārdhaṣaṭkakampādonāgnyaṃśamaṃcoccaṃ śivāṃśaṃ vedikodayamvyomāṃśaṃ tu śikhāmānaṃ vimānaṃ sārvadeśikambhānukūṭaṃ tathā koṣṭhaṃ bhānudviguṇapaṃjarampādaṃ pratyalpanāsyāḍhyaṃ śikharolpāṣṭanāsikāḥekākāratalastaṃbhaṃ subhadramiti vidyatetadbrāhmyamiti vikhyātaṃ sarvadeva priyāvahamvasvaśraṃ śīrṣakaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ śrīmaṇḍanamudāhṛtamśrīvantamiti khyātaṃ śālābhadrayutaṃ tu vāśrīkāntaṃ śikharelpāṣṭa nāsyāḍhyaṃ śrīviśālakamvistārādhyardhamāyāmaṃ sabhākāraṃ tu śīrṣakammānasūtrāntaraṃ nandabhāgaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: alindamaṃśena kartavyaṃ hārabhāgena kalpayetekāṃśaṃ kūṭavistāraṃ guṇāṃśaṃ koṣṭhadīrghakamp. 113) śālāmadhye mahānāsī nīvraṃ tadardhabhāgayāśālā taddviguṇāyāmaṃ śivāṃśaṃ paṃjaraṃ bhavetkūṭamekena kartavyaṃ koṣṭhaṃ taddviguṇāyatamūrdhve bhūmistadardhaṃ tu madhye daṇḍena nirgatiḥkakarīdaṇḍavatkoṣṭhaṃ vasvaśraṃ harmyaśīrṣakamravikoṣṭhaṃ ca kūṭaṃ ca ravidviguṇapaṃjaramgehavyāsaṃ tu dharmāṃśaṃ kṛtvā nālīgrahaṃ catuḥhāravyāsaṃ śivāṃśena paritaḥ parikalpayetkarṇakūṭaṃ tadekāṃśaṃ koṣṭhāyāmaṃ tu tadvayamcatuṣkūṭāṣṭakoṣṭhaṃ ca paṃjaraṃ bhānusaṃkhyayāalindaṃ jalapādāḍhyāt prastarāntaghanī kṛtamkoṣṭhaṃ taddviguṇāyāmaṃ paṃjaraṃ cāṃśamānakamkūṭaṃ bhāgena kartavyaṃ koṣṭhaṃ taddviguṇāyatamūrdhvabhūmaṃ tribhāgaikaṃ madhye daṇḍena nirgamamśikhare'ṣṭamahānāsī pādaṃ pratyalpanāsikānataṃ kūṭonnataṃ koṣṭhaṃ antaraprastarānvitamnānālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ nānā jālaka toraṇaiḥjayāvahamidaṃ khyātaṃ sarvadevārhakaṃ paramtadevāntaramaṃcaṃ syāt kūṭakoṣṭhaṃ ca paṃjaramp. 115) evaṃ syānmūlabhūmaṃ tu vasvaśraṃ madhyame talesukhāvahamidaṃ khyātaṃ sarvadevārhakaṃ paramsahyośca samasūtraṃ tu tadavyayagṛhaṃ bhavetityaṃśumānkāśyape catubhūmividhānapaṭalaḥ (ekonatriṃśaḥ)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvitalādikalāntānāṃ samameva prakīrtitamāyatāśraṃ tu koṣṭhaṃ syāt catuṣpādaikabhittitaḥsthūpivargasamāyuktaṃ kūṭakoṣṭhau viśeṣataḥkūṭaśāloccā kartavyā paṃjarāśca tathaiva cap. 116) ekāṃśaṃ vedikotsedhaṃ sārdhāṃśaṃ galamānakamevaṃ tu kūṭakoṣṭhau dvau kalpayettu talaṃ pratiuttarāsyordhvasīmāntaṃ haṃsamālordhvasīmakamsāntaraprastaraṃ cettu prastarasyordhvasīmakamtaduccaṃ rudradhā bhajya ekāṃśaṃ vedikodayamsapādāṃśaṃ galotsedhaṃ pādona dvyaṃśaśīrṣakamevaṃ hi kūṭakoṣṭhau dvau kalpayet kalpavittamaḥtadvyāse tricatuṣpaṃcabhāge bhāge tu nīvrakamcaturdikṣu caturnāsī kūṭānāṃ parikalpayetvedāśraṃ vasukoṇaṃ vā vṛttābhaṃ vā galaṃ śiraḥśālānāṃ pārśvayorvipra lalāṭākhyānu nāsikāḥsthūpyāgrasamaṃ proktaṃ lalāṭanāsyāgrasīmakamkūṭānāṃ nāsikā nīvraṃ mahānāsī vadācaretśālānāṃ drāviḍānāṃ tu sthūpiraśvini saṃkhyayāgalāṃśe kūṭakoṣṭhānāṃ devatādyāstu kalpayetupānāduttarāntaṃ tu navabhāgavibhājitevedāṃśaṃ caraṇāyāmaṃ maṃcamadhyardhabhāgayāprativājanasīmāntaṃ paṃjaroccamudāhṛtampaṃjaraṃ nāsikākāraṃ kūṭakoṣṭhākṛtistu vāp. 118) evaṃ tvanekabhedena paṃjarākṛtirucyateevamāditale kuryāt antaraprastarānvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṃjaraṃ nīvrarahitaṃ prastarordhve viśeṣataḥtadavyāsasadṛśaṃ tuṃgaṃ yuktyā paṃjaramācaretguṇāṃśaṃ ghaṭabhi syāt chatraśīrṣakasaṃyutamardhāṃśaṃ vedikāmānaṃ kapotāntaṃ galodayamśeṣaṃ prāgiva kartavyaṃ evaṃ niṣkrāntapaṃjarampaṃjare kūṭakoṣṭhe ca pāde pādāntare'pi vāhastau pādau dvayopetaṃ dāntaṃ kīrṇa jaṭānvitamgopānaṃ yattato dhṛtvā haṃsau pādau tadanvitaugopānaṃ śirasā bāhyaṃ sthāpayettu yatheṣṭakauityaṃśumānkāśyape kūṭakoṣṭhādilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (triṃśaḥ)vistārotsedhamānaṃ tu proktaṃ prāsādamānakedvibhāgaṃ gṛhapiṃḍī syāt ālindaṃ caikabhāgayāvarṣikasthalasaṃyuktaṃ kalpayetprastaroparidevatāsthāpanaṃ kuryāt tāvaddevarcanī kṛtamśivāṃśaṃ karṇakūṭaṃ tu madhye koṣṭhaṃ guṇāṃśakamhārāntaramathāṃśena kalpayetkalpavittamaḥmadhye koṣṭhāgnibhāgaṃ tu paṃjarāṃśena mānataḥtadūrdhve bhuvane cāṣṭabhāgāṃśaṃ karṇakūṭakamhārāntaramathārdhāṃśaṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇasaṃyutamśālādīrghaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syāt ardhāṃśaṃ paṃjarasya tutadūrdhvabhūmirvisṛtāgvyaṃśaṃ madhye daṇḍena nirgatiḥsārdhapaṃcāṃśamaṃghryuccaṃ sārdhadvyaṃśaṃ tu maṃcakammaṃcamānaṃ tu dvyardhāṃśaṃ paṃcāṃśaṃ caraṇāyatamdvibhāgaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ sārdhavedāṃghrituṃgakamkarṇaṃ pādonapakṣāṃśaṃ sārdhavedaṃ śirodayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 121) savedacatvāriṃśattu bhāgaṃ kṛtvā gṛhodayamprastaraṃ cāgnibhāgaṃ tu pādasārdhayutaṃ bhavetsapādadvibhāgamaṃcaṃ syāt talipaṃ pādādhikaṃ yugampakṣāṃśaṃ maṃcamānaṃ syāt pādasārdhaguṇāṃśakamdvibhāgaṃ galamānaṃ tu sārdha vedāṃśaśīrṣakamsadanoccaṃ tu ṣaṭtriṃśat bhāgaṃ kṛtvā dvijottama !prastarocca dvibhāgena caturbhiḥ pādadairghikamsārdhāgnyaṃśaṃ tu talipaṃ tadardhaṃ maṃcamānakamguṇāṃśaṃ pādadīrghaṃ tu sapādāṃśaṃ tu prastaramsapādāgnyaṃśa śikharaṃ śeṣaṃ sthūpyudayaṃ bhavetvimānotsedhaṃ vibhajet trayastriṃśati bhāgayāprastaroccaṃ dvibhāgena sārdhavahnyaṃśakāṃghriyamtribhāgaṃ caraṇāyāmaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ maṃcamānakamstaṃbhaṃ pādādhikaṃ dvyaṃśaṃ maṃcamānaṃ sapādakamsārdhatripādaśikharaṃ dvibhāgaṃ sthūpi mānakamcaturviṃśati bhāgaṃ tu kṛtvā tu sadanodayamtadardhaṃ maṃcamānaṃ tu pādaṃ pādonakaṃ guṇamprastaraṃ tu sapādāṃśaṃ staṃbhaṃ pādādhikadvayamekāṃśaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ ardhāṃśaṃ vedikodayamp. 123) aṣṭāṃśarahitaṃ vyomabhāgaṃ sthūpyudayaṃ bhavethomādi sthūpi paryantaṃ yugāśraṃ parikalpayetpādaṃ pratyalpanāsyāḍhyaṃ hāraṃ tannāsikā dvayamkṣudranāsī dvayaṃ koṇe kalpitaṃ brahmakāntakamtadeva na ta kūṭaṃ tu koṣṭhonnatasamaṃcakamtadeva vedikā kaṇṭhaṃ śīrṣakaṃ vasukoṇakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣudranāsī dvayaṃ koṇe kalpitaṃ brahmakāntakamtadeva natakūṭaṃ tu koṣṭhonnatasamaṃcakamtadeva vedikākaṇṭhaṃ śīrṣakaṃ vasukoṇakambhadrakāntamiti khyātaṃ kūṭakoṣṭhau dvayau samautadeva koṣṭhamadhye tu bhadrahīnamathāpi vāati bhadramiti khyātaṃ sarvadevārhakaṃ paramsonnataṃ sarvatobhadraṃ mama prītikaraṃ bhavetnānādhiṣṭhānasaṃyuktaṃ nānāpādairalaṃkṛtamśikhareṣṭālpanāsyāḍhyaṃ mahānāsī catuṣṭayamtadevāṣṭakaśālāḍhyaṃ ādibhūmau dvibhāgayāprāgukta nāmamākhyātaṃ tāsviṣṭaṃ parikalpayetityaṃśumānkāśyape paṃcatalavidhi paṭalaḥ (ekatriṃśaḥ)tasya vistāratuṃgaṃ tu prāsādamānavadbhavetdvibhāgaṃ gṛhapiṃḍī syāt aliṃdaṃ śaśibhāgayādharātalo dvitribhūmau devatā sthāpanaṃ bhavetbāhye tripiśilākāraṃ bhavanābhyantaraṃ bhavethārāntaraṃ caturviṃśat kalpayedādi bhūtalepārśvayoḥ karṇakūṭasya paṃjaraṃ parikalpayettadūrdhve bhūdaśāṃśe tu vyomāṃśaṃ karṇakūṭakamdvibhāgaṃ koṣṭhadīrghaṃ syāt ardhāṃśaṃ paṃjarasya tutasyordhve bhūviśālaṃ tu navabhāgavibhājitepaṃjaravyāsamekāṃśaṃ ardhāṃśaṃ hārayottaremadhye koṣṭhaṃ dvibhāgena ekāṃśaṃ paṃjarastathātasyordhve bhūmivistāraṃ ṣaḍbhāgaṃ vibhajetsamamardhāṃśaṃ paṃjaravyāsaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daṇḍaṃ vā'dhyardhadaṇḍaṃ vā dvidaṇḍaṃ bhadranīvrakamadhiṣṭhānocchrayaṃ cāgniṣaḍbhāgaṃ caraṇodayampādocca sārdhapaṃcāṃśaṃ maṃcaṃ sārhda dvibhāgayāsārdhadvibhāgamaṃcoccaṃ paṃcāṃśaṃ caraṇodayampādahīnaṃ tu paṃcāṃśaṃ talipasyodayaṃ bhavetpādāyāmamidaṃ khyātaṃ pādona dvyaṃśamaṃcakamsārdhavedāṃśamānaṃ tu śīrṣakaṃ parikalpayetambujāsanamākhyātaṃ sarvadeva priyāvahamaśeṣa sauṣṭikānāṃ tu śīrṣaṃ vai caturaśrakamsāntaraprastaropetaṃ hīnaṃ vāpi samonnatamvṛttākāraṃ prakartavyaṃ nāmnā bhadravalīnakamśivabhadramidaṃ khyātaṃ śivaprīti karaṃ parammukhe lalāṭanāsāḍhyaṃ nāgendramiti saṃjñitamityaṃśumānkāśyape ṣaḍbhūmividhāna paṭalaḥ (dvātriṃśaḥ)prāsādamānavidhinā vāsodayaṃ parikalpayetpakṣāṃśaṃ bhittiviṣkambhaṃ ekenālindamiṣyatevinyāsasūtrayorantara bhānvaṃśaṃ vibhajetsamampaṃjaravyāsamekāṃśaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavettasyordhve bhūmivistāraṃ dharmabhāgavibhājitepaṃjaravyāsamardhāṃśaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavetpaṃjaraṃ kūṭakoṣṭhaṃ ca tadvadeva vidhīyatevyomāṃśaṃ karṇakūṭaṃ syāt ekāṃśaṃ paṃjarastatammadhye śālā dvibhāgena śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretkūṭamekāṃśamityuktaṃ śālā tadviguṇāyamūrdhvabhūmyagnibhāgaikaṃ madhye daṇḍena nirgamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sapādāgnimadhiṣṭhānaṃ sārdhaṣaṭkāṃghri tuṃgakamsa tripāda dvibhāgaṃ tu maṃcamānamudāhṛtamsapādaṃ paṃcabhāgaṃ tu staṃbhamānamudīritamsapādadvibhāgamaṃcaṃ syāt sa tripādayugāṃśakampādoccaṃ sārdhavedāṃśaṃ pādona dvyaṃśamaṃcakamardhādhika yugāṃśaṃ tu śīrṣakodayamiṣyatepaṃjaraṃ kūṭa koṣṭhaṃ ca samasūtre tu kalpitamśālā ṣaṭtriṃśatiryuktaṃ bhānuddviguṇakūṭakamnānādhiṣṭhānasaṃyuktaṃ ekākāramathāpi vātadevonnatakūṭāḥ syuḥ sāntaraprastarānvitamtadeva natakūṭaṃ ca koṣṭhonnatasamaṃcakāḥtadeva śīrṣaṃ karṇaṃ ca * * śraṃ vedikāyatamsamaṃ connatakūṭaṃ vā śrīpradaṃ tadudāhṛtamrudrakāntamidaṃ khyātaṃ rudraprītikaram paramkrameṇādi talātkalpya vṛttabhadramidaṃ smṛtamkūṭānāṃ mastakaṃ vṛttaṃ suvṛttamiti vidyateyatheṣṭaṃ śikharākāraṃ kaṇṭhaḥ sthūpī ghaṭastathāśivabhadramiti khyātaṃ śivaprītikaraṃ paramdvidaṇḍaṃ vātha niṣkāntaṃ bhadraṃ vā bhadrapaṃjaramnānācitrairvicitraṃ tu śivasaukhyamudāhṛtamvṛttamevaṃ hi bāhyaṃ tu vṛttābhaṃ sauṣṭikānvitampaṃjaraṃ kūṭakoṣṭhaṃ ca antaraṃ prastarānvitamevaṃ saptatalaṃ khyātaṃ vasubhaumamathocyateityaṃśumānkāśyape saptabhūmividhānapaṭalaḥ (trayastriṃśaḥ)prāsādamānavidhinā saṃgrāhyaṃ visṛtodayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtāṃśaṃ garbhagehaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ gṛhapiṇḍikāathavā navabhāgena garbhagehaṃ vidhīyatekuḍyamekena kartavyaṃ alindaṃ tu śivāṃśakamvinyāsasūtrayorante trayodaśa vibhājitetribhāgaṃ madhyakoṣṭhaṃ syāt śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavetbhānukoṣṭhaṃ catuṣkūṭaṃ kalāpaṃjarasaṃyutamvarṣasthalamalīndaṃ syāt prastarāntaṃ ghanīkṛtamkūṭakoṣṭhādi sarvāṃgaṃ ādibhūmimivaiva tukarṇakūṭaṃ tadekāṃśaṃ śālādīrghaṃ dvibhāgayāpaṃjaraṃ kūṭakoṣṭhaṃ ca saṃkhyāvāditaloktavatkūṭakoṣṭhādisarvāṃgaṃ mānasaṃkhyaiva pūrvavathārāntaramathārdhāṃśaṃ lambapaṃjarasaṃyutamkarṇakūṭaṃ tadekāṃśaṃ madhyeśālā dvibhāgayācatuṣkūṭaṃ catuśśālā vasupaṃjarasaṃyutamtadūrdhve bhūviśālaṃ tu ṣaḍbhāgaṃ vibhajetsamamardhāṃśaṃ paṃjaravyāsaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaṃ bhavetkūṭātkoṣṭhastu nīvrā vā madhyaśālā tu nīvrakamsaptasapta tribhāgena kṛtvā geha samucchrayamprastaraṃ tu sa pādāgnisārdhaṣaṭkāṃghri tuṃgakampādonāgnyaṃśa maṃcaṃ syāt sārdhabhūtāṃghrituṃgakamsa pādaṃ paṃcabhāgaṃ tu caraṇodayamīritamsa pādadvibhāgamaṃcaṃ syāt pādaṃ pādona paṃcakamsa tripādāṃśamaṃcoccaṃ vyomāṃśaṃ vedikodayamkaṇṭhamānasamaṃ sthūpī tuṃgamityeva mucyatesauṣṭhyagraṃ ca yugāśraṃ syāt staṃbhaṃ pratyalpanāsikāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekākāratalaṃ staṃbhaṃ śivacchandamudāhṛtamvāgīśamiti vikhyātaṃ sarvadevārhakaṃ paramyāgavantamiti khyātaṃ sarvadeva priyāvahamvimānaśikharaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ aṣṭāśraṃ parikalpayettadeva kūṭakoṣṭhaṃ ca samaṃcaṃ vā vimaṃcakamnānācitrairvicitraṃ tu pārvatīmiti vidyatenāmnā kailāsamityuktaṃ mama prītikaraṃ paramityaṃśumānkāśyape vasubhūmividhānapaṭalaḥ (catustriṃśaḥ)prāsādamānavatkāryaṃ gehavyāsaṃ tadunnatamdvibhāgā gṛhapiṇḍī syāt alindaṃ caika bhāgayāhārāvyāsaṃ śivāṃśena kalpayetkalpavittamaḥyugāṃśaṃ garbhagehaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ grahapiṇḍikāḥvinyāsasūtrarantaṃ vā kalāṃśaṃ vibhajetsamampaṃjaravyāsamekāṃśaṃ karṇakūṭaśivākṛtiḥcatuṣkūṭāccatuśśālā kalāpaṃjara saṃyutamevameva prakartavyaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca mahītalamardhāṃśaṃ paṃjara vyāsaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretpaṃcabhūmiviśālaṃ ca bhānubhāgavibhājiteardhāṃśaṃ paṃjaravyāsaṃ syādardhaṃ hārayontaramhārāntaraṃ tu dvātriṃśat kalpayetkalpavittamaḥkoṣṭhaṃ taddviguṇāyāmaṃ ardhāṃśaṃ hārayontaramtadūrdhvabhūviśālaṃ tu rasabhāga vibhājitepaṃjaravyāsamardhāṃśaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavetmadhyeṃśaṃ daṇḍamānena nirgamaṃ parikalpayetpādonacaturaṃśaṃ tu dharātalamudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptāṃśaṃ caraṇoccaṃ tu sapādāgnyaṃśa maṃcakamṣaḍbhāgaṃ pādamānaṃ tu pādonāgnyaṃśamaṃcakamsapādaṃ paṃcabhāgaṃ tu pādasyotsedhamucyatepādādhikadvibhāgaṃ tu prastarasyodayaṃ bhavetp. 137) sārdhavedāṃśakaṃ pādaṃ pādonadvyaṃśamaṃcakamśīrṣakaṃ sārdhavedāṃśaṃ pādona dvyaṃśakuḍmalamsamaṃconnatakūṭāḍhyaṃ kūṭāgraṃ caturaśrakamaśeṣamadhyaśālāstu pārśvakoṣṭhastu nirgatiḥtadevonnatakoṣṭhāḥ syuḥ maṃconnatakūṭakamsamaṃcaṃ vā vimaṃcaṃ vā kūṭakoṣṭhau samunnatautadeva śikharaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ vasvaśraṃ cāṣṭanāsikāḥsauṣṭyaṃśena yugāśraṃ vā śrīvardhanamidaṃ paramvṛttagrīvāśiropetaṃ caturdigbhadranāsikāḥyugmapaṃjarasaṃyuktaṃ supadmamiti vidyatep. 138) tadevagarbhagehaṃ tu vṛttaṃ vṛtta gṛhaṃ bhavetityaṃśumānkāśyape navabhūmividhānapaṭalaḥ (paṃcatriṃśaḥ)prāgvatprāsādamānoktamārgeṇaivodayaṃ tathāvedāṃśagarbhagehaṃ tu gṛhapiṇḍī tribhāgayāvinyāsasūtrayorantara munibhāgavibhājiteekāṃśaṃ paṃjaravyāsaṃ pādaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavethārāntaraṃ ca dvātriṃśat kalpayedādi bhūtaleekāṃśakarṇakūṭaṃ tu śālā taddviguṇāyatākūṭādīnāṃ tu saṃkhyā tu ādibhūmisamaṃ bhavetdviguṇaṃ koṣṭhadīrghaṃ tu ardhāṃśaṃ paṃjarastatamtasyordhvatalavistāraṃ rudrabhāgavibhājite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrdhvabhūmi viśālaṃ tu vyomāṃśaṃ kūṭavistṛtamhārāntara tribhāgaikaṃ paṃjaravyāsamucyateadhyardhāṃśaṃ tu koṣṭhaṃ syāt śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ samamprāgvatkūṭādināṃ saṃkhyā rasabhūrevameva hikūṭamekāṃśamānena madhye śālā dvibhāgayācatuṣkūṭaṃ catuśśālā paṃjarāṣṭakasaṃyutamsaptāṃśaṃ vibhajedaṣṭabhūmeścaiva tu vistaramhārāntarāgni bhāgaikaṃ madhyapaṃjara vistṛtamprāgvatkūṭaṃ ca koṣṭhaṃ ca paṃjaraṃ ca prakalpayetmadhye bhadraṃ tadekāṃśaṃ daṇḍamānena nirgatiḥyugāṃśaṃ tadadhiṣṭhānaṃ aṣṭāṃśaṃ caraṇāyatampādoccaṃ sārdhasaptāṃśaṃ prastaraṃ sārdhavahnikamsārdhaṣaṭkāṃghri tuṃgaṃ tu prastaraṃ cāgni bhāgayāpādoccaṃ sārdhapaṃcāṃśaṃ sārdhapaṃcāṃśamaṃcakamsārdhapakṣāṃśa maṃcoccaṃ paṃcāṃśaṃ pādadīrghakamsa tripādayugāṃśaṃ tu pādadīrghamudāhṛtampādona dvyaṃśamaṃcaṃ syāt śaśyaṃśaṃ tu vitardikampādahīnadvibhāgaṃ tu sthūpyutsedhamudāhṛtampādaṃ pratyalpanāsyāḍhyaṃ nānāpādaṃ rasātalamtadevonnatakūṭaṃ cet indrakāntamiti smṛtampakṣaśālā tu madhyasthā śālā daṇḍena nīvrakamnānālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ catuṣkūṭamidaṃ tathākūṭakoṣṭhādisaṃyuktaṃ samasūtramathoparitadevaśikharaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ vṛttābhaṃ parikalpayettadeva karṇakūṭānāṃ śīrṣakaṃ ca galaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśabhūmyevamākhyātaṃ tatastvekādaśaṃ talamityaṃśumānkāśyape daśabhūmividhānapaṭalaḥ (ṣaṭtriṃśaḥ)prāsādamānavidhinā saṃgṛhettu tatodayampakṣāṃśaṃ gṛhapiṇḍī syāt alindaṃ caikabhāgayāhārāntaramathāṃśena kalpayettu yathākramamprastarāntaṃ ghanaṃ vāpi tadūrdhve'lindameva vāśivāṃśaṃ karṇakūṭaṃ syāt pakṣāṃ śāladvibhāgayāhārāntaraṃ ca tattulyaṃ kalpyevaṃ syādi bhūtaleśivāṃśaṃ kūṭavistāraṃ koṣṭhadīrghaṃ tu taddvayambhānukoṣṭhaṃ catuṣkūṭaṃ kalāpaṃjara saṃyutamtasyordhve bhūviśālaṃ tu trayodaśavibhājiteardhāṃśaṃ paṃjaravyāsaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavettadūrdhve bhūmi vistāraṃ dvādaśāṃśavibhājiteśeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ khyātaṃ tribhāgaikāṃśapaṃjaramtadūrdhve bhūmivistāraṃ rudrāṃśaṃ tu pūrvavattasyordhvabhūmivistāraṃ daśabhāgaṃ vibhājitetadūrdhvabhū navāṃśe tu kūṭavyāsaṃ śivāṃśakamhārāntaratribhāgaikaṃ paṃjaravyāsamiṣyateaṣṭāṃśaṃ vibhajedaṣṭabhūmeścaiva pravistṛtampaṃjaravyāsamekāṃśaṃ hārāntaraṃ tadardhakamhārāntaraṃ kalāsaṃkhyā procyate'ṣṭasamanvitamkūṭavyāsamathāṃśena koṣṭhadīrghaṃ dvibhāgayādaśabhūmiviśālaṃ tu rasabhāgavibhājiteprathamādipaṃcabhūmyantaṃ bhadrapaṃjarasaṃyutamūrdhvabhūmiviśālaṃ tu guṇabhāgavibhājite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāsādasya tu cotsedhaṃ śatāṃśaṃ sa trayodaśapādoccaṃ sārdhavasvaṃśaṃ paṃcamānaṃ yugāṃśakamcaraṇaṃ sārdhasaptāṃśaṃ prastaraṃ sārdhavahnikamardhādhikaṣaḍaṃśaṃ tu pādoccāstu maṃcakamardhādhikaṃ tu bhūtāṃśaṃ pādadīrghamudāhṛtamsapādaṃ paṃcabhāgaṃ tu pādadīrghaṃ praśasyatesa pādaṃ pakṣabhāgaṃ tu maṃcamānamudīritammaṃcamānadvibhāgaṃ tu sārdhavedāṃśamaṃghrikamśaśyaṃśaṃ vedikāmānaṃ kaṇṭhoccaṃ sārdhabhāgayāpādonaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ syātsthūpyudayamiṣyateśikhare tu caturdikṣu mahānāsī samanvitamsauṣṭikaṃ cāntamaṃcaṃ tu vijayaṃ tadudāhṛtamsarvātmakamidaṃ khyātaṃ sarvadevātmakaṃ paramviśālabhadramākhyātaṃ sarvadevārhakaṃ paramsamaṃcaṃ vā vimaṃcaṃ vā kūṭaśālā ca paṃjaramtadeva śikharaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ vṛttamaṣṭāśravedikātadeva karṇakūṭastu bhadrayukkarṇabhadrakamnāmnā karṇaviśālaṃ tu sarvadevapriyāvahamityaṃśumānkāśyape rudrabhūmividhipaṭalaḥ (saptatriṃśaḥ)tasya vistāratuṃgaṃ tu proktaṃ prāsādamānakambhūtāṃśaṃ garbhagehaṃ tu pakṣāṃśaṃ gṛhapiṇḍikāalindaṃ tu śivāṃśaṃ syāddhārā bhāgena kalpayetgarbhagehasya tulyaṃ vā gṛhapiṇḍestu vistṛtamvinyāsa sūtrayorantasaptādaśavibhājitetayormadhye tu pakṣāṃśaṃ śālādīrghamudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 147) śivāṃśaṃ paṃjaravyāsaṃ karṇakūṭamivākṛtiḥevamāditalaṃ kuryāt ūrdhvaṃ rudrataloktavatdharātalodayabhūtāṃśaṃ navāṃśaṃ caraṇodayamevaṃ bhānutalaṃ proktaṃ trayodaśatalaṃ śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape bhānubhūmividhi paṭalaḥ (aṣṭatriṃśaḥ)tasya vistāra tuṃgaṃ ca prāsādamānavadgṛhamguṇāṃśaṃ garbhagehaṃ tu pakṣāṃśaṃ gṛhapiṇḍikātadbāhye'lindamekāṃśaṃ hārābhāgena deśika !vinyāsasūtrayorantaḥ ekonaviṃśadaṃśakaiḥp. 148) pakṣaśālā ca tattulyaṃ ekāṃśaṃ paṃjarasya tupaṃjaraṃ karṇakūṭābhaṃ tasyābhaṃ kṣudrapaṃjaramcatvāriṃśaddvayādhikya śatāṃśe sadanodayambhūtāṃśaṃ maṃcamānaṃ syāt śeṣaṃ dvādaśabhūmivatityaṃśumānkāśyape trayodaśabhūmividhipaṭalaḥ (ekonacatvāriṃśaḥ)evaṃ krameṇa saṃkalpya paṃcālīndasamanvitamgarbhagehaṃ rasāṃśaṃ ca vedāṃśaṃ gṛhapiṇḍikāekadvitricatuṣpaṃca bhūmau vātha dharātaledevasthāpanabhūmyantaṃ yāvattāvadghanaṃ kurualindaṃ lajapādaṃ vā chāditaṃ vā tulādibhiḥvyāse sa veditriṃśāṃśe karṇakūṭaṃ śivāṃśakamtayormadhye dvibhāgena śālādīrghamudāhṛtamtayormadhye vidhāṃśena paṃjaraṃ karṇakūṭavatevaṃ hi kalpayedādibhūmiśālāṣṭaviṃśatiḥsavedaṣaṣṭi saṃkhyāḥ syuḥ hārāntaraṃ dvijottama !dvibhāgaṃ madhyaśālā syāt śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva hi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triṃśadaṃśavibhāgaṃ tu kṛtvā tṛtīyabhūtalamhārāntaraṃ tadardhaṃ syāt śeṣaṃ dvitīya bhūmivatkarṇakūṭasamaṃ piṇḍīśālāyāstu dvipārśvayoḥpaṃcame tala vistāre ṣaḍviṃśatyaṃśa bhājitetayormadhyasthaśālā ca tayormadhye ca koṣṭhakamtayormadhye'rdhabhāgenapaṃjaraṃ karṇakūṭavatṣaṣṭhaṃ ca bhūmivistāraṃ caturviṃśati bhājitesaptamaṃ bhūmivistāraṃ dvāviṃśatyaṃśakaṃ bhajettayormadhye śivāṃśena kṣudraṃ koṣṭhaṃ prakalpayetadhyardhaṃ paṃjaravyāsaṃ tadardhaṃ hārayontaramaṣṭamaṃ bhūmi vistāraṃ viṃśatyaṃśavibhājitetayormadhye dvibhāgena koṣṭhāyāmamudāhṛtamśeṣaṃ prāgiva kartavyaṃ teṣāṃ saṃkhyā tu pūrvavatśivāṃśaṃ karṇakūṭaṃ syāt madhye śālā dvibhāgayātasyārdhenaiva tatpārśvedayo hārāntaraṃ bhavetkūṭakoṣṭhāntare caiva koṣṭhayorantare'pi vāhārāntaraṃ tadardhāṃśaṃ kalpayetkalpavittamaḥkalpyevaṃ navame bhūmau daśabhūmestu vistaramkarṇakūṭaṃ śivāṃśaṃ syāt tatsamaṃ paṃjarastatambhānuśālā catuṣkūṭaṃ kalāpaṃjarasaṃyutamekādaśatalavyāsaṃ manubhāga vibhājitetayormadhye sthalāṃśānāṃ guṇāṃśaṃ parikalpayetcatuṣkūṭā tu śālā ca paṃjaraṃ ṣoḍaśānvitambhānubhūmiviśālaṃ tu bhānubhāgavibhājitesarveṣāmapi koṣṭhānāṃ paṃcāṃśaṃ pravidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karṇakūṭaṃ śivāṃśena madhye śālā dvibhāgayātayormadhye vibhāgena paṃjaraṃ karṇakūṭavatcaturdaśatalavyāsaṃ vasubhāgavibhājiteardhāṃśaṃ paṃjaravyāsaṃ tasyārdhaṃ hārayontaramhārāntaraṃ caturviṃśat kalpyamevamanukramātkarṇakūṭaṃ tu vyomāṃśaṃ madhyeśālā dvibhāgayāaśeṣordhvatalaṃ vyāsaṃ vedabhāgavibhājitekṛtvā prāsādatuṃgaṃ tu dvibhāgena śatadvayamsārdhaṣaṭkaṃ tu maṃcoccaṃ pādoccaṃ bhānusaṃkhyayāsārdhabhūtāṃśamaṃcaṃ syāt daśāṃśaṃ caraṇodayampādoccaṃ sārdhavasvaṃśaṃ maṃcamānaṃ yugāṃśakamcaraṇaṃ sārdhasaptāṃśaṃ prastaraṃ sārdhatribhāgikamardhādhikaṣaḍaṃśaṃ tu pādoccamagnimaṃcakamardhādhikaṃ tu bhūtāṃśaṃ pādadīrghamudāhṛtamsapādaṃ paṃcabhāgaṃ tu pādadīrghamudāhṛtamsapādaṃ pakṣabhāgaṃ tu maṃcadīrghamudīritammaṃcamānaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syāt sārdhavedāṃśamaṃghrikamśaśyaṃśaṃ vedikāmānaṃ kaṇṭhoccaṃ tu dvibhāgayāsapādāṃśaṃ śikhāmānaṃ kalpayettu krameṇa tuśikhare tu caturdikṣu mahānāsī samanvitamtadeva sāntaraṃ maṃcaṃ sauṣṭikaṃ nata koṣṭhakamtadeva natakūṭaṃ ca koṣṭhonnata sa maṃcakāḥtadeva śikharaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ vasvaśraṃ parikalpayettadeva madhyabhadrāḍhyaṃ kūṭakoṣṭhasamanvitampārvatīkamidaṃ khyātaṃ upapratikaraṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedikordhve tayāvaiva vṛttākāra samanvitampaṃjaraṃ kūṭakoṣṭhaṃ ca śikharaṃ ca ghaṭaṃ tathāanenaivāthavā kuryāt ekādyānekabhūmikamtattadyucitavistāraṃ tuṃgakuḍyaṃ ca garbhakamsālindasadanānāṃ tu sopānārohaṇaṃ yathātasyāgraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuryāt ekānekatalaṃ tu vāevaṃ yaḥ kurute harmyaṃ aśakyāpekṣitaṃ tu vādāsīdāsādibhiścānyai svacchāvaśamudā svabhiḥityaṃśumānkāśyape ṣoḍaśabhūmividhipaṭalaḥ (catvāriṃśaḥ)śikharasyodayordhve vā mahānāsyāvasānakep. 156) taddhidyāvasamāpte tu tadā mūdhneṣṭakāṃ nyasetśilābhistu śilāharmye tviṣṭakeṣṭakayā tadāmiśradravyakṛte harmye yaddravyeṇa kṛtaṃ śiraḥekādyanekabhūmīnāṃ harmyāṇāṃ tu viśeṣataḥprakuryādiṣṭakāṃ vipra tataḥsthāpanamārabhetnavāṣṭasaptaṣaṭpaṃcahastaṃ vā maṇṭapaṃ statammaṇṭapaṃ vā prapāṃ vātha ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyutamtaraṃghramaṃghriveṣṭaṃ ca vitānadhvajasaṃyutammaṇṭapasya tribhāgaika madhye kṛtvopavedikāmśeṣaṃ vedi viśālaṃ tu bhānumātrasamanvitamp. 157) mahāśāsvagnikuṇḍāni caturaśrāṇi kalpayetgomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā śilpinaṃ tu visarjayetpunaśca gomayairlipya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettadātadardhaistaṇḍulairbhūṣya tadardhaiśca tilairapinānāpuṣpaiḥ kuśairdarbhaiḥ paristīrya vicakṣaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya svasvamantrairviśeṣataḥpanasaṃ khadiraṃ sālaṃ tiṃtriṇīsārameva vāhemajaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ ayasā miśrameva vāmūrdhni śailopariṣṭāttu sthūpyantaṃ vā tadāyatamtasyāgramaṃgulaṃ vyāsaṃ mūlādagraṃ kramātkṛśamp. 158) vasvaṃśaṃ madhyame tvagre vṛttākāraṃ prakalpayetkartavyaṃ tasya mūle tu śikhipādaṃ suyojayettadvyāsārdha ghanopetaṃ pūrvāgraṃ cottarāgrakamdaṇḍamūla tribhāgaikaṃ śikhāvyāsaṃ samāśrayamdaṇḍamūlāgrayoḥ paṭṭaṃ yojayellohajaṃ budhaḥkarṇikāyāṃ nyaseddaṇḍaṃ śakrādiṣu yathākramampṛthivyādīni bījāni daṇḍānte vilikhedbudhaḥsuvarṇarajataistāmraiḥ sūtraiḥ kārpāsajaistu vābrahmaviṣṇū ca rudraṃ ca īśānaṃ ca sadāśivamnaivedyaṃ dāpayetteṣāṃ tāmbulaṃ tu nivedayetp. 159) abhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau sa kūrcānsāpidhānakānsa sūtrānpallavopetān aṣṭavidyeśvarādhipāntato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ agnyādhānādikaṃ kuruśatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā pratyekaṃ juhuyātkramātājyena juhuyāddhīmān pratyekaṃ paṃcaviṃśatiḥbrahmādibījamantraistu pṛthak spṛṣṭvā daśāhutiḥācāryo mūrtipaissārdhaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥsitayajñopavītāḍhyaḥ sitamālyānulepanaḥyajñasūtreṇa sahitabhūṣaṇairbhūṣya śilpinamgandhapuṣpādibhiryaṣṭvā homaṃ kṛtvā jayādibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 160) sthirarāśyudaye viprobhayarāśyudaye'pi vāācāryaḥ śilpibhiścaiva yogyatośmagṛhoparimārjanyā maṇḍayitvā tu paṃcagavyakuśodakaiḥsthapatestarjanīveśamātraiva śikhare suṣimiṣṭakāḥ sthūpikuṃbhāṃśca vahnidhāmapradakṣiṇamuttarābhimukho bhūtvā tvācāryo mantravittataḥvicintya svasvamaṃtreṇa caturaśreṣṭakā nyasetsuṣesvāṃgeyamāśritya prāgudagraṃsu sātmakamsuṣe vāyuṃ samāśritya prāgudagraṃ marutātmakammāṇikyaṃ marakataṃ caiva vaiḍūryaṃ cendranīlakamp. 161) vajraṃ madhyādiṣu sthāpya śaktibījamanusmarankalaśasthodakaiḥ prokṣya daṇḍamaśmānameva cagulāṃbhasā ca sudhayā sthūpiṃ badhvā tu niścalamśikharasthopariṣṭāttu sthūpiṃ prāguktavartmanāsvarṇaiśca rajatairvātha tāmraiśca chādayedgṛhamdakṣiṇāṃ dāpayettasmai daśaniṣkaṃ hiraṇyakamśilpinaṃ pūjayetpaścāt gobhūmīkāṃcanādibhiḥityaṃśumānkāśyape mūdhneṣṭakāvidhipaṭalaḥ (ekacatvāriṃśaḥ)rakṣārthaṃ śobhanārthaṃ ca śālā yasyodayasya tucaturbhāgaikabhāgaṃ vā antarmaṇḍalavistṛtammadhyahārāviśālaṃ tu bāhye tanmaṇḍalatrayammahāmaryādi vistāramādeḥ paṃcaguṇaṃ bhavetnīvraṃ dvitīyaṃ prathamāt dvitīyāttṛtīya nīvrakamprākāraṃ prati niṣkrāntānyuktāni kuḍyasīmakamathavā śeṣaviprāṇāṃ nīvrahomādvidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nataṃ dvitīyakaṃ paścāt tadvadeva nataṃ kramāttripaṃca saptahastena prathamaṃ trividhaṃ bhavettripaṃcasaptadaśakaṃ hastamekona viṃśatiḥekaviṃśattrayoviṃśat paṃcaviṃśatkaraṃ bhavetmahāmaryādi vistāraṃ evaṃ trividhamucyatesaptahastaṃ samārabhya paṃcatriṃśāvasānakamtripaṃca saṃkhyayā proktaṃ harmyāṇāṃścaiva saṃjñakamprāgvadeva sālasaṃkhyāḥ syuḥ harmyāṇāṃ jātisaṃjñitāpaṃcaprākāramevaṃ hi triprākāramathocyateśeṣaṃ vābhyantare bāhye varjitau tattrisālakāmdvitīyaṃ vā tṛtīyaṃ vā grāhyaṃ śeṣāstu varjitāḥtasyānukūlasaṃyuktaṃ dvisālaṃ saṃprakīrtitamtasmānmukhe mukhe yāmaṃ kalpayetkalpavittamaḥdviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vātha catuḥ paṃca guṇaṃ tu vāantarmaṇḍalabhittestu vistāraṃ vyomahastakamsārdhadvihasta hastāntaṃ mahāmaryāvasānakamtadvyāsatricatuṣpaṃca guṇaṃ vā sālatuṃgakamprastarāntaṃ galāntaṃ vā sālā tuṃga mudāhṛtamkalpayitvā vidhānena vṛṣānsaṃsthāpya śīrṣakamathavāṃghritalopetaṃ bāhyetvabhyantarājitammūlādagraṃ kramātkṣīṇaṃ vasvaṃśeṃśaṃ dvijottamatripaṃca saptahastādi nandarudrakarādi vāprathamādi paṃcaśālānāṃ uccaṃ hyekona bhedakamdvidvihasta vivṛddhyā tu pratyekaṃ tu tribhedakambodhikāntaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu caturthaṃ cottarāntakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: eka tripaṃcasāleṣu tāsāmuktodayaṃ viduḥmaṇṭapākṛtikaṃ vātha ṛjukuḍyamathāpi vākusyasyopari kuḍyaṃ syāt pādasyopari pādakamvakṣye'haṃ pādamānaṃ ca parimāṇaṃ dvijottama !tanmānaṃ saptadhā bhajya pakṣāṃśaṃ tu dharātalamdharātalaṃ taduktaṃ vā ārjavaṃ vā prakalpayetdharātalaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syāt saptāṃśaṃ caraṇodayamadhiṣṭhānaṃ guṇāṃśaṃ syāt śeṣaṃ pādodayaṃ bhavetpādasyotsedhamānaṃ tu ṣaṭsaptāṣṭau tu vā bhajettattribhāgaṃ dvibhāgaṃ vā tripādaṃ vārdhameva vāmūlapādaviśālaṃ tu dharmanandāṣṭabhājiteagrapādaviśālaṃ tu daṇḍamityabhidhīyateuttarotsedhamākhyātaṃ vistāraṃ mūlapādavatuttaravyāsamākhyātaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ madhyādhamaṃ kramātuttarotsedha tulyaṃ tu tulānīvramudāhṛtamvājane vallikordhve vā tulāsthāpanamācaretjayantyārdha viśāloccaṃ manumārgamudāhṛtamanumārgaṃ tathā kalpya daṇḍamāneṣṭakāntaramathavā tulopariṣṭāttu iṣṭakāstaruṇā kurusudhayā gulatoyaiśca iṣṭakāstaruṇaṃ kuruiṣṭakākaraṇaṃ hyetat śilāśceduttaroparivājanordhve tu vācchāda sudhākarma samācaretmūlāgrastambha tuṃgaṃ tu dharmanandāṣṭadhā bhajetprastaraṃ ca tathā kāryaṃ ekānekatale'pi vāchatrākāraṃ śiropetaṃ sabhākāramathāpi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
