sanskrit: mṛlloṣṭhairlohaloṣṭhairvā sāradārumayaistu vāsabhākāramidaṃ khyātaṃ lupā vāra vihīnakambāhyakuḍyavihīnaṃ tu maṇṭapākāramaṇḍitamjāti pañcatalaṃ khyātaṃ chandaṃ vedatalaṃ bhavetjātyādīnāṃ tu harmyāṇāṃ yogyaṃ sālātaraṃ kuruathavā madhyahārāyāṃ āgneyyāṃ pacanālayamśāṃkare yāgaśālāsyāt bhraṃśabhāge'tha vā budhaḥśakraśaṃkarayormadhye maṇḍanālayameva vānir-ṛti varuṇayormadhye dharmaśravaṇamaṇṭapamtatpārśvayoḥ prakartavyaṃ maṇḍanālayamuttamamsomavāyavyayormadhye śastrāṇāmālayaṃ kurutatpārśve śayanasthānaṃ paryaṃkena samanvitamgrahakṣatapade kuryāt dhānyālayaṃ dvijottamamālikābhyantare caiśe kūpasthānamudāhṛtamśakraśaṃkarayormadhye śālisthānamudāhṛtamyāmya pāvakayormadhye puṣpamaṇṭapamucyatenir-ṛtivaruṇayormadhye dharmaśravaṇamaṇṭapamvāyavya somayormadhye śayanasthānamucyatejayanteñjanaśālā syāt āgneyyāṃ pacanālayamśāṃkare nṛttamūrtiṃ ca tvāgneyyāṃ vṛṣavāhanamkaṃkālaṃ vāyudigbhāge bhikṣāṭanaṃ jayantakesugrīve harirardhaṃ syād gandharve candraśekharamditayetvardha nārīśaṃ indre kalyāṇasundaramvāruṇye liṃgamudbhūtaṃ saumye tu gajahāriṇammūlaharmyaṃ tu saṃvīkṣya sakalasthāpanaṃ kuru
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prākāratati madhye ca dīrghamadhye ca veśanampradhānadvāramekaṃ vā anye vā jālakaṃ dvijaekadvitricatuṣpaṃca daṇḍaṃ vā vidhivistṛtamśaivānāṃ paricārāṇā prācyāmāvāsamucyatedaivajñāmbaṣṭhabhiṣajāṃ vādakānāṃ ca yāmyakesarveṣāmapi bhaktānāṃ vāsamuttarapārśvataḥkālāmukhaṃ tu nair-ṛtyāṃ bauddhālayaṃ tu vāruṇejñānābhyāsālayaṃ kuryādaiśānyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥyāmyapāvakayormadhye jaladānaprapāṃ kuruvaruṇanair-ṛtayormadhye sutikā vā samucyatesaumyānilayormadhye bālaśikṣārthamaṇṭapamtadbāhye parito vipra dāsīnāṃ gaṇikādināmcakriṇāṃ puṣpajīvīnāṃ kulālānāṃ tathaiva canāpitaśmaśrukārāṇāṃ gopālānāṃ tu kāruṇāmparitaḥ kalpayeddhīmān pūrvādīnāṃ vasānakamdakṣiṇe cottare bāhye carmakārādi vāsakamtadbāhye krośamātre tu caṇḍālaśreṇi rucyateityaṃśumānkāśyape prākāralakṣaṇavidhipaṭalaḥ (dvicatvāriṃśaḥ)astreṇa hastasandhānaṃ pādau sadyena sandhayetādau paścāttu saṃdhānaṃ kramātsaṃpūrṇamācaretaṣṭatriṃśatkalānyāsaṃ sthānamaṃgamudāhṛtamdharmatālāttritālānta śreṣṭhāntarādhamaṃ tridhāmadhyamaṃ daśatālaṃ syā bhanupaṃktyāṃgulaṃ bhavetsadvādaśaśataṃ bhāgaṃ nava tālottamaṃ bhavetkanyasaṃ navatālaṃ syād vedādhikaśataṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uttamaṃ daśatālena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarānuṣābhūmī ca durgāṃ ca lakṣmī vai mātarastathākanyasaṃ daśatālena kārayeddvijasattama !anye ca devatāścaiva navatālottamena tupaṃcatālottamenaiva vighneśaṃ kārayedbudhaḥbālāstu vedatālena tritālenaiva kiṃnaraḥevaṃ tālakramaṃ proktaṃ berāṇāmanukūlyakamprāsāde tvekabhūmau tu procyate mukhamaṇṭapamprāsādābhimukhe caiva diśāsu vidiśāsu caudyāne vā nadī tīre taṭākartāra eva vāprāsādasyāgrake kuryāt maṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakamsnapanārthaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu nartanāntu caturthakamantarmaṇḍalahārādi antarhārānta vā kurumaṇṭapānmaṇṭapāntaṃ tu sālādvā maṇṭapāntakamekadvitricatuṣpaṃca ṣaṭsaptāṣṭakaraṃ tu vāantarālaviśālaṃ tu rudrasaṃkhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥekadvitricatuṣpaṃca bhaktyā vābhyantarālakambhittibandhāntarālaṃ cet pārśvayorveśasaṃyutampārśvayormadhyame dvāraṃ jālakaṃ vā prakalpayetayugmakāṃ vā bhittirvā'bhyantarālaṃ dvijottama !athavā veśahīnaṃ tu maṇṭapasya samam bhavettrihastaṃ tu samārabhya dvidvihastavivardhanātābhāsa sadanānāṃ tu ābhāsaṃ maṇṭapastvimesaptatriṃśati hastāntaṃ vikalpaṃ navadhā bhavetnavatriṃśatkarārabhya dvidvihasta vivardhanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptapaṃcāśadārabhya dvidvihastavivardhanāttadvistārasamaṃ dīrghaṃ samaśraṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavetpaṃcahastāvadhiryāvat bhaktivyāsaṃ tripaṃcadhāguṇāṃgula vivṛddhyā tu bhaktivyāsaṃ prakalpayetaṣṭahastāvadhiryāvat trayoviṃśāṃghribhedakamstambhānāmudayaṃ hyevaṃ stambhavyāsamathocyateekonaviṃśamātrāntaṃ trayoviṃśāṃghrivistarammūlatāraṃ tadekāṃśaṃ tattadaṃśo navāgrakamtalipoccaṃ tu bhūtāṃśe dvibhāgaṃ vā talodayamsopapīṭhamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kevalaṃ vā masūrakamupapīṭhodayaṃ khyātaṃ upapīṭhocchrayaṃ tu vānīvraveśamalaṃkāraṃ gaṇyaṃ prāgiva vidyatekalālpanāsikopetaṃ madhye kūṭaṃ tu eva vāiṣṭadigdvāramevaṃ vā dvayajālakakoṣṭhadiktoraṇādi vihīnaṃ vā kalpyevaṃ prathamaṃ bhavetpūrve pare dvibhaktyaikaṃ bhaktyā vistṛta nīvrakambhānudviguṇasaṃkhyāṃghri yuktaṃ viṃśatināsikāvasupaṃjarasaṃyuktaṃ dvitīyaṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavetmaṇṭapaṃ paritoṃśena dvātriṃśaccaraṇānvitamiṣṭadigdvārasaṃyuktaṃ dvārānyatraiva kuḍyakamkuḍyaṃ kuṃbhalatādyaistu bhūṣitaṃ tu tṛtīyakamtatkūṭamaṣṭapādāḍhyaṃ madhye raṃgasamāyutamdvibhaktivistṛtaṃ caiva bhaktyā nīvraṃ samāyutamcatvāriṃśati cāṣṭāṃghri yuktaṃ vā tatra yojayettoraṇāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ caturthaṃ maṇṭapānvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navabhāgena tanmadhye kūṭaṃ vā maṇditāṃ kaṇamtribhāgaikāṃśavistāraṃ nirgamaṃ mukhabhadrakamsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ paṃcamaṃ parikīrtitamcaturbhāgena tanmadhye hyūrdhvakūṭaṃ prakalpayetsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṣṭhamaṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavetguṇāṃśakāṃśaviṃśaṃ tu nīvrabhadraṃ catuścakaḥmukhe sopānamagnyaṃśaiḥ vyāsadīrghasamanvitamsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ saptamaṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavetmadhye caivāṣṭadiśi ca navakūṭasamāyutamprāgvanmukhena sopānaṃ diśi bhadrasamanvitamrudrabhaktyā yugāśraṃ tu madhye'gnyaṃśena kūṭakamdvārānyatraiva kuḍyaṃ vā iṣṭabhāgāvasānakamdvādaśāṃśe yugāśraṃ tu madhye dvyaṃśena kūṭakamcaturdvyaṃśena vistāraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ syāccaturdiśisarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ daśamaṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavetiṣṭadikkuḍyasaṃyuktaṃ caturdigbhadrasaṃyutamsadvayaṃ navatīyuktaṃ aṃghri ca samanvitamsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ rudrāṃśaṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavetvedādhikyaṃ tu viṃśāṃśaṃ dviśataṃ caraṇānvitamnandādi bhadrasaṃyuktaṃ iṣṭabhaktyā viśeṣataḥtripaṃcabhittivistāraṃ āyataṃ caturaśrakamguṇāṃśaṃ vistṛtāyāmaṃ mukhabhadrasamanvitamtoraṇairjālakaiścānyaiḥ alaṃkṛtya samanvitamsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ maṇṭapaṃ tu trayodaśaita ūrdhvaṃ catustriṃśat daśasīmāvasānakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhittistambhaṃ ca paritaḥ karturicchāvaśānnayetvistārabhittitulyaṃ vā yātaṃ vā yatabhitti yaḥsaptaviṃśāṃgulaṃ yāvat tāvatpādena voditamnāśraye tu karaṃ pūrya maṇṭapaṃ tu samācaretāyādīṣṭa śubhaupetaṃ maṇṭapasya tadāyatambhaktitrayaviśālaṃ tu paṃcabhaktyāyatānvitampārśve vārayutaṃ cettu triṃśadaṃghri samanvitamlūpārohaṇakaṃ kuryāt aṣṭaviṃśāṃghrisaṃyutamathavā vārahīnaṃ tu triraṣṭacaraṇānvitamnānākuṃbhalatādyaistu kalpitaṃ prathamaṃ bhavetmaṇṭapaṃ paritoṃśena kūṭamabhyantaretaramdvātriṃśaccaraṇopetaṃ maṇṭapasya dvitīyakamtripaṃcabhakti vistāraṃ dīrghamadhye sabhā bhavetcatvāriṃśati pāḍyaṃ vā sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutamrasabhaktiviśālaṃ tu vasubhaktyā yatāśrakammaṇṭapaṃ parito'kṣāṃśaṃ iṣṭadiṅmukhabhadrakamnānālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ caturthaṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavettribhaktivistṛtaṃ paṃca bhaktyāyāmaṃ sabhāṃkaṇamtribhaktivistṛtaṃ caika bhaktyāyāmamukhabhadrakamsarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ paṃcamaṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavetdvicaturbhāgavistāraṃ dīrghamadhye sabhodayamiṣṭadiṅmukhabhadrāṃśaṃ caturdvyaṃśe ca suvrata !ṣaṣṭhamaṃ maṇṭapaṃ hyevaṃ procyate tu śivārhakamekāṃśaṃ bhakti vistāraṃ dīrghamadhye sabhā bhavettricaturbhāgavistāraṃ dīrghaṃ syānmukhamaṇṭapam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśabhaktyāviśālaṃ tu dvibhaktyādhikamāyatamparito lindamekāṃśaṃ maṇṭapāddvyaṃśabāhyataḥiṣṭadigbhadrasaṃyuktaṃ aṣṭamaṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavetparito'lindamekāṃśaṃ maṇṭapaṃ dvyaṃśabāhyataḥādityāṃśaviśāle tu dvibhāgādhikamāyatambāhyake'lindamekāṃśaṃ maṇṭape dvyaṃśabāhyakevistṛte tu jagatyāṃśe taddvyaṃśādhikaṃ māyatammaṇṭape'tra vimānaṃ tu tadbāhye'lindabhāgayābhadramaṇṭapamākhyātaṃ iṣṭadigbhadrasaṃyutamdvicaturbhāgadhāyāmaṃ tāramadhye sabhāṃkaṇammaṇṭapādbāhyato'lindaṃ bhāgamevaṃ vidhīyatetripaṃcāṃśe viśālaṃ tu dvibhāgādhikamāyatamaṃkaṇāvṛtamekāṃśaṃ alindaṃ tu vidhīyatetasyāvṛtāṃśato'lindaṃ trayodaśaṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavetcaturviṃśāṃkaṇopetaṃ bāhye'lindāṃśa mānataḥtasyā vṛtāṃśato'lindaṃ caturdaśaṃ maṇṭapaṃ bhavetjālakaṃ ca kavāṭaṃ ca grāhyaṃ yuktyā viśeṣataḥevaṃ hi manubhedaṃ ca sāyataṃ maṇṭapaṃ viduḥsarveṣāṃ maṇṭapānāṃ tu bhittivyāsaṃ tu paṃcadhāsarveṣāṃ mukhabhadrāṇāṃ aṃkaṇaṃ maṇṭapākṛtiḥpaṃcaṣaṭsaptanandāṣṭa daṇḍaṃ vā tasya vistṛtamyaṣṭinābhyutakalpyevaṃ vasvaśraṃ gajahastakammūlādaṣṭāṃśahīnaṃ tad agravyāsaṃ kramātkṛśamdaṇḍaṃ sapādadaṇḍaṃ vā sārdha tripādapādakamtena dviguṇa nīvraṃ tu adhastānmaṇṭapaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādau tasminsthale sthitvā savyapādapurassarammaṇṭapaṃ hyevamākhyātaṃ gopuraṃ śṛṇu suvrata !ityaṃśumānkāśyape maṇṭapalakṣaṇavidhipaṭalaḥ (tricatvāriṃśaḥ)antarmaṇḍala sālādistvadhunā procyate kramātdvāragopura ityete kramānnāmnā prakīrtitāḥdvibhūmirvā tribhūmirvā caturbhūmirathāpi vātricatuṣpaṃcabhūmirvā dvāraprāsādamārabhetpaṃcaṣaṭsaptabhūmirvā dvāragopuramiṣyatesopapīṭhamadhiṣṭhānaṃ vinā vādupapīṭhakammūlaprāsādavistāraṃ saptāṣṭanavabhājiteśobhādi gopurāntānāṃ vipulaṃ kīrtitaṃ kramātmūlālayaviśālaṃ tu catuṣpaṃcaṣaḍaṃśakemūlagehatribhāgaikaṃ bhāgamardhāṃśameva vāpaṃcabhāge tu vedāṃśaṃ sāleṣu prathamādiṣukalpyaivaṃ harmyamānaṃ syāddhastamāna vaśāttataḥśobhādi gopurāntānāṃ pratyekaṃ tritribhedakamguṇahastaṃ samārabhya saptādaśakarāvadhicaturhastaṃ samārabhya yāvadaṣṭadaśaiḥ karaiḥpratyekaṃ tritridhā mānaṃ chandaṃ paṃcavidhaṃ bhavetsvasvoditaḥ prakartavyaṃ viparītaṃ vipatkaramdaśaikādaśahastaṃ tu adhamāditrayaṃ trayamathavānyaprakāreṇa śobhādīnāṃ tu vistaramtrayodaśakarāntaṃ tu śobhāvyāsaṃ tu paṃcadhātrayoviṃśatkarāntaṃ tu dvāraśālā tu paṃcadhādvāraprāsādavistāraṃ paṃcadhā parikīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṃcadhā dvāraharmyasya vistāraṃ parikīrtitamdvidvihastavivṛddhyā tu paṃcadhā gopurastatamsa pādaṃ sārdhapādona dviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu vāśobhādi gopurāntānāṃ evaṃ hyevaṃ pragṛhyatāmhastamānena vistāraṃ gṛhīte tu viśeṣataḥhastacchedaṃ pravṛddhyā vā hanyā vā pūrvamācarettau vinā harmyamūlasya vaśaṃ saṃkalpitasya tuvistāraṃ saptadhā bhajya śobhoccaṃ rudrabhāgayāsaptābhāgena rudrāṃśaṃ bhānvaṃśaṃ vā tṛtīyakevistāradviguṇotsedhaṃ mahāgopuramiṣyatevistārāyāmayormānaṃ sūtraṃ pādbāhyamucyatevistārasya tribhāgaikaṃ caturbhāgaikameva vāsārdhahastaṃ samārabhya ṣaṭṣaḍaṃgulavardhanātalpānāṃ ca tridhā proktaṃ dvyantarāṇāṃ tataḥ śṛṇuṣaḍaṃgulavivṛddhyā tu dvāravyāsaṃ prakīrtitamrasamatravivṛddhyā tu mahate dvāravistṛtamadhyardhaṃ pādahīnaṃ tu dviguṇaṃ dviguṇonnatamliṃgasya madhyamaṃ dvāraṃ madhyamaṃ tu vadāmyahamliṃgamadhyāttu vāme vā dvāramadhyaṃ prakalpayettanmadhyādgopurāyāmaṃ ubhayoḥ pārśvayossamamguṇabhaktisamārabhya yāvadekona viṃśatiḥyāvaddvipaṃktayorvyāse tāvadevāyapaṃktayaḥśeṣaṃ kuḍyaviśālaṃ syā tārārdhaṃ vāgrahastakamparitaḥ kuḍyavistāraṃ anenaiva prakalpayetvistāre paṃcabhāgaṃ syāt āyāme'pi tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekāṃśaṃ karṇakūṭaṃ syāt guṇāṃśaṃ koṣṭhadīrghakamvistāraṃ saptabhāgaṃ syāt navabhāgaṃ tadāyatamkarṇakūṭaṃ tu tāreṃśaṃ śālādīrghaṃ guṇāṃśakamśālādīrghaṃ tu paṃcāṃśaṃ āyāmaṃ tu prakalpayetkūṭāntarasamāyāmaṃ śeṣaṃ hārānvitaṃ bhavetdvitalaṃ hyevamākhyātaṃ tritalaṃ tvadhunocyategarbhagehaṃ guṇāṃśaṃ syād aṃśena gṛhapiṇḍikākarṇakūṭaṃ śivāṃśena śālādīrghaṃ guṇāṃśakamkalpyevamādibhūmaṃ tu dvitalaṃ pūrvavadviduḥdvāraśobhaṃ tu vistāraṃ rudrāṃśaṃ tu tadāyatamalindaṃ tatsamaṃ khyātaṃ hāraṃ bhāgena kalpayetāyāme paṃcabhāgena koṣṭhadīrghaṃ prakalpayettritalaṃ hyevamākhyātaṃ caturbhūmimidaṃ paramgarbhagehaṃ tribhāgādi sārdhāṃśaṃ kuḍyavistṛtampaṃjaraṃ karṇakūṭaṃ ca tvekaikāṃśena kalpayetśālāyāme tu vedāṃśaṃ ardhāṃśaṃ hārayontaramvistāre tu daśāṃśe tu bhānvaṃśaṃ tu tadāyatamśeṣaṃ pūrvavaduddiṣṭaṃ catubhūmimidaṃ parampūrve pare ca pārśve ca śālā paṃcāṃśamāyatamhārāntaraṃ tathāṃśaṃ ca kalpyevaṃ prathamaṃ talamtāramekādaśāṃśe tu taddīrghaṃ tu trayodaśaalindaṃ caikabhāgena hārābhāgena kalpayetpaṃcabhūmessamākhyātaṃ ṣaṭtalaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇuyugāṃśaṃ garbhagehaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ bhakti vistṛtampārśvaśālā tu vedāṃśaṃ ṣaḍaṃśaṃ mukhapṛṣṭhayoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduddiṣṭaṃ rasabhūmyaivameva tubhūtāṃśaṃ garbhagehaṃ tu gṛhapiṇḍī dvibhāgayākoṣṭhāyāmaṃ tu bhūtāṃśaṃ sarvatrāṃśena paṃjaramathavā trayodaśaṃtāraṃ āyāmaṃ tu tripaṃcakampaṃcabhāgena kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ pārśvadīrghakamsaptabhūmissamākhyātā tanmahāgopuraṃ bhavetvinālindaṃ kṛtaṃ cettu kuḍyagarbhagṛhaṃ tu vāādibhūmyaivamākhyātaṃ ūrdhvaṃ ṣaṭtalavadbhavetpādādhiṣṭhānayostuṃgaṃ mūlaprāsādamūlakamdaśaikādaśabhāgaṃ vā saptāṣṭa nava eva vāśeṣaṃ cānalabhāgaṃ tu kṛtvaikāṃśaṃ dharātalamupapīṭhavidhānokta tuṃgaṃ caivopapīṭhakamtaduccaṃ tu catuṣpaṃca ṣaṭsaptāṣṭau tu vā bhavetupapīṭhonnataṃ khyātaṃ śeṣaṃ tu guṇabhājitehomāduttarasīmāntaṃ dvāramānaṃ vidhīyatesthūpyantamuttarādyaṃ ca rasabhāgaṃ vibhājitepādona guṇabhāgaṃ tu śiraśśeṣaṃ śikhodayamuttarādi śikhāntaṃ ca navabhāgaṃ vibhājitemaṃcamānaṃ śivāṃśaṃ syāt tatsamaṃ kandharodayamdvitalaṃ hyevamākhyātaṃ tritalaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇusapādaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ sārdhadvyaṃśāṃghriṇodayammaṃcamānaṃ śivāṃśaṃ syād aṃśaṃ grīvodayaṃ bhavettritalaṃ hyevamākhyātaṃ caturbhūmi mathocyatepādona dvyaṃśamaṃcoccaṃ guṇāṃśaṃ caraṇodayamtadardhaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ dvibhāgaṃ caraṇodayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: guṇāṃśaṃ śikharotsedhaṃ śikhāmānaṃ śivāṃśakamśikhāntamuttarādyaṃ ca trayoviṃśati bhājitetadardhaṃ maṃcamānaṃ syāt pādāyāmaṃ guṇāṃśakamtadardhaṃ maṃcamānaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ caraṇodayamsārdhadvyaṃśaṃ śirottuṃgaṃ ekādaśaṃ sthūpi mānakamuttarādi śikhāntaṃ ca ekona triṃśadaṃśakesa tripādaśivāṃśaṃ tu prastarodayamīritamsārdhadvyaṃśāṃghri tuṃgaṃ tu tasyārdhaṃ prastarodayamśivāṃśaṃ galamānaṃ tu sārdhadvyaṃśaṃ śirodayamuttarādi śikhāntaṃ ca mānaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃśakedvibhāgaṃ prastaroccaṃ tu vedāṃśaṃ caraṇodayampādona dvyaṃśamaṃcoccaṃ guṇāṃśaṃ pādamānakamtadardhaṃ maṃcamānaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ talipāyatampādahīnāgnibhāgaṃ tu śiraśśeṣaṃ śikhodayammaṇṭapasā yathā dvāraśālāṃ kuryād dvijottamamālikākṛti kartavyaṃ dvāraharmyaṃ dvijottama !sarve vai gopurābhaṃ vā kalpayetkalpavittamaḥekadvitritalaṃ vāpi sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutamvasvakṛtyālpanāsāḍhyaṃ prāguktavidhinā dvija !maṇṭapākṛtikaṃ vāpi śrīkāntaṃ tadudāhṛtampāśvayorvaṃśanāsāḍhyaṃ ayugmasthūpasamanvitammukhe mukhe ca ṣaṇṇāsī pārśvayorvaṃśanāsikāevaṃ trividhanītyā tu dvāraśobhāḥ prakalpayetardhakoṭi catasrāḍhyaṃ paṃjaraṃ ca tadākṛtiḥvijayaṃ viśālametaddhi viśālāyāmamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pārśvayorvaṃśanāsāḍhyaṃ śirobhadrasamanvitamvipratīkāntalaṃkāraṃ vakṣyate tu viśeṣataḥmahānāsī catasrāḍhyaṃ śirobhadrasamanvitamtrividhā dvāraśālāsyād dvāraprāsādamucyatedvārordhve raṃgasaṃyuktaṃ dvāraṃ tadbhadrasaṃyutamsvastikā kṛtināsāḍhyaṃ catuṣpaṃjarasaṃyutamśrīkeśālaṃkṛtaṃ vakṣye bhūmibhāgādi pūrvavatnānāmasūrakastambhaṃ vedijālakatoraṇaiḥpārśvayordaṇḍavaktrāḍhyaṃ kṣudranāsīvibhūṣitamkeśaviśālālaṃkāraṃ bhūmibhāgādi pūrvavatayugmasthūpi saṃyuktaṃ dvāraprāsādakaṃ trayamprāguktavatprakartavyaṃ bhūmibhāge dvijottama !śikharaṃ cāṣṭanāsāḍhyaṃ ayugmasthūpisaṃyutammukhe mukhe ca bhadrāṃgaṃ śiraścāyatamaṇḍanamantaḥ pādottarairyuktaṃ ayugmasthūpikānvitampure pare mahānāsī satāre dvyaṃśanīvrakamśālākrāntaṃ saṃyuktaṃ nānālaṃkāraśobhitamdvāraharmyaṃ tridhā proktaṃ śṛṇu gopuralakṣaṇamśālākāraṃ śiroyuktaṃ bhadranāsī mukhe mukhemātṛkhaṇḍamidaṃ khyātaṃ śrīviśālamatha śṛṇuśīrṣaṃ ca tasākāraṃ sabhākāramathāpi vācaturdiśi mahānāsī vidikṣu kṣudranāsikāḥdiśibhadrasamāyuktaṃ madhyavāraṇasaṃyutamsabhākāraśirovāpi śālākāramathāpi vāantaḥ pādottarairyuktaṃ prastare tu talaṃ prati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: alīndaṃśaṃ tu kuḍyaṃ vā varṣasthalamathāpi vāśālākāraṃ sabhāgaṃ vā mālikā kṛtireva vābāhye bāhyeṃghriyasthāpya madhye madhye yutaṃ tu vāalīndaṃ hārayormāne vivṛttāṃghrikameva vākūṭakoṣṭhādyalaṃkāraṃ ūrdhvasthavat prakalpayetśīrṣadaṇḍakaśālābhaṃ śālākāraṃ taducyateprastaraṃ pratisaṃchādyaṃ maṇḍyaṃ yaśvīṣṭaraṃ vināgopuraṃ hyevamākhyātaṃ parivāramatha śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape gopuralakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (catuścatvāriṃśaḥ)aṣṭau vā ṣoḍaśaṃ caiva dvātriṃśacca yathākramamsaṃkalpyāntarahārāyāṃ parivārāṣṭakaṃ dvija !madhyahārā caturthe tu dvātriṃśatparivārakammukhāyāmaṃ vinā bīje caturaśre kṛte satitadāvṛttāṣṭabhāgeṣu pūrvādi kramayogataḥagnirdurgā tu vā yāmye athavā saptamātaraḥekaberantu vā yāmye nair-ṛtyāṃ vā vināyakamsaumye tu keśavasthānaṃ tatra kātyāyanī tu vāpratimātvālayopetā pīṭhaścedālayaṃ vināgauryāstu mālikā vātha vimānaṃ vā prakalpayetmūlaharmyāttripādaṃ vā ardhaṃ vā pādameva vātricatuṣpaṃcahastaṃ vā parivārālayastatamśāntikādiṣu yanmūlaṃ gehameṣāṃ tadeva hitrivargamaṇṭapākāraṃ catudvāra samanvitamparivārālayaṃ proktaṃ pratimālakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuyaduktaṃ sakalānāṃ tu tanmānaṃ vātha gṛhyatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvātriṃśatparivāraṃ tu jālajaharmye tu kalpitamathavā sarvaharmyeṣu sarvaṃ vā parikalpayetādau tu parivārāṇāṃ vakṣyehaṃ vṛṣalakṣaṇamityaṃśumānkāśyape parivāralakṣaṇavidhipaṭalaḥ (paṃcacatvāriṃśaḥ)catvāriṃśāṃgulāyāmaṃ galātpṛṣṭhāvasānakamtasmādgrīvoccamaṣṭāṃśaṃ uro'ntaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgulamjānumānaṃ dvimātraṃ syāt jaṃghamānaṃ ṣaḍaṃgulamśṛṃgāraṃ tu vasvaṃśaṃ śṛṃgoccaṃ caturaṃgulamardhāṃgulaṃ tadagraṃ syāt agraṃ mūlātkramātkṛśamlalāṭa vyāsanandāṃśaṃ mukhavyāsaṃ śarāṃmulamadhyardhāṃgulamutsedhaṃ śapharākṛtivatkṛtamtasmādvai pṛṣṭhagrīvāntaṃ ṣaṇmātraṃ parikīrtitamkarṇamūlaviśālaṃ tu dvimātramiti vidyateghanamardhāṃgulaṃ khyātaṃ ghrāṇaṃ sārdhāṃgulāyatamaṃgulaṃ nāsikādūrdhvaṃ tuṃgamityabhidhīyatetrimātraṃ cottaroṣṭhaṃ ca yuktitaḥ kalpayetkramātgrīvavyāsaṃ daśāṃśaṃsyātanmūlaṃ dvādaśāṃgulampṛṣṭhagrīvāgravistāraṃ ṣaḍaṃgulamudāhṛtamgrīvasyāgraghanaṃ cāpi adhyardhāṃgulamucyateśarīramadhyame vyāsaṃ caturdaśāṃgulaṃ bhavetpūrvapādorumūlasya vyāsaṃ paṃcāṃgulaṃ bhavetjaṃghāgraṃ guṇamātraṃ syāt sārdhāgnyaṃśaṃ khurastatamśeṣaṃ pūrvoruvatkāryaṃ pucchaṃ jaṃghāgrasīmakampucchāgraṃ keśasahitaṃ vyāsaṃ vedāṃgulaṃ bhavetbījāyāmaviśālaṃ tu caturagnyaṃgulaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: udarātpyaṃgulaṃ śeṣaghanamityabhidhīyatesudhayā iṣṭikāgarbhaṃ śilālohajameva vākiṃcinyūnādhike vipra mānonmāna pramāṇakekartavyaṃ viparītaṃ cet viparītaphalapradamityaṃśumānkāśyape vṛṣalakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaḥ)dvivaktraṃ caikahṛdayaṃ dvināsī ca ṣaḍakṣakamsavyavaktre caturjihvā vāmavaktre trijihvayādakṣiṇe tu caturhastaṃ vāmapārśve trihastakamtomaravyajanaṃ vāme ghṛtapātraṃ viśeṣataḥprabhāmaṇḍalasaṃyuktaṃ padmapīṭhoparisthitambrāhmīmāheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathādakṣiṇe vīrabhadraṃ tu paścime tu vināyakamsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ vṛṣadhvajamgadāvaradahastaṃ ca vāmapārśve karadvayamcaturbāhusamāyuktaṃ hemavarṇasamāyutamraktapadmāsanāsīnaṃ haṃsavāhanaketukambrāhmaṇīrūpamākhyātaṃ brahmavṛkṣasamāśritamśūlābhayakarāssavye vāme varadahastakāīśvareṇopamāhyeṣāṃ īśvarīti prakīrtitāsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā vālikāmaṇḍamākuṭīmayūravāhinī caivodumbaraṃ vṛkṣameva vāsustanā cāruvadanā śyāmāṃgā casulocanārājavṛkṣaṃ samāśritya garuḍadhvajavāhinīvārāhīṃ caturbhujāṃ śāntāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmpītāmbaradharāṃ vāpi sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṃkuśaṃ cābhayaṃ savye vāme varadaśaktikāmcaturbhujāṃ triṇetrāṃ ca raktavarṇordhvakeśikāmvyāghracarmāmbaradharāṃ nāgendraskandha sustanāmcāmuṇḍīlakṣaṇaṃ hyevaṃ ekaberaṃ ca tadbhavetevaṃ vai saptamātṝnāṃ kārayeddvijasattama !ityaṃśumānkāśyape mātṛkālakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (saptacatvāriṃśaḥ)pādāduṣṇīṣaparyantaṃ catuṣṣaṣṭyaṃśabhājitamtasmādvai netrasūtrāntaṃ caturmātramudāhṛtamtasmācca karṇamānaṃ syāt dvayaṃgulamudāhṛtamūruḥ ṣaḍaṃśamānaḥ syāt jānudīrghaṃ guṇāṃgulamsaptāṃgulasamāyāmaṃ aṃguṣṭhādi vasānakamtarjanyādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ pratyekaṃ tu yavonakamcaturmātraṃ talāyāmaṃ agnyaṃśaṃ madhyamāṃgulamkaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhayoścaiva dīrghaṃ saptadaśā yavamaṃguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ vyāsamityabhidhīyatenakhavyāsaṃ tripādaṃ syād nakhadīrghāya vṛttavatprakoṣṭhāntaṃ yugāṃgulyaṃ bāhuvyāsaṃ ṣaḍardhakamsaptāṃgulaṃ nataṃ nimno mukhamadhye daśāṃgulamtadaṃgulāgravistāraṃ sārdhamātraṃ dvijottama !vāmadantāyatadbhavet vedamātramityabhidhīyateadharasya tu niṣkrāntāllambanaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ bhavetkarṇabhūtāṃgula vyāsaṃ utsedhaṃ caiva tatsamamyadvadgajānanaṃ tadvat kartavyaṃ tu mukhaṃ dvijaekonaviṃśadaṃgulyaṃ kakṣāntaramudāhṛtamstanākṣaṃ sa yavavyāsaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ stanamaṇḍalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvāviṃśadaṃgulaṃ khyātaṃ madhyodaraviśālakamliṃgāyāmaṃ guṇāṃgulyaṃ tasyārdhaṃ tasya vistṛtamūrumūlaṃ dvādaśāṃgulyaṃ ūrumadhyaṃ ṣaḍardhakamnalakātārayugāṃśaṃ syā paṃcāṃśaṃ pādavistṛtamaṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ pādāṃguli viśālakamsthānakaṃ tvāsanaṃ vāpi padmapīṭhe viśeṣataḥmodakaṃ gajahaste tu aṃkuśaṃ dakṣiṇe karetriṇetraṃ hemasaṃkāśaṃ dukūlavasanacchadamāsane tvāsanaṃ cetu vāmapādaṃ tu śāyayetīṣadvakratanurvāme kartavyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahodaramityaṃśumānkāśyape vināyakalakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (aṣṭacatvāriṃśaḥ)mānonmānādayassarve prāguktaṃ sarvalakṣaṇamśaktiṃ bāṇaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca cakraṃ pāśaṃ prasāritamdhanurdaṇḍaṃ halaṃ caiva bhānuhastānvite dhṛtamkheṭakaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca kukkuṭaṃ vāmahastakekukkuṭaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca vāmahastadhṛto guhaḥatrānuktaṃ tu yatsarvaṃ umāskandasahitoktavatityaṃśumānkāśyape skandalakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ekonapaṃcāśaḥ)lambamānastanokukṣī nīlaṃ vā rakta vāsasambhadrapīṭhasthitāsīnāṃ dvipādaṃ caiva lambitamkākadhvajasamāyuktāṃ alakātilakānvitāmdvibhujo dakṣiṇe haste daṇḍaṃ vāme tu sūcidhṛkśvetavarṇaṃ mahākāyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamsustanā yauvanāṃgā ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvinetrā karaṇḍamakuṭā vāmapādaṃ pralambitamevaṃ jyeṣṭhā samākhyātā durgālakṣaṇamucyatesaumyā pītāmbaropetā pīnorujaghanastanīabhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ khaḍgaṃ vai vāmahastakamsamapātsthānakaṃ kuryāt padmapīṭhopari sthitāevaṃ durgā samākhyātā viṣṇulakṣaṇamucyatepītāmbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ caturbhujasamanvitamparahaste tu vāme tu śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ tu dakṣiṇeāsīnaṃ vā sthitaṃ vāpi savyāsavye śriyāvanīekavaktraṃ dvihastaṃ ca jātiliṃgasamaprabhamkaraṇḍamakuṭopetaṃ svamaṇḍalamakuṭo pareraktaraṃjakabaddhābhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamsaumyanetradvayopetaṃ sauramevaṃ prakalpayetkirīṭamakuṭopetaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamviśālodaraṃ tathāgrīvaṃ * śacī samanvitamāsīnaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ gajārūḍhamathāpi vāekasiṃhāsanāsīnāvaśvinyau viśvarūpiṇauphullaraktotmalākṣau ca pītāsṛgvastradhāriṇaukaradvayasamāyuktau strībhūṣaṇa vibhūṣitaulambitau dakṣiṇau pādau vāme vaikuṭikāsanautayoḥ pārśvadvaye vipra dakṣiṇādakṣiṇe kramātpariviśālakaraṇī vaśvinyau pītapiṃgalaupītaraktanibhopetau * * * kṛṣṇavāsasauaśvinyevaṃ samākhyātau pitṛrupamathocyatepītavarṇāṃga keśāste vāsīkābaddhamastakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāgābharaṇasaṃyuktāḥ bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥphalakā bhadrapīṭhe vā pitarastu mahāsanāḥsūcirdakṣiṇahastāstu pitarastraya ucyatedvibhujaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tu khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇamraktavastradharaṃ cograṃ kirīṭamakuṭānvitamyamavattasya pārśvasthau tamivaśmaśruvaktrakaukṛṣṇa śyāma nibho petau raktavastradharāvubhaunīlalohitasaṃkāśau dvau cāmaradhṛtistriyauyamaḥ siṃhāsanāsīno mahiṣopari rohitaḥkaraṇḍamakuṭā raktā dvibhujā ca suśobhanāāsīno vā sthito vāpi saptasaṃkhyā ca rohiṇīnir-ṛtiṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu dvibhujaṃ ca mahātanumpītavastradharaṃ raudraṃ karālavasudaṃṣṭrakamraktakeśasamāyuktaṃ sthitaṃ vāsīnameva vāatikāntā yuvā raktā keśabhārālakānvitādukūlavasanāssarvā pīnorūjaghanasthalāḥgandhādyairanuliptāṃgā bhadrapīṭhopari sthitāḥapsarāstvevamākhyātā varuṇastvatha vakṣyatesarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ karaṇḍamakuṭānvitamyajñasūtreṇasaṃyuktaṃ makarasthānakānvitamvṛddhāśca dvibhujāḥ śāntāḥ jaṭācūḍasamanvitāḥbhasmanā ca tripuṇṭrāste sthānakāstvāsanāstu vādaṇḍaṃ vināthavā (haste) savye vai jñānamudrikāḥatryagastthau vasiṣṭhaśca gautamāṃgirasau tathādvibhujastu mahāvīryaḥ tāmrākṣo dhūmrasaṃnibhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuṃcitāṃghriyuto vāyuḥ śālalambarabhūṣitaḥsiṃhāsanopariṣṭāttu śīghrayātro sukhasthitaḥcaturbhujāstriṇetrāśca jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitāḥsamapādāḥ sthānakāśca sarve padmopari sthitāḥabhayaṃ paraśuṃ savye varadaṃ kṛṣṇavāmakeīśāno vijayo bhīmo devadevo bhavodbhavaḥsomassiṃhāsanāsīnaḥ kundaśaṃkhanibhānvitaḥāsīno vā sthito vāpi kumudābhyāṃ jvalatkaraḥśuklavastradharaśśāntaḥ sarvapuṣpairalaṃkṛtaḥśvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ sālvikādi guṇaṃ bhavettāmasaṃcāṣṭadordaṇḍaṃ ityevaṃ sātvikādikamśūlaṃ dakṣiṇahaste tu kapālaṃ tvitare dhṛtamparahaste tu savye khaṭvāṃgaṃ jaṃgamanyakepūrvavatparahastau dvau ghaṇṭā vāmahastakeśūlaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ ca dakṣiṇe tu karatrayetāmasaṃ tu dhanurbāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe'dakṣiṇe dhṛtamugradṛṣṭi samāyuktaṃ nānānāgavibhūṣitamīśo vai dvibhujaḥ śāntaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥśuklayajñopavītaśca śuklapadmopari sthitaḥīśamevaṃ samākhyātaṃ tato vai bhāskaraṃ kramātraktamaṇḍalasaṃsaktāḥ karaṇḍamakuṭānvitāḥchannavīrasamāyuktā bhāskarā dvādaśaiva tulokaprakāśakaścaiva lokasākṣī trivikramaḥete vai dvādaśādityā uttarādi kramāt sthitāḥanantaṃ caturbhujaṃ saumyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sitavastradharaṃ śāntaṃ triṇetraṃ padmasaṃsthitamācāryaṃ caturbhujaṃ śāntaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamabhayaṃ varadopetaṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇamabhayaścaturbhujaśśānto jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitaḥabhayaṃ varadopetaḥ śūlapāśadharo bhavetatyanta sundarā śāntā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitākaraṇḍamakuṭopetā padmapīṭhopari sthitādukūlapaṭṭadevāṃgaiḥ nānāvastradharā varāājānulambya vāme tu hastā ca samabhaṃgikācaturbhujā triṇetrā ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāgaurīlakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ yathā sakalalakṣaṇamśivaścaturbhujaḥ śāntaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥabhayaṃ varadopetaḥ khaḍgakheṭakadhāraṇaḥcaturvaktraścaturbāhuḥ haritālasamaprabhaḥkṛṣṇājinottarīyaśca yajñasūtrasamanvitaḥśuklamālyānulepaśca karṇakuṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥkamaṇḍalaṃ kuśaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe sruksruvau dharaḥabhayaṃ varadau pūrve hastau vā dvijasattama !meḍhramūlopariṣṭāttu vāmahastordhvavaktrakamdakṣiṇe cākṣamālāṃ ca vāmahaste kamaṇḍalumāsīno vā sthito vāpi padmapīṭhopari sthitaḥsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śuklavastropavītakamabhayavaradopetaṃ śūlapāśadhṛtaṃ śucimbhṛguḥ śuklanibhaśśāntaḥ śuklavastradharastataḥabhayavaradopetaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvamevoditastvīśaḥ tathātraiva tu kalpayetekavaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ netratrayasamanvitamjaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamvidyeśaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥjaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktāṃ śuklavarṇāṃ sitāmbarāmsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā muktāhārā sulocanāpustakaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ vāme triṇetrā cārurūpiṇīevaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktā vāgdevī parikīrtitāhemaratnojvalannakra kuṇḍalābhyāṃ sumaṇḍitāraktākṣī pītagandhā ca kaṃcukācchādanastanīambujaṃ dakṣiṇe haste vāme śrīphalamucyatemekhalā kaṭisūtrā ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāpaśupativatkṛtvātha sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥanilaḥ pratyuṣaścaiva prabhāvaśca tathaiva capītāmbara dharāḥ sarve āsīnāstvāsthitāstu vākaraṇḍamakuṭopetā raudrāssarve prakīrtitāḥekarudramiva kāryo trimūrtirdvijasattama !taptakāṃcanasaṃkāśo hastadvayasamanvitaḥpadmapīṭho pariṣṭāttu dvinetro meṣavāhanaḥbhūtākārau mahābalau śaṃkhapadmanidhī tataḥkaraṇḍamakuṭopetau sitavāsottarīyakaudhanadasya tu vāme tu devīṃ kuryātsalakṣaṇāmkālāgnirudramūrtestu lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate'dhunākhaḍgakheṭakasaṃyuktaṃ śaracāpadhṛtaṃ paramraktordhvakeśasaṃyuktaṃ siṃhāsanoparisthitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karaṇḍamakuṭopetaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamraktavastrasamāyuktaṃ padmapīṭhoparisthitamtriṇetraṃ caturbhujaṃ saumyaṃ raktābhaṃ sitavāsasamkaraṇḍamakuṭopetaṃ nāgaṃ paṃcaphaṇānvitambhīmaṃ caturbhujaṃ raudraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamabhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva śūlaṃ pāśaṃ ca dhārayetsasyāṃkuranibhābhūmiḥ nīlālakasamanvitāpītavastradharā caiva prasannavadanānvitāpadmapīṭhopariṣṭāttu āsīnā vā sthitāpi vākaraṇḍamakuṭopetaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥkhaḍgakheṭakasaṃyuktaḥ padmapīṭhoparisthitaḥkeśabhārasamāyuktāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥkhaḍgakheṭakasaṃyuktāḥ pīnorujaghanasthalāḥugraścaturbhujo raudraḥ raktavarṇasamanvitaḥabhayavaradopetaṃ ṭaṃkaśūlasamanvitamśanaiścaraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ sitavastrakamdaṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇahaste tu varadaṃ vāmamucyateīṣatpaṃgumiva sthāne īṣaddhṛsvatanuḥ smṛtaḥbhānudvayāṃgulaṃ tāraṃ utsedhaṃ bhānumātrakamguṇāṃgulaṃ tadutsedhaṃ padmoccaṃ tu guṇāṃgulamśilābhirveṣṭakābhirvā sudhayā vā prakalpayetprāsādasya tu vistāraṃ yattaddaṇḍamihocyatedaśadvādaśadaṇḍo vā manudaṇḍāvasānakamathavānyaprakāreṇa pīṭhasthānaṃ vidhīyatemahāpīṭhaṃ prakartavyaṃ tasya lakṣaṇamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tripādaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ dvāratuṃgārdhakanyasamdviguṇaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ triguṇaṃ śreṣṭhamucyatedvihastaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ trihastaṃ śreṣṭhamucyateupānoccaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syād ṣaḍaṃśaṃ jagatī bhavetvedāṃśaṃ karṇamānaṃ tu ūrdhvakampaṃ śivāṃśakamvedāṃśaṃ padmatuṃgaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ karṇikodayampadmoccaṃ paṃcabhāgaṃ tu mahāpaṭṭī dvibhāgayāatha pīṭhodayaṃ vipra dharātalaṃ yathā kuruadhiṣṭhānoktamārgeṇa veśaniṣkrāntamācaretpīṭhākāraṃ yugāśraṃ vā vṛttaṃ vāṣṭāśrameva vālohajaṃ śailajaṃ vātha iṣṭakāmayameva vābhūtaiśca makarairvyālaiḥ vṛṣabhaiśca vibhūṣitampīṭhavyāse tu ṣaṭsapta vasunandāṃśake'pi vātadūrdhve tu mahāpīṭhaṃ uktavyāsodayānvitamāmodaṃ prāgdale vipra pramodaṃ yamadigdaletāmasaṃ cāgnidigbhāge rājasaṃ nair-ṛte dalevighnakartāramityuktaṃ tadvighnaṃ tadudāhṛtamtatsarvātmakamityuktaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ dvijottama !tāsāmārtiharāyātha nityotsavapradakṣiṇamsvargapradakṣiṇaṃ paścāt kṛtaṃ tadvāsināṃ hi tatpaścimābhimukhe harmye kiṃcidbhedaṃ vadāmyahamvāruṇe tu mahāpīṭhaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretparivāravidhiḥ proktaḥ paścālliṃgasya lakṣaṇamityaṃśumānkāśyape parivāravidhiḥ paṭalaḥ (paṃcāśaḥ)saṃhāre viṣayā bhūtālayaṃ gacchantyaśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃhāre niṣkalaṃ śāntaṃ paṇyamānamudīritamsarvatra vyāpinaṃ guhyaṃ sarvalokaikanāyakamtacchānteḥ śaktisaṃbhūtaṃ tasmānnādasya saṃbhavambindormanonmanī khyātā tasyāmīśvarasaṃbhavaḥtasmātprajeśassaṃbhūtaḥ prajeśāttu viśeṣataḥdevatā ṛṣayaścaiva dānavāpsarayonayaḥbindvantaṃ sakalaṃ khyātaṃ miśraṃ nādānyabindukamliṃgaṃ śivamayaṃ khyātaṃ pīṭhaṃ tasyātmikāyatamjagadārtivināśārthaṃ sarvaprāṇi hitāvahamliṃgayoni prakāreṇa sādākhyaṃ tatvamudbhavamtalliṃgaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ calaṃ caivācalaṃ tathāratnajaṃ lohajaṃ vātha liṃgaṃ kṛtvā sayonikamśirasodvartanopetaṃ lakṣaṇoddhāravarjitamudayenalaikabhāgaṃ vā vedāṃśaikamathāpi vāgamāgamākṣamaṃ caiṣṭadaṃśe nyastvoddhṛtakṣayamśailajaṃ bāṇajaliṃgaṃ vā garbhagehe tu viṣṭhareamajaṃ sūtrasaṃyuktaṃ bāṇaliṃgaṃ tu tadvināsumāsatithinakṣatre lagne vāre śilāṃ grahetdivyantarikṣabhaumādinimittānyupalakṣayetevaṃ vai dakṣiṇe vāme hastimāṃsena saṃyutamdadhnā ca pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca kṣīrakuṃbha tathaiva caannaṃ ca māṃsahāraṃ ca śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥvarāhaṃ ca gajaṃ caiva veśyā cātyantasundarīulkāpātaṃ diśādāhaṃ nvahākatha (?) pravartanammuktakeśaśirāścaiva vikīrṇākeśasaṃyutāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: darśanena ca mṛdbhāṇḍaiḥ tailapātraṃ tathaiva caabhāvaputranārī ca vidhavā ca tathaiva caśubhaṃ cedgamanaṃ kuryāt aśubheṣu nivartayetparvate sāgare tīrthe kṣetre caiva vane tathānadī taṭākatīre vā śilāṃ saṃgṛhya deśikaḥśvetāraktā ca pītā ca kṛṣṇā caiva caturvidhāmallikākusumābhā ca śvetāyāṃ saptadhā smṛtāḥdāḍimī puṣpasaṃkāśā bandhūkakusumaprabhāraktā saptavidhā khyātā evameva dvijottama !āsanāpuṣpasaṃkāśā haridrasya ca cūrṇavatāragvadhasya puṣpābhā pītaśailādvisaptadhābhṛṃgamāyūrakarṇābhā mahiṣasya ca nāsivathrasvamudgasamākārā kṛṣṇaśailā daśa smṛtāsarvakāmārtha mokṣaṃ ca dadyātsatatameva capratilomānulomābhyāṃ bījayogyaṃ tu gṛhyatāmśuklamālyānu liptāṃgau paṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇānvitauyasmindeśe śilāṃśaṃ tu tāṃ kṛtvā tu pradakṣiṇamvātātapāgni dagdhāṃ ca saṃkīrṇaṃ kṣīravāriṇāśarkarāḍhyāṃ tathaivānyaiḥ jharjharāṃ rukṣasaṃnibhāmsūtrapātavadākārā vīraraśmi samāyutājambūphalasamākārā stanākṣasadṛśopamākṛṣṇalohanibhākārā kṛṣṇabhṛṃgasya saṃnibhākharjūra patra sākārā dūrvāstaṃbha nibhā tathāikṣoragrasamākārā harīkā paṃcadhā smṛtādarirūpaṃ tridhā khyātaṃ sarvadoṣabhayāvaham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇā tu nāśāya śvete kṛṣṇā tathaiva caharikā kṛṣṇaśaile tu sitavarṇaṃ viśeṣataḥanyā kṛtyāśubhā khyātā godhānyadhananāśanambinduḥ putravināśaṃ syāt darī sarvavināśanambālā yuvatirvṛddhā ca puṃstrīnapuṃsakaṃ tathāghanakambudhvanī hrasvā śilā bālā iti smṛtāvivṛtadhvanisaṃyuktā yā sā vṛddhā prakīrtitātāladhvanisamākārā dīrghā yā sā śilā striyaḥsuraireva samākhyātāṃ ākṛtyā bhedamucyateāyatāśrā ca vṛttā ca daśadvādaśakoṇakādaśāśrāṃ dvādaśāśrāṃ ca bālāṃ vṛddhāṃ ca varjayetnapuṃsakaśilāyāṃ tu pādādhāraśilāyadprāgagrāṃ vodagagrāṃ vā śilāṃ saṃgrāhya śilpikaḥadhobhāge mukhaṃ khyātaṃ ūrdhvagatā bhavetsadyamaṃtreṇa saṃsnāpya gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetagnyādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ agnikāryoktamācaretcaruhomamaghoreṇa puruṣeṇaiva taṇḍulamśatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥtato vahniṃ samudvāsya pūjodvāsādikaṃ nyasetkavacaṃ tu samuccārya śilācchedanamācaretgarbhagehapramāṇaṃ ca dvāramānaṃ tathaiva caliṃgamānoddhṛtaṃ sapta teṣāṃ pratyekanaikadhāśreṣṭhottamādinavadhā procyate dvijasattama !taduttamamitikhyātaṃ tasyārdhaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetstambhayāmatataive tu navabhāgaṃ vibhājite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhiṣṭhānodaye vipra stambhamānavadācaretnavahastavidhiryāvat saṃkhyā ṣaṣṭi sa paṃcakampaṃcahastādadho harmyaṃ liṃgaṃ stambhavaśaṃ vinātrihastaṃ ṣaṭkarāntaṃ tu liṃgaṃ chanda vimānakeevaṃ hastaṃ samākhyātaṃ tālamānamathocyatesā liṃgo navasaṃkhyā syuḥ kalpyajātiratho bhavettadekānaikabhāgaṃ ca liṃgamānāṃgulena tuhastamānātkṣayaṃ liṃgaṃ vṛttākāraṃ viśeṣataḥśeṣaṃ tu dṛśyamānaṃ syāt vikalpābhāsa harmyakeekāṃgulaṃ samārabhya yāvadrudrāṃgulāvadhitrayodaśāṃgulādhastāt śailajaṃ tu na kārayetnāgaraṃ drāviḍaṃ liṃgaṃ vesaraṃ ca vadāmyahamtuṃge tryaṃśaṃ śivāṃśaṃ tu vistāraṃ śreṣṭhamucyateadhodaye kalāṃśe tu paṃcāṃśaṃ śāntikaṃ bhavetābhicāraṃ dvibhāgaṃ syād vyāsamevaṃ caturvidhamliṃgocce dvinnavāṃśe tu rasabhūtayugāṃśakevesaraṃ ca caturbhedaṃ harmyaliṃgasya piṇḍikāaṣṭāṃśaṃ saptaṣaṭpaṃca bhāgairvyāsaṃ prakalpitamvesaraṃ ca caturbhedaṃ harmyaṃ liṃgasya piṇḍikāyatraiva kalpitaṃ liṃgaṃ vardhahetu mudāhṛtamtasmāt sarvaprayatnena saṃkaraṃ na samācaretliṃgasyotsedhamānaṃ tu mānāṃgulena bhājayetśreṣṭhāntarādhamarmārvāmātrapūrṇaṃ parigrahethṛtvā te dinasaṃkhyā tu aśvinyādi dvijottama !p. 241) anale guṇite cāṣṭa hṛte yonimudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navabhirguṇite nāḍi hṛte śeṣaṃ vyayaṃ bhavetāyādhikyaṃ vyayaṃ hīnaṃ saṃpadāmāspadaṃ sadāsitasaumyaśaśī jīvo saptavāre śubhāśubhamjanmatrayaṃ ca vedāṣṭā ṛtu nandābhyavarjitambhānuvārādi saṃyuktaṃ viśākhādiścatuścatuḥśeṣaṃ yogaṃ parigrāhya śubhamānaṃ tu saṃgṛhetsarvato bhadraliṃgaṃ ca sārvadeśikameva casamaliṃgaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vardhamānakamsarveṣāmitaraṃ liṃgaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradamp. 242) iṣṭāyāmaviśāle tu catura śrīkaraṃ purācaturaśramadhobhāgaṃ brahmabhāgamathocyateūrdhvabhāge tu vṛttasya tacchivāṃśeti vidyatevṛkṣasya mūlamadhyāgraṃ śākhāpuṣpasamanvitamcarma cā rudramekasya ekaikāṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥtathaiva śivaliṃgasya bhāgaṃ pratyavibhibhedinākoṇātkoṇaṃ tu saṃkalpya tena mānena deśikaḥathavā liṃgatāraṃ tu saptabhāgaṃ vibhājiteathavā vasubhāge tu madhyapaṭṭaṃ rasāṃśakamaṣṭāśraṃ paṭṭavistāre caturaśrīkṛte satip. 243) tadbāhyaṃ tu paricchedya kalāśraṃ tadbhavedihaaṣṭāśrādīni vinyāsaṃ caturaśraṃ tu labhyatemadhye vomaṃ tu vasvaśraṃ agre vṛttaṃ śivāṃśakambhānudvyaṃśe tatāyāme saptāṃśaṃ caturaśrakamṣaṭsaptavasubhāgaṃ vā paṃca ṣaṭsapta eva vāliṃgāyāme daśāṃśe tu guṇāṃśaṃ caturaśrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivādhikamiti khyātaṃ athavānyaprakārataḥṣaṭṣaṭsaptāṃśakairvāpi śaivādhikyaṃ caturvidhamvasvaśraṃ tu guṇāṃśena vedāśraṃ vṛttamucyatemūlādagraṃ suvṛttaṃ tu liṃgottuṃgaṃ tribhāgikep. 244) pūjābhāgaṃ tadekāṃśaṃ sarvato bhadrameva hibhūtavedaguṇāṃśaṃ vā liṃgocce tu vibhājitesārvadeśikaliṃgaṃ tu evameva prakalpayetṣaḍaṃśairvartulairnāhaṃ saptāṃśairmadhyanāhakamsarvajātyārhakaṃ caiva trairāśikamidaṃ paramsamatvamūlavedāśraṃ śeṣaṃ vasvaśrameva vāpūjābhāgaṃ kalāśraṃ tu dhārāliṃgaṃ tridhābhavetsamaliṃgasya dhārasya sarvaprāṇi hitāvahampūjābhāgaṃ tridhākṛtvā ūrdhvabhāge mukhaṃ bhavetkarṇāṣṭau dvādaśākṣaṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutamp. 245) ata ūrdhvasya bhāgaṃ tu caturviṃśacchatāṃśakaiḥkeśāntaṃ nimnabhāgaṃ syāt muktādāmalakākṛtiḥnetrasūtrātpuṭāntaṃ ca puṭāntād hanumānakamhanvādigalamānaṃ tu caturyavamudāhṛtamśeṣaṃ liṃgākṛtikhyātaṃ kalpayellakṣaṇānvitamstanasūtroparībimbaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitammukhaliṃgamidaṃ khyātaṃ nṛpāṇāmabhivṛddhayebhāgahīnaṃ tu saṃkalpya sthūlamūlamudāhṛtamevamārṣakamākhyātaṃ ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaṃ varamdaśanavāśrakaṃ caiva agre tāramanopamamp. 246) śirasodvartanaṃ hīnamānonmānenanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bāṇena pūjitaṃ bhoge bāṇaliṃgamudāhṛtamunnataṃ tu mukhaṃ khyātaṃ sparśane tvatiśītalamviṣṭhare tu praveśāṃśaṃ sārvadeśikaliṃgavatliṃgabhedaṃ samākhyātaṃ śirasodvartanaṃ śṛṇutasmālliṃgodaye cordhve śirasodvartanaṃ dvija !tṛtīyaṃ tripuṣākāraṃ ardhacandraṃ caturthakamūrdhvādardhāṃśamālambya prathamaṃ chatraśīrṣakamchatrābhaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ syāt saptāṃśaṃ tu tṛtīyakamdvijānāṃ ca nṛpāṇāṃ ca chatrābhaṃ sarvakāmadamp. 247) vyāse dvātriṃśadaṃśe tu manupakṣakalāṃśakaiḥvardhamāne tu liṃge tu praśastaṃ kṣatriyārhakambhānutrayodaśāṃśaistu tripuṣābhaṃ caturvidhamtriṃśatyaṃśe viśāle'smindvāviṃśatyeka viṃśatiḥsvastikākhyeṣu liṃgeṣu kartavyaṃ śūdravṛddhidamchatrādiśīrṣakākāro kartṛjātivaśānnayetśirasodvartanotsedhaṃ guṇa ekavibhājiteuṣṇīṣamanamākhyātaṃ śiromānaṃ taducyateyāvallambāṃśasīmāntaṃ mūrdhni madhyāt natamvaktratrayasamāyuktaṃ kartavyaṃ chatraśīrṣakamp. 248) śīrṣake liṃgatāroccaṃ uktādanyaṃ na kārayetliṃgalakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ piṇḍikālakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuityaṃśumānkāśyape liṃgalakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (ekapaṃcāśaḥ)ādau tu vakṣyate vipra sakalānāṃ tato viduḥdāruje dārujaṃ vātha iṣṭakāmayameva vāliṃgotsedhasamaṃ pīṭha vistāraṃ cottamaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tayormadhye'ṣṭabhāge tu uttamādi trayaṃ trayamvyāsārdhamadhamottuṃgaṃ tayormadhyeṣṭabhājitekrameṇa kathitā vipra nāgarā hyeva mucyatesaptāṃśaṃ kanyasaṃ vyāsaṃ tayormadhye'ṣṭabhājiteudayaṃ vasudhā bhajya dvibhāgaṃ vānalāṃśakeśeṣaṃ pīṭhodayaṃ khyātaṃ evaṃ drāviḍamācaretpariṇāhe kalāṃśe tu bhānvaṃśamadhamaṃtatīḥviṣṇubhāgasamoccaṃ tu pīṭhaṃ kanyasamucyatenavadhā piṇḍikottuṃgaṃ vesare hyevamācaretathavā liṃgaviṣkaṃbhaṃ caturaśrīkṛte satītriguṇaṃ vā viśālaṃ tu pīṭhānāṃ tu viśeṣataḥpīṭhavyāsaṃ samākhyātaṃ viṣṇubhāgasamonnatamupānabāhyavistāraṃ sarveṣāṃ tu viśeṣataḥviṣṇubhāgasamottuṃgaṃ sapādaṃ sārdhameva vāliṃgānāṃ sakalānāṃ ca sāmānyaṃ pīṭhalakṣaṇamguṇāṃśaṃ śreṣṭhamānaṃ tu tayormadhye'ṣṭabhājitepīṭhatuṃgasamavyāsaṃ adhamaṃ pīṭhamucyatenavadhā vistṛtaṃ khyātaṃ sakalānāṃ viśeṣataḥgomukhārahitaṃ pīṭhaṃ sakalānāṃ viśeṣataḥsāyatāśrāya vṛttaṃ vā pratimānāsanaṃ tu vāpīṭhaṃ caturvidhaṃ khyātaṃ alaṃkāraṃ dvijottama !bhūtāṃśoccamadhaḥ padmaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ pādukasādṛśamśivāṃśaṃ ghṛtavāryuccaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ dalasaṃyutamardhāṃgulaṃ dalāgroccaṃ mānāṃgulena suvrata !pīṭhatāra tribhāgaikaṃ gomukhādīrghamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlatāratribhāgaikaṃ tasyāgraṃ vistṛtaṃ bhavettripādaṃ vārdhavā nīvra tribhāgaikāṃśameva vāpaṭṭikordhvasamaṃ nimnaṃ tasyādīṣaṃ tataṃ tu vāadhiṣṭhānāṃgavadveśa nīvraṃ vā parikalpayetkṛtvā tu ṣoḍaśotsedhaṃ bhāgenopānamucyateśivāṃśaṃ paṭṭikāmānaṃ kaṇṭhamānaṃ guṇāṃśakamśaśyaṃśaṃ ghṛtavāri syāt etattu bhadramucyateguṇāṃśaṃ jagatī mānaṃ kumudoccaṃ tu tatsamamtasyordhvakaṃpamekāṃśaṃ guṇāṃśā paṭṭikā bhavetbhadrameva tathā khyātaṃ vedipīṭhamathoparitadūrdhvapadmatattulyaṃ kaṃpamaṃśena kārayettadūrdhve padmamakṣāṃśaṃ paṭṭikā caiva tatsamamathavodayaṃ tu vasvaṃśe upānoccaṃ śivāṃśakamvedikā pīṭhamākhyātaṃ tadevākṣāṃśapaṭṭikāpadmaṃ vā bhadrapīṭhaṃ vā vṛttaṃ tatparimaṇḍalamupapīṭhāṃgavadvātha tattannāmnā prakīrtitāḥśāntiḥ syāddhanuṣākāraṃ guṇāśraṃ ripunāśanamroganāśakaraṃ cāṣṭakoṇamevaṃ kramādviduḥdravyotkṛṣṭairnavā vātha jīrṇoddhāre dvijottama !paścādanyā kṛtirvipra guṇaṃ vā gadāyatamliṃgānāṃ sāyataṃ pīṭhaṃ na kuryāttu kadācanasarvaṃ ca sakalānāṃ tu kartavyaṃ saṃpadāṃ padamityaṃśumānkāśyape piṇḍikā lakṣaṇa paṭalaḥ (dvipaṃcāśaḥ)liṃgatāratrayaṃ vyāsaṃ tattripādasamunnatamvyāsaṃ tu navabhāgaṃ tu tattripādoktamunnatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tuṃgaṃ tu navadhā proktaṃ pādāśma nāgare viduḥtadardhaṃ kanyasaṃ proktaṃ tayormadhyeṣṭabhājitetadardhamadhamaṃ khyātaṃ tayormadhye'ṣṭabhājitenālīgṛhatribhāgaika bhāgamuttamavistṛtamvyāsaṃ tu navadhā tuṃgaṃ tattribhāgottamonnatamtuṃgaṃ tu navadhā proktaṃ pādāśma veśarānvitamekāṃśamavaṭe nimnaṃ liṃgamūlavadākṛtiḥanyatra samatāṃ kuryāt ādhārākhya śilā smṛtāliṃgātpīṭhāvasānaṃ vā ekadvitryaṃgulādhikampīṭhavyasādyavaikaṃ vā drāviḍākṣāntikādikamnandyāvartaśilāvyāsaṃ navadhā vesaraṃ hi tatcaturaśrocitāyāme teṣāṃ dīrghamudāhṛtampaścime cottarāgraṃ tu prāgagraṃ cottare nyasettṛtīyamūlaṃ nir-ṛtau vāyumūlaṃ caturthakamūrdhveṣṭabandhanaṃ lipya sthāpayetpiṇḍikāṃ budhaiḥekāśmaṃ cottamaṃ pīṭhaṃ dvābhyāṃ vai madhyaviṣṭharampīṭhānāṃ tu galādūrdhvaṃ aśvatvekena kārayetgalādhastād dṛṣadvau ced pūrva vai cāpare nyasetcatvāraṃ ceccatuṣkoṇe caturaśraṃ prakalpayetathavā cāṣṭabandhairvā niśchidraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kurulohajaṃ ratnajaṃ caiva dārujaṃ caivameva tuviṣṇubhāgārdhasīmnā ca piṇḍikordhvaṃ samunnayetnapuṃsakaśilābhistu pīṭhādhastācchilāṃ nayetityaṃśumānkāśyape pādaśilādilakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ (tripaṃcāśaḥ)liṃgasya mukhanirmāṇaṃ lakṣaṇoddhāramiṣyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navāṣṭasaptahastaṃ vā maṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakammaṇṭapasya tribhāgaikaṃ tanmadhye vedikāṃ kurugomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā piṣṭacūrṇairalaṃ kṛtāmśālibhisthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā vedikāyāṃ viśeṣataḥadhamatrayaliṃgānāṃ evaṃ maṇṭapamācarettenaiva triguṇairvyāsaṃ maṇṭapasya viśālakamvedyūrdhve śāyayelliṃgaṃ prākśiraścordhvavaktrakamsasūtrānnavavastrāḍhyān gandhatoyena pūritāngandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca arcayettu svanāmataḥraktena śālinā veṣṭya liṃgapīṭhau samarcayetagnyādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ agnikāryoktamācaretā vo rājeti maṃtreṇa idaṃ viṣṇviti maṃtrataḥcaruṃ hutvātvaghoreṇa pratyekāṣṭaśatāhutiḥsvarṇarajatakārpāsa sūtrairvā hṛdayena tuevaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prabhāte sumuhūrtakesitavastrottarīyāḍhyaḥ sitamālyānulepanaḥsthapatiśca śucirbhūtvā yajñasūtrapavitradhṛtpāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ śiraḥ sthāne baliṃ haretratnena taṃ likhelliṃgaṃ madhye sūtraṃ tu pātayetliṃgamānena matimān sūtravistāramucyatevedaviṃśacchatāṃśaṃ ca kṛtvaikāṃśāṃgulaṃ stṛtamuttamottamaliṃgānāṃ sūtraṃ paṃcayavaṃtatīadhamatrayaliṃgānāṃ sūtratāraṃ yavaṃ bhavetlakṣaṇaṃ śirasi vyādhiḥ lalāṭe maraṇaṃ bhavetcibuke bandhunāśaṃ syāt karṇe skandhavināśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00198 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
